title: Growth Marketing - Germany 🇩🇪
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission ⚖️

At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle.

Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive.

The team you're joining

A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins.

The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀)

  • A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both)
  • Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board
  • A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth
  • An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI
  • A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections

Your missions

Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears.

  • Internationalization: design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France).
  • Inbound Lead Gen: team up with our agency to build campaigns that hit hard on Meta, LinkedIn and Google, and pull in as many qualified leads as possible.
  • Outbound Lead Gen: pinpoint the right contacts for the sales teams and fire up activation campaigns (enrichment, automation, sequences, performance tracking).
  • Nurturing: build and run nurturing campaigns on our leads, plus product-usage campaigns with existing customers, to max out conversion and retention.
  • Field Marketing & Product Growth: back the PMM team on product launches and be field marketing's right hand on our events, webinars and product launches.

The profile we're looking for

You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it).

Hard skills

  • AI is your copilot: this role runs 100% with AI, campaign production, copywriting, analysis, automation. A daily reflex, not a gimmick.
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation, sales engagement and CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, Intercom, Lemlist…).
  • A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys.
  • A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick.
  • A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins.
  • Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus).

Soft skills

  • Fluency in English is required to communicate with the team.
  • Fluency in German, it's a plus.
  • Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide.
  • Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark.
  • A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans.

Our stack 🛠️

Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

What's in it for you ☀️

🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

🌴 A flexible leave policy

🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

📚 A genuine focus on individual and collective learning, with a €750 annual budget for any training related to your role, plus team-wide and company-wide training sessions

🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year

👩‍⚕️ Health insurance with Alan

🍱🚲 A Swile card for meal vouchers and sustainable mobility allowance (€66.60/month)

💡 Discounts and perks via our Works Council (CSE) on the Happypal platform

🍏 Brand new Apple equipment

Our values 🤝

At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

Knowledge is power: information is at the heart of Doctrine's mission, and we constantly strive to grow.

Release early, release often and listen to your customers: we believe in the power of iteration and in constantly listening to our market, our customers and their challenges.

Our hiring process 🚀

  1. A 30-min intro call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers to understand your career goals and walk you through what we're building at Doctrine.
  2. A 1-hour conversation with your future manager to dive into the role, team scope and answer all your questions.
  3. One or two technical assessments to evaluate your skills in practice.
  4. An office visit including: lunch with 3 people from different teams to give you a feel for your future colleagues; a values conversation to share our vision; and a meeting with our CEO, Guillaume.

(The process can be adapted to fit your personal and professional constraints if needed.)

Ladies, go ahead and apply!

Research shows that women in particular tend not to apply for a role when they don't meet every single requirement. To put your mind at ease: this job description is a guide, nothing more.

If Doctrine interests you, we'd love to hear from you!

Diversity & inclusion

All our roles are open to people with disabilities. Feel free to bring it up at any point during the process. We're committed to putting in place whatever adjustments are needed to ensure a working environment that works for everyone.

title: Growth Product Manager - Customer Acquisition (German Speaking)
descriptionHtml:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

Hybrid in Berlin or London

We’re looking for a Growth Product Manager

Own the systems that decide which German businesses iwoca reaches, and the journey they take from first click to submitted loan application. You’ll join a team that is still being built, with a data scientist in place and engineers being hired in parallel. A good fit if you like working from first principles, and would rather run an experiment than win an argument.

The team

The DE Acquisition Tech team builds the systems behind how German businesses discover iwoca and apply for funding: the models that decide which businesses to approach, the eligibility checks that tell a business early whether iwoca can help, and the signup flow itself. Product, analytics, data science and engineering sit in the same squad by design, so the team can go from hypothesis to shipped change without waiting on anyone else. The German marketing and sales teams depend on this work: the team’s models decide who they contact, and its journeys decide how many of those businesses convert.

The team is being built right now. It currently includes a data scientist, and we’re hiring engineers in parallel – so you would join early enough to shape how the team operates.

The role

This role sits between iwoca’s German commercial teams – marketing, sales and commercial strategy – and the technical squad that builds for them. Reporting into the Head of Direct Acquisition, you will own acquisition and activation outcomes for the German market: finding the opportunities, defining the hypotheses, and working with engineering, data, marketing and sales to build, test and iterate.

The scope is broad. We’re not looking for someone with deep expertise in every domain the team covers – spanning product development, analytics, UX and data science – but rather someone intellectually curious, and skilled at asking the right questions.

Own the funnel from first visit to application

  • Own every step of that journey, including the signup flow itself and the eligibility checks inside it.

  • Set the roadmap for acquisition and the signup journey, and decide what the squad builds next.

  • Own the scoring and segmentation that decides where marketing spends and who sales calls first.

Build with your technical squad

  • Ship lead scoring systems, eligibility checkers and signup flows with the team’s data scientist and the engineers we’re hiring.

  • Rework website content, signup flows and decisioning logic with marketing and sales, to convert more of the businesses that already reach iwoca.

  • Strip friction out of the signup journey, so that applying for funding takes minutes rather than an afternoon.

Be the first call when the numbers look wrong

  • Act as the technical partner for German marketing, sales and channel management on attribution, tracking and data pipeline problems.

  • Investigate and resolve data quality issues – broken dashboards, misattributed traffic, unexplained volume changes – often at short notice.

  • Give channel managers access to, and guidance on, the attribution logic behind their numbers.

  • Keep the tracking and attribution systems trustworthy, so every decision downstream rests on numbers the team believes.

Run the experiments that decide what ships

  • Design, run and interpret A/B tests across messaging, targeting, eligibility checks and signup flows.

  • Find opportunities from first principles, backed by data, customer research and funnel analysis.

Shape how a new team works

  • Direct the squad’s work day to day: brief the data scientist and engineers, set priorities, and turn their models into shipped products.

  • Define the priorities, roles and rituals of a team that is still being built.

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with marketing and sales, aligning them with engineering and data on shared goals, hypotheses and success metrics.

  • Turn the commercial strategy team’s goals into testable hypotheses and briefs the squad can act on.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience as a product manager, growth product manager, or in a role with clear ownership of product-led growth outcomes.

  • Strong analytical capability and experience with experimentation frameworks and A/B testing tools.

  • Hands-on experience with tracking and attribution setups, such as Amplitude, GA4, GTM, server-side tagging or conversion feedback into ad platforms.

  • Able to act as the product voice on modelling work – challenging assumptions and turning model output into decisions, without building the models yourself.

  • Strong capability using AI tools, including structured prompting and iterative AI interaction to problem solve and increase productivity.

Bonus:

  • Experience in fintech, lending, B2B SaaS, or regulated products.

  • Experience working with data science teams or involvement in modelling projects.

  • Fluency in German and strong written communication skills tailored to customer-facing environments.

  • Knowledge of the German SME ecosystem or B2B financial products.

  • Experience working in or helping build newly formed teams.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 - £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Compensation: £60K – £80K

title: Head of Enterprise Product
descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to lead n8n’s enterprise product strategy and build scalable monetisation infrastructure, turning complex enterprise needs into innovative, reusable capabilities while preserving the simplicity, flexibility, and product-led experience that make n8n successful.


To make this happen, you'll take ownership of four key areas:

Shape our enterprise product vision and strategy

  • Define and drive our enterprise product vision, translating the needs of builders, admins, and buyers across governance, security, compliance, scale, and reliability into reusable product capabilities.

  • Identify new opportunities, make thoughtful product bets, and decide which customer requests to prioritise, decline, or transform into broader solutions rather than reacting to individual deals.

  • Champion exceptional product craft, usability, and quality, balancing innovation with enterprise readiness and measuring success through adoption, time-to-value, retention, and expansion.

Own and scale our monetisation infrastructure

  • Set the product strategy, priorities, and roadmap for monetisation infrastructure, enabling evolving commercial models without creating unnecessary complexity, exceptions, or workarounds.

  • Partner with Growth, Finance, Sales, and self-serve product teams to inform pricing, packaging, and tiering decisions while maintaining clear ownership of product priorities and outcomes.

  • Make strategic trade-offs between new commercial capabilities, foundational investments, and simplification, ensuring reliable, scalable infrastructure with clear dependencies and realistic delivery commitments.

Build a high-performing product function and drive technical alignment

  • Shape and lead the enterprise Product Management function, owning team structure, hiring, performance, and career development while empowering PMs to make strong, autonomous decisions.

  • Partner closely with Engineering leadership to build ambitious yet achievable roadmaps, making informed decisions about scope, sequencing, architectural constraints, and technical dependencies.

  • Balance new product capabilities with technical debt, platform investment, and reliability, establishing clear ownership, effective prioritisation, and strong collaboration between Product and Engineering.

Be the strategic product partner to customers and commercial teams

  • Build deep knowledge of our enterprise customers, personally leading senior-level roadmap conversations, understanding their evolving needs, and navigating complex product escalations.

  • Act as a trusted product counterpart to Sales, Customer Success, Legal/Security, and partners, translating customer and commercial insights into strategic product decisions.

  • Set clear expectations with commercial teams and customers, confidently challenging account-specific requests when needed and ensuring long-term product value drives prioritisation.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Enterprise product strategy: You have a proven track record of turning complex enterprise customer needs into scalable product capabilities, with the judgement to prioritise meaningful opportunities and confidently say no when necessary.

  • Product-led mindset: You understand how to meet sophisticated enterprise requirements without compromising the broader product experience, and you maintain a high bar for usability, simplicity, and product craft.

  • Monetisation expertise: You have led monetisation infrastructure initiatives or bring a strong understanding of the systems, technical dependencies, and commercial trade-offs required to support scalable business models.

  • Commercial fluency: You have navigated pricing, packaging, renewals, or enterprise deal considerations and know how to balance commercial opportunities with sustainable product strategy.

  • Technical credibility: You can confidently partner with Engineering leaders to evaluate architecture constraints, make informed prioritisation decisions, and balance innovation with scalability, reliability, and technical investment.

  • Product leadership: You have built or led high-performing Product Management teams, developed PMs, and established clear ownership and decision-making practices that enable teams to operate autonomously

  • Executive customer engagement: You're comfortable engaging directly with senior enterprise customers, leading strategic roadmap conversations, managing escalations, and translating customer insights into actionable product priorities.

  • Entrepreneurial judgement: You proactively identify opportunities, challenge assumptions, and take considered bets rather than relying on established playbooks or reacting to the loudest customer requests.

Nice-to-haves

  • Developer tools experience: You have worked on products for technical users, developer platforms, or within open-source ecosystems.

  • Product-led and enterprise experience: You have helped scale a product-led business with a meaningful enterprise sales motion and understand how to make both models successful.

  • Enterprise infrastructure expertise: You have experience with monetization systems, enterprise governance capabilities, or similar infrastructure supporting complex customer and commercial needs.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of one of our most strategically important product areas, where we're seeing some of our strongest product-market fit. You'll shape our enterprise product vision, influence company-wide product decisions, and build a high-performing PM function with the autonomy and ownership to scale alongside our ambitions.

You'll operate at a particularly exciting intersection: bringing enterprise-grade governance, security, and reliability to a developer-loved automation platform without losing what makes it special. From deciding which opportunities deserve investment to shaping the infrastructure behind our commercial growth, your decisions will have a direct and measurable impact on how customers adopt, deploy, and expand with n8n.

As part of one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, you'll work closely with Product, Engineering, and commercial leadership in a collaborative, remote-first environment that values ownership, experimentation, and continuous learning.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

title: Head of Operations NRW (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur drittgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Du bekommst die Schlüssel zu sechs Unternehmen in NRW. Du führst ihre Standortleitungen, verantwortest die wirtschaftlichen Ergebnisse und baust daraus eine Region, die perspektivisch 30 Unternehmen tragen kann. Deine Entscheidungen bestimmen, wer führt, was sich verändert und wie profitabel die Unternehmen wachsen.

Du bist nah genug am Geschäft, um selbst zu sehen, wo es hakt. Und du hast die Verantwortung, etwas daraus zu machen. Du holst Führungskräfte an Bord, entwickelst Talente und setzt Veränderungen durch, deren Wirkung du in den Teams und in den Zahlen erkennst.

Mit jedem Zukauf wächst die Aufgabe. Du entwickelst Menschen, die selbst Unternehmen führen können, und schaffst die Struktur für den nächsten Wachstumsschritt. Was du in NRW aufbaust, kann zum Vorbild für weitere Regionen werden.

Du arbeitest direkt mit Jan (COO) und unserem Führungsteam zusammen. Bei dir laufen Menschen, Technologie und Unternehmertum zusammen. Du übernimmst einen wesentlichen Teil von Buena und gestaltest, wie groß er werden kann.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du verantwortest Umsatz, Kosten, Kapazität und Profitabilität deiner Region. Du verstehst BWA und GuV und setzt dort an, wo deine Entscheidungen den größten Unterschied machen.

title: Head of Research & Editorial
descriptionHtml:
About Firstwork

Labour markets are broken. Millions of people are ready to work and can't start. Screening, right-to-work checks, contracts, onboarding and scheduling still run across disconnected systems, with hundreds of manual decisions in between. Firstwork builds AI agents that run frontline workforce operations end to end. We activate hundreds of thousands of workers a month globally for some of the world's largest employers and staffing firms, working forward-deployed inside the customer's operation. Backed by Y Combinator and Gradient (Google’s AI fund), with offices in New York, and London and Dubai opening this year.

Why this role

Frontline labour markets are badly measured. Governments publish unemployment and vacancy statistics. Nobody publishes a credible number for how long it takes to get a qualified person from application to first shift, what that delay costs, or how much of it is regulatory rather than operational.

We see activation at scale, across sectors and jurisdictions, so we can measure what nobody else can. Publishing it sets the terms of the debate, gives policymakers something real to work with, and gives our commercial teams something better than a pitch deck. The standard we are aiming at is work a member of government or tier one investor forwards along to their colleagues.

What you'll do

  • Set the research agenda

  • Write and publish flagship reports and white papers

  • Own editorial standards across everything Firstwork publishes

  • Build data stories with our data and engineering teams

  • Lead policy engagement on European labour and employment regulation

  • Produce the CEO's long-form writing and speaking material

  • Build partnerships with academics, institutions and industry bodies

  • Manage a Content Producer who turns the research into video, graphics, podcasts and report design

What we're looking for

  • Seven or more years in research, journalism, think tanks, policy, or a strategy function producing original published work

  • A portfolio with at least one piece that changed how someone thought about a subject

  • Quantitative comfort. You can interrogate a dataset and recognise when it won't support the claim you want to make

  • Real interest in labour markets, migration, regulation or the economics of work

  • The spine to hold a line on accuracy when there is commercial pressure not to

  • Editorial judgement. You can commission, edit and improve other people's work

  • Use of AI across the research process, on the understanding that it raises the verification bar rather than lowering it

This is a rare opportunity for a serious writer and content creator to help shape the future of work at a high-growth, well-funded company with strong opinions about what the world should look like in the age of AI. If the idea of running a research desk on a dataset nobody else has access to excites you, send us your best work.

Firstwork is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status.

title: Head of Strategy and Product
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

title: Head of Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Head of Transformation

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £130k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our customers are some of the world's largest companies, and every partnership depends on Deducta delivering the measurable outcomes we've committed to. This role owns that delivery, from sales handover through implementation, adoption and ongoing value. You'll report to the leadership team.

You'll work directly with senior leaders at our customers, own our most important relationships, and build and lead the customer team as we scale. You'll have the autonomy to shape how Deducta delivers, and to make that model repeatable without losing quality.

What you'll do

  • Customer delivery: Own delivery end to end, from sales handover through implementation, adoption, value realisation and ongoing partnership.

  • Enterprise programmes: Translate customer objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners and dependencies, and keep complex programmes moving.

  • Senior relationships: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders from day-to-day programme leads through CPOs, CFOs and other executives.

  • Data and platform: Work directly with customer data and the Deducta platform, understanding each customer's business so our work produces meaningful insights and outcomes.

  • Implementation and adoption: Identify blockers early, coordinate the right resources across product and engineering, and make sure customer learnings shape how we improve the product.

  • Team and operating model: Build, manage and grow the customer team and delivery model as the company scales.

Success in this role means:

  • Trusted partner: Customers see Deducta as a partner that consistently delivers against its commitments.

  • Predictable implementations: Implementations move quickly, with risks and blockers surfaced early rather than through firefighting.

  • Visible value: Customers adopt the platform, can articulate the value Deducta creates, and keep deepening how they use it.

  • Scalable delivery: Our delivery model becomes more repeatable and scalable without sacrificing the quality of the customer experience.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency operator with roughly three to four years in MBB or top-tier management consulting, experience managing complex workstreams and confidence in front of senior clients. You should be as comfortable in the data as you are presenting to an executive. A background in procurement or enterprise software isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Client leadership: You build credibility quickly, manage demanding stakeholders and become a trusted partner to senior executives.

  • Programme leadership: You turn an ambitious objective into a structured plan and create accountability across stakeholders you don't control.

  • Analytical depth: You get into the data yourself, identify what matters and synthesise complex information into clear conclusions.

  • Problem solving: You diagnose why something isn't working, separate symptoms from underlying problems, and drive the team to a practical solution.

  • Executive communication: You take complex, messy work and communicate the answer clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • People leadership: You have managed others, or can build and lead a high-performing customer team.

  • Nice to have: Experience in enterprise software, data, analytics, AI, procurement, complex technology implementations, or a high-growth environment.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call

  2. Background interview

  3. Technical exercise

  4. Final interview

  5. Offer, referencing and start

Help the world's biggest businesses finally see themselves clearly.

Compensation: £130K • Offers Equity

title: Healthcare & Life Sciences Principal, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

As Principal, Business Development for Healthcare & Life Sciences in EMEA, you will be a strategic partner to regional Sales and Sales Engineering leadership. You will help define where and how Everpure wins in European healthcare and life sciences, then translate that strategy into field execution, organizational capability, customer engagement, partner motions, pipeline, and bookings.

You will lead the development of a multi-year EMEA HLS growth strategy across providers, payers, and life sciences. This includes identifying the most important market opportunities, shaping vertical and horizontal plays, and aligning Sales, SE, Marketing, Alliances, Product, and executive leadership around measurable outcomes.

This is a builder and operator role. You will personally advance the highest-priority customer and partner opportunities while also strengthening the people, coverage, operating rhythms, enablement, and ecosystem required to scale HLS growth beyond individual deals.

You will connect critical healthcare and life sciences priorities—including AI adoption, data modernization, clinical and research workloads, cyber resilience, cloud, and sovereign infrastructure—to differentiated business outcomes for customers. You will build executive credibility with customers and partners and help Everpure become the data platform of choice for European healthcare and life sciences.

What You’ll Do

Shape and execute the EMEA HLS growth strategy

  • Develop and maintain the regional HLS strategy, including priority countries, subsegments, accounts, routes to market, investment choices, and growth assumptions.

  • Translate market insight, customer priorities, regulatory requirements, and competitive dynamics into clear field plays and measurable business plans.

  • Balance growth across providers, payers, and life sciences while identifying the vertical and horizontal opportunities most likely to create repeatable regional growth.

  • Establish the operating cadence, metrics, and inspection rhythm required to track progress, address gaps, and adjust priorities.

Partner with Sales and Sales Engineering leadership

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to EMEA Sales and SE leaders on HLS priorities, executive engagement, technical focus areas, and resource allocation.

  • Align country sales, specialist SE, partner, marketing, and corporate teams around the highest-value strategic plays and initiatives.

  • Help leaders make explicit trade-offs about where to invest, where to stop, and how to scale what is working.

  • Turn strategy into practical technical plays, enablement, executive programs, and field actions that improve execution.

Own critical vertical and horizontal business development

  • Lead the most important HLS opportunities and strategic initiatives across Europe, from executive discovery through partner alignment, solution development, and commercial execution.

  • Connect HLS business problems to horizontal priorities such as AI, data platforms, cloud, cyber resilience, and sovereign infrastructure.

  • Create repeatable plays for workloads such as EHR, enterprise imaging, genomics, clinical AI, research, and regulated data environments.

  • Build and expand executive relationships with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to create pipeline, bookings, and referenceable outcomes.

Build the organization and operating model

  • Identify the talent, capability, and partner gaps that constrain HLS growth in EMEA.

  • Develop field capability through coaching, enablement, playbooks, communities of practice, and repeatable operating mechanisms.

  • Strengthen collaboration between country teams, specialist resources, Sales Engineering, Alliances, Marketing, Product, and executive leadership.

  • Build systems and relationships that continue to produce results beyond your direct involvement.

Develop and execute partner strategies

  • Design and operationalize joint go-to-market motions with strategic ISVs, hyperscalers, GSIs, resellers, and technology partners.

  • Define mutual objectives, roles, investments, target accounts, pipeline actions, and measures of success for priority partnerships.

  • Convert partner relationships into customer opportunities, closed business, technical validation, and referenceable outcomes.

  • Equip partner and field teams with the messaging, technical context, enablement, and commercial plays required to execute.

Represent Everpure in the market

  • Act as a senior voice for Everpure’s HLS strategy in customer meetings, executive briefings, industry events, analyst discussions, and partner forums.

  • Shape the market narrative around intelligent data foundations, healthcare AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign data platforms.

  • Bring customer and market insight back into regional and corporate strategy, product priorities, and field execution.

What Success Looks Like

In this role, success means you have:

  • Established a clear EMEA HLS growth strategy with explicit priorities, trade-offs, investments, and measurable commercial outcomes.

  • Built trusted, productive partnerships with Sales and SE leaders across multiple European markets.

  • Improved the organization’s HLS capability through stronger talent, enablement, operating discipline, and partner capacity.

  • Created repeatable vertical and horizontal plays that generate pipeline, bookings, and customer references.

  • Personally advanced strategic customer and partner opportunities to measurable business results.

  • Expanded Everpure’s relevance across providers, payers, and life sciences through credible technical and executive engagement.

What You Bring

HLS and regional market expertise

  • Significant experience in healthcare and life sciences technology, with credibility across more than one HLS subsegment and a strong understanding of European market dynamics.

  • A working knowledge of healthcare regulation, data sovereignty, procurement, compliance, and the operating differences across European countries.

  • The ability to translate customer and market insight into a focused regional strategy and practical field execution.

Commercial and business-development ownership

  • A track record of owning or materially driving bookings, pipeline, customer growth, or business performance with specific, recent examples.

  • Experience leading complex customer opportunities and converting strategic relationships into measurable commercial outcomes.

  • The judgment to distinguish between activity, influence, pipeline creation, and closed business.

Technical and solution fluency

  • Credibility discussing production data and AI platforms, including architecture, workload characteristics, scale, deployment models, security, and sovereignty.

  • Sufficient depth across relevant healthcare workloads—such as EHR, imaging, genomics, clinical AI, research, or regulated data—to engage customers, SE leaders, and partners in substantive conversations.

  • The ability to connect technical choices to customer outcomes, business value, and a compelling route to adoption.

Leadership partnership and organization development

  • Demonstrated success influencing senior Sales, SE, partner, and executive leaders without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience building capability that scales beyond your individual contribution, such as talent, enablement, governance, partner ecosystems, or operating mechanisms.

  • A collaborative, direct, and outcome-oriented leadership style suited to a multi-country, cross-functional EMEA environment.

Alliance and ecosystem execution

  • Experience creating and executing joint go-to-market strategies with strategic partners, with clear mutual commitments and measurable results.

  • The ability to work across ISVs, hyperscalers, GSIs, resellers, and technology partners depending on the customer problem and route to market.

  • Strong executive communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

Location and Travel

We operate in a hybrid and field-based model. You will be expected to work effectively from a regional corporate office or key EMEA market and travel approximately 25–40% across the region as business needs require.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!

title: Influencer & Branded Content Senior Associate
descriptionHtml:
We are PMG

PMG, a global independent platform company engineered for impact, integrates business strategy, media, creative, and data within a single operating model powered by our proprietary operating system, Alli. With more than 1,000 employees, PMG partners with brands including Apple, Nike, Dropbox, Experian, Sephora, and Whole Foods. Our work has earned top industry honors, including Cannes Lions and Adweek’s Media Plan of the Year, and PMG has won 40+ workplace culture awards, including being the only company to rank among Ad Age’s Best Places to Work for 11 consecutive years.

Who You’ll Be Working With

At PMG, our Influencer & Branded Content team is at the intersection of culture, storytelling, and strategy, helping brands connect with audiences in authentic, meaningful ways. We craft high-impact influencer campaigns that go beyond traditional advertising, driving engagement, building brand affinity, and delivering measurable results across social, digital, and experiential platforms.

You’ll collaborate with creators, talent agencies, media strategists, content teams, and brand partners to develop and execute influencer marketing programs that seamlessly align storytelling with business objectives. A key focus will be scaling PMG’s influencer and creator marketing discipline—establishing frameworks, curating talent relationships, and setting standards for authenticity and effectiveness in alignment with brand goals. Your role will be instrumental in shaping how brands foster meaningful connections with their audiences.

You will also play a key role in exploring new content formats, leveraging emerging platforms, and staying ahead of industry trends to ensure creator strategies are not only relevant but also innovative and impactful. At PMG, we don’t just follow trends—we create them.

If you’re passionate about shaping culture through creator-driven storytelling, using data to drive real impact, and redefining what’s possible in influencer marketing, this is the place to make your mark.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the identification and selection of influencers that align with our clients' target audiences and campaign objectives.
  • Collaborate with the Lead to develop and execute comprehensive influencer campaigns, ensuring seamless coordination between influencers, internal teams, and clients.
  • Oversee the creation and delivery of branded content, including overseeing the adherence to brand guidelines and coordinating with influencers and internal teams to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Support the Senior Overseer in analyzing campaign performance, extracting key insights, and providing strategic recommendations for future campaigns.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends, emerging platforms, and best practices in influencer marketing, and share relevant insights with the team.
  • Support mentoring and guiding Associate-level team members, providing support and sharing knowledge to help them grow in their roles.
  • The primary focus of this role is the Influencer & Branded Content channel, ensuring excellence in strategy, execution, and performance. However, responsibilities may extend across other media channels as needed to support broader campaign objectives and business priorities

What You Will Bring

  • Experience in Influencer & Branded Content, with a bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Expertise in content creation and influencer marketing strategy, driving impactful partnerships and innovative campaigns.
  • Experience in contract review and proposal development, ensuring smooth negotiations and long-term influencer collaborations.
  • Advanced detail orientation, overseeing accurate execution, reporting, and strategic alignment in influencer initiatives.
  • Strong proficiency in project implementation, managing high-level influencer campaigns from concept to completion.
  • Skilled in presentation and communication, delivering insights, strategic recommendations, and campaign performance analysis.
  • Deep understanding of advertising standards, client service, and relationship management, fostering high-quality influencer-brand partnerships.
  • Proficiency in influencer management dashboards and social media platforms, leveraging analytics to optimize campaign performance.
  • Experience in networking and influencer marketing, building meaningful industry relationships to enhance campaign reach and effectiveness.
  • A commitment to curiosity and adaptability as a Continual Learner, staying at the forefront of media innovation while prioritizing client success with a Customer-Focused mindset that seeks opportunities to deliver meaningful value.
  • A dedication to People-Focused leadership, fostering collaboration, innovation, and professional growth by leading by example and nurturing strong relationships that empower others to excel.

What We Offer

Performance-Based Rewards: Your impact should be part of your reward. This role is eligible for PMG’s annual bonus program—a standout part of our total compensation offering and an opportunity to share in our success. Bonus awards are informed by individual impact and performance, as well as team and company results, and are subject to applicable program terms.

Professional Development: Keep growing through learning and development programs, mentorship opportunities, and support for career advancement.

Generous Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge, connect with loved ones, and enjoy life outside work.

Parental Leave: Receive paid parental leave during life’s important family moments.

Retirement Benefits: Build for your future with competitive retirement benefits, including employer contributions or matching where applicable.

Fertility and Family Support: Access fertility and family-building benefits for eligible employees and their spouses or partners.

Healthcare: Choose from medical, dental, and vision coverage designed to support you and your family.

Pet Insurance: Access optional coverage for the four-legged members of your family.

Lifestyle Spending Account: Receive company-funded support for eligible health and well-being expenses.

Commuter Benefits: Access support for your commute where available.

Volunteering Opportunities: Receive eight paid hours each year to give back to your community.

AI Tools and Training: Access enterprise AI tools and ongoing training that helps PMGers use AI effectively, creatively, and responsibly.

Our benefits and compensation programs may vary by location and eligibility and are subject to applicable plan terms. We’ll share full details during the hiring process.

What Sets Us Apart

Being part of PMG means joining a company culture that’s unmatched in digital. We're dedicated to working hard to serve our employees and clients, delivering value, results, and innovation—which often requires true grit and agility. We believe in taking care of ourselves and each other to continuously improve in every way.

In alignment with our core values to be inclusive and always change for the better, PMG is committed to creating a more diverse and inclusive culture, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that we only change for the better by bringing diverse perspectives to our company. PMG recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

descriptionHtml:

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles.

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous

Dans le cadre du projet MACMIA de massification des compétences et métiers de l’IA, vous contribuerez au développement de plateformes pédagogiques impliquant un ensemble de ressources logiciels en interaction avec des objets physiques dont des robots programmables. La principale plateforme de ce type, MaqIT, est géré et maintenu par l’Institut Henri Fayol en mettant en relation des ingénieurs et des enseignants-chercheurs qui utilisent la plateforme pour des travaux pratiques en Intelligence artificielle.

Ce recrutement doit servir à soutenir les activités de formations proposées dans le cadre du projet MACMIA, qui est une réponse à l’appel à manifestation d’intérêt France 2030 sur les compétences et métiers d’avenir en IA, et qui impliquent 7 établissements d’enseignement supérieur, 3 campus des métiers et qualification, 2 pôles de compétitivité, 7 entreprises, 1 opérateur de compétence ainsi que France Travail.

Sous la direction du responsable du département Informatique et systèmes intelligents (ISI), vous assurerez un ensemble de missions d’ingénierie. Plus précisément, les objectifs sont :

  • Participer à l’amélioration de la plateforme MaqIT : développer des interfaces interactives facilitant l’utilisation des composants connectés de la plateforme (robots mobiles, bras robotiques, convoyeurs, capteurs et actionneurs divers)

  • Maintenir les logiciels pour l’exploitation des composants connectés (mises à niveau et tests)

  • Intégrer les nouveaux composants connectés et assurer leur fonctionnement avec le reste du matériel, notamment en déployant des interfaces interactives pour faciliter leur utilisation

  • Aider à la conception de contenu pédagogique en lien avec les plateformes et les logiciels développés (pour les travaux pratiques sur l’interaction avec l’humain et le monde réel ou les graphes de connaissances et le raisonnement)

  • Définir des scénarios pédagogiques exploitant la plateforme MaqIT (fil rouge dans le cadre du Défi Intelligence Artificielle du cycle Ingénieur civil des mines).

Pour ce projet, vous serez amené à dialoguer avec les ingénieurs du pôle ingénierie de l’Institut Henri Fayol et avec des enseignants-chercheurs.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de Master (Bac+5) ou équivalent et possédez :

• Une expérience confirmée en conception logicielle

• Une bonne maîtrise de la programmation (notamment Python, C++ ou Java)

• Connaissances dans les technologies de l’IA

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

• Connaissances de l’environnement ROS (Robot Operating System)

• Conception d’interfaces utilisateurs et UX Design

• Pratique des outils d’apprentissage automatique

• Ingénierie de connaissances

• Collaboration passée avec des enseignants-chercheurs

• Intérêt pour la pédagogie et éventuellement, une expérience en enseignement

• Rigueur, travail en équipe, autonomie, proactivité

title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
descriptionHtml:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications.

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives.

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts.

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment.

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks.

What You Will Do 

  • Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay.

  • Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa.

  • Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC).

  • Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation.

  • Support EDI workstreams within global ERP initiatives and local rollouts across business units, maintaining consistency with global integration templates.

  • Monitor daily EDI transactions, prioritise critical issues and resolve integration or transmission failures to help prevent supply chain disruptions.

  • Analyse performance across EDI networks and clearing centres, identify recurring errors and bottlenecks, and coordinate configuration adjustments and testing with external providers.

  • Maintain standard messages and application interfaces in line with relevant industry standards and data compliance requirements.

  • Collaborate with internal IT teams, business stakeholders and external providers to deliver and support integrations involving both Infor and other applications.

What We Expect of You 

Essential Skills & Experience 

  • Strong familiarity with the document sequences supporting core supply chain processes such as Order to Cash (O2C) , Logistics and Source to Pay (S2P), including orders, invoices and shipping notices.

  • Extensive hands-on experience in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), B2B integration frameworks and complex data mapping environments.

  • Strong technical proficiency in EDI mapping tools, XML schemas and data transformation languages.

  • Good awareness of global B2B messaging standards, such as EDIFACT, and electronic communication protocols.

  • Proven ability to read and analyse Java code in Eclipse IDE to debug custom mapping extensions and data routing rules.

  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills, with the ability to translate business and trading partner requirements into clear mapping and interface specifications.

  • Ability to work effectively in a complex, collaborative matrix environment with virtual teams in a multi-cultural and geographically diverse setting.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, including root-cause analysis of data payload errors and transmission failures, with sound judgement in challenging situations.

  • A strong command of spoken and written English is required, and knowledge of German is considered a plus.

Valuable Experience 

  • Practical knowledge of Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC), Infor ION Framework and Infor OS, including their integration with Infor M3 and the routing of EDI documents into core applications.

  • Familiarity with Mapping Manager and Business Document Mapper within the Infor integration environment.

  • Onboarding customers, suppliers and 3 PLs via EDI.

Important: Applicants must have the legal right to work in Germany. Please note that visa or work-permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

About Intersnack IT: 

Intersnack IT KG is a member of the Pfeifer & Langen Industrie- und Handels-KG’s group of companies and a sister company to Intersnack Group. Established from the international harmonization and centralization of Intersnack Group’s IT estate, we are responsible for all group-wide IT services for and within Intersnack Group. Our goal is to provide a common IT infrastructure, aligned IT services, and business solutions according to Intersnack’s requirements. Based on a solid digital foundation, Intersnack IT KG acts as a partner to all Intersnack functions, actively contributing to Intersnack’s business strategy. Explore exciting career opportunities and learn more by visiting our website at Intersnack IT KG. 

About Intersnack Group: 

Intersnack has become one of Europe’s leading savory snacks producers by ‘creating happy snacking moments’ in people’s lives. Being privately owned, we operate with a long-term view and commit ourselves to a more sustainable world. Successfully and sustainably growing, our turnover in 2024 was more than €4.5 bn. We are now present in more than 30 countries across Europe and beyond. We have 12 regional Management Units, 45 production sites, and a total workforce of approximately 15,000 people worldwide. For further company insights, please visit the following link: Intersnack Group Overview 

If you want to be part of our dynamic food industry success story, you’ll find all sorts of opportunities at Intersnack. Join our team, help us grow, and celebrate our successes together!

title: Internship - Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

about the role

This is the perfect role for someone early in their career (e.g. recent grad) who wants to get deep exposure to how startups operate, work directly with customers, and help scale AI products in the real world.

As a Success Strategist Intern, you'll work closely with the founders across both onboarding/agent development and customer success, supporting our team in making customers successful with telli.

You'll help onboard new customers, develop AI agents, support existing accounts, and build the processes that help us scale.

What You'll Do

Customer Ownership & Operations

  • Support pilot accounts and help customers get live with AI agents

  • Assist with customer communications, answer questions, and resolve basic issues

  • Help track agent performance and customer health metrics

  • Support customer workshops and training sessions

Agent Development

  • Help build and refine AI agents alongside the team

  • Support workflow creation for onboarding and pilot management

  • Work with automation tools (n8n, Zapier) to improve internal efficiency

  • Document best practices and playbooks

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Help translate customer feedback into insights for product and engineering teams

  • Support operational tasks that help telli scale

  • Prepare materials for customer and team meetings

  • Jump in wherever needed to move projects forward

what makes you a great fit

  • You really enjoy working with customers and help them succeed

  • You're tech-savvy (or have a semi-technical background)

  • You're an excellent communicator in both English and German - especially writing

  • You've experimented with AI agents or workflows and understand topics like prompt engineering

  • You're organized, hands-on, and not afraid of unglamorous work

  • You're early in your career and hungry to learn fast

you may not be a good fit if…

  • You have a pure business background but never worked with workflows or AI agents

  • You only like 'strategic' work

  • You want to work 9-5 or remotely

Compensation: €3K – €5K per month

title: ISMS Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
In dieser Position als ISMS Manager (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung für die Informationssicherheit und gestalten die Weiterentwicklung des unternehmensweiten Sicherheitsmanagements. Sie begleiten die ISO-27001-Zertifizierung, bewerten Risiken und beraten die Geschäftsleitung bei strategischen und operativen Fragestellungen. Dabei verbinden Sie konzeptionelle Arbeit mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität und sorgen dafür, dass Sicherheitsanforderungen im Arbeitsalltag wirksam umgesetzt werden.

Sie kennen jemanden, der perfekt zu dieser Position passt? Dann sichern Sie sich jetzt unseren Weiterempfehlungsbonus! Bitte bewerben Sie sich über den Bewerben-Button auf dieser Seite.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Sie verantworten den laufenden Betrieb des ISMS, identifizieren Optimierungspotenziale und entwickeln bestehende Sicherheitsprozesse kontinuierlich weiter

  • Bei komplexen IT- und Sicherheitsthemen analysieren Sie technische Zusammenhänge, bewerten potenzielle Bedrohungen und leiten geeignete Schutzmaßnahmen ab

  • Mit Ihrer Expertise in ISO 27001 und BSI-Grundschutz gestalten Sie Sicherheitsrichtlinien, überprüfen deren Umsetzung und stellen die Einhaltung relevanter Vorgaben sicher

  • Sie planen interne Audits, koordinieren notwendige Maßnahmen zur Zertifizierung und begleiten die Vorbereitung auf externe Prüfungen

  • Als zentrale Ansprechperson beraten Sie die Geschäftsleitung, IT-Fachbereiche und externe Dienstleister zu Informationssicherheit, Risikomanagement und Compliance

  • Sie entwickeln Notfallkonzepte weiter, organisieren regelmäßige Übungen und überprüfen die Wirksamkeit bestehender Wiederherstellungs- und Reaktionsprozesse

Ihr Profil

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Informationssicherheit, beispielsweise als Information Security Manager, Informationssicherheitsbeauftragter oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion, bildet Ihre fachliche Grundlage

  • Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit IT-Bezug oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation; auch ein kaufmännischer Hintergrund mit fundierter IT-Erfahrung ist denkbar

  • Ihre Kenntnisse in ISO 27001, BSI-Grundschutz und IT-Governance ermöglichen Ihnen, Sicherheitsanforderungen strukturiert zu bewerten und in die Praxis zu übertragen

  • Mit Ihrem technischen Verständnis für IT-Infrastrukturen, Cloud-Umgebungen und aktuelle Bedrohungsszenarien erkennen Sie Risiken frühzeitig und entwickeln angemessene Lösungsansätze

title: IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)

Krumbach-Niederraunau, Bayern · Hybrid · Vollzeit, unbefristet

Über Everfield

Everfield übernimmt, entwickelt und skaliert europäische Softwareunternehmen aus vertikalen Märkten und Spezialnischen und gibt ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um den nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Unsere Mission: Ambitionen fördern, Wachstum vorantreiben und Chancen für Europas Software-Ökosystem eröffnen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem arbeiten dezentral: Sie behalten ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte und konzentrieren sich auf das, was sie am besten können – Produkte entwickeln und Kunden betreuen. Everfield unterstützt mit Talent Acquisition, HR und einem Expertenteam, das zu Finanz- und Operations-Themen berät. Seit der Gründung 2022 ist Everfield in neun Ländern vertreten, Tendenz steigend.

Über SoCom

Die SoCom Informationssysteme GmbH entwickelt mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden TIKOS, die führende ERP-Lösung für gewerbliche Wäschereien und Textildienstleister. Mit rund 40 % Marktanteil in der DACH-Region und über 30 Jahren Erfahrung steuern Kunden mit TIKOS ihre gesamte Prozesskette, von der Wäscheannahme über RFID-Tracking bis zur Auslieferung. Seit Oktober 2026 gehört auch die Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH zur SoCom-Familie. SoCom ist Teil des Everfield-Ökosystems.

Über die Rolle

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte IT: die interne Infrastruktur, die Informationssicherheit und die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für unsere Kunden betreiben. Viele dieser Leistungen haben wir bisher extern eingekauft. Jetzt holen wir das Know-how ins Haus – und du stellst die IT so auf, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum, der Integration neuer Unternehmensteile und steigenden regulatorischen Anforderungen Schritt hält.

Du bist Gestalter:in und Macher:in zugleich: Du entwickelst die IT-Strategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an.

Deine Aufgaben

• IT-Verantwortung und Strategie: Du verantwortest die IT von SoCom ganzheitlich, entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Roadmap und steuerst das IT-Budget für Hardware, Lizenzen, Cloud und Dienstleister.

• Insourcing und Dienstleistersteuerung: Du überführst bisher extern erbrachte Leistungen – Netzwerk, Firewall, Server, Backup und E-Mail-Security – schrittweise in die eigene Verantwortung. Verbleibende Dienstleister und Verträge steuerst du über klare SLAs.

• Cloud und Hosting: Du betreibst die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für Kunden hosten, und entwickelst sie weiter. Gemeinsam mit Vertrieb und Support kalkulierst du Hosting-Angebote, verantwortest Verfügbarkeit, Kapazität und Kosten und treibst eine zukunftsfähige Hosting-Architektur voran.

• Infrastruktur und Betrieb: Du verantwortest Server, Netzwerk, Firewall, Backup und Disaster Recovery – am Standort und in der Cloud – sowie Microsoft 365, Endgeräte, Telefonie und Mobilfunk. Monitoring und Patch-Management steuerst du über ein RMM-Tool.

• Informationssicherheit und Compliance: Als interne:r Owner für IT-Security koordinierst du das Schwachstellen- und Incident-Management, arbeitest eng mit dem CISO-Netzwerk von Everfield zusammen und setzt die Anforderungen aus NIS-2, Cyber Resilience Act und DSGVO in der Infrastruktur um.

• Integration Düchting: Du bringst die IT der Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH bis 2027 auf SoCom-Standard und konsolidierst Systeme, Lizenzen und Prozesse.

• Dokumentation und Wissenssicherung: Du baust eine belastbare IT-Dokumentation auf – Systeme, Zugänge, Kosten und Notfallpläne –, damit Wissen im Team geteilt und jederzeit verfügbar ist.

• Führung und Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer IT-Administration zusammen und bildest mit ihr ein Team mit gegenseitiger Vertretung. Für Support, R&D, DevOps und Vertrieb bist du die zentrale Ansprechperson für alle IT-Themen.

• KI und Digitalisierung: Du begleitest den sicheren Einsatz von KI-Tools im Unternehmen gemäß der KI-Richtlinie von Everfield und automatisierst interne IT-Prozesse.

Was du mitbringst

Muss

• Abgeschlossenes Studium (Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik o. Ä.) oder Ausbildung zur/zum Fachinformatiker:in mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der IT-Administration oder im IT-Management, davon mindestens 2 Jahre in verantwortlicher Rolle in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen (ca. 30–250 Mitarbeitende)

• Fundierte Praxis mit Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Netzwerken (VLAN, VPN) und Firewalls (z. B. Sophos, Fortinet)

• Erfahrung im Betrieb von Cloud- oder Hosting-Infrastruktur (IaaS, z. B. IONOS, Azure, AWS) inklusive Virtualisierung, Backup und Disaster Recovery

• Ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein und praktische Erfahrung im Schwachstellen- und Incident-Management

• Erfahrung in der Steuerung externer IT-Dienstleister sowie im Budget- und Lizenzmanagement

• Hands-on-Mentalität: Du übernimmst Verantwortung und löst Probleme selbst

• Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse für die Abstimmung im internationalen Everfield-Netzwerk

Kann

• Erfahrung im Hosting von Business-Software für externe Kunden (SLAs, Mandantentrennung)

• Kenntnisse in NIS-2, ISO 27001/BSI IT-Grundschutz oder dem Cyber Resilience Act

• Erfahrung mit SQL-Server-Datenbanken und Linux-Systemen

• Erfahrung mit RMM-Tools (z. B. NinjaOne, Datto RMM) und Automatisierung mit PowerShell

• Erfahrung mit IT-Integrationen nach Unternehmenszukäufen

• Kenntnisse im sicheren Einsatz von KI-Tools

Nicht jede:r erfüllt jeden Punkt. Wenn du die Muss-Kriterien weitgehend mitbringst und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, bewirb dich – wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen.

Bewerbungsprozess

• Erstgespräch (30 Min.) mit Karolina, Talent Acquisition Partner bei Everfield

• Fachinterview (60 Min.) mit Stefan Hoffmann, Geschäftsführer SoCom, und Everfield AI Lead

• Finales Gespräch vor Ort in Krumbach (90 Min.) mit Fallstudie (z. B. ein Insourcing-Plan für einen externen IT-Dienstleister) und Kennenlernen des Teams

Die Position ist hybrid mit regelmäßiger Präsenz an unserem Standort in Krumbach-Niederraunau
