descriptionHtml:
About Us

PAJ is a leading manufacturer, distributor, and consultant in the field of GPS tracking, headquartered in Windeck-Hurst. We offer GPS trackers for almost every application. PAJ is a highly dynamic and growing company with many creative and dedicated people, both within and outside of Germany. An open communication culture and great personalities are what make us who we are. If you love variety and challenges, then you belong with us!

Learn more at: https://www.paj-gps.com/careers/

What Makes Us Special

  • Dynamic & flat hierarchies: Short decision-making paths, fast decisions.
  • Family atmosphere: A warm, supportive team.
  • Active involvement: Your voice matters. Actively help shape our solutions
  • Varied tasks: An exciting workday with growing opportunities
  • Support for further development: Outstanding performance is rewarded with development opportunities
  • Flexible working: Hybrid – on-site when needed.
  • Job type: Full-time


About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on IT professional who uses AI as a core working tool. You will run and improve our IT infrastructure, support our employees, and solve complex technical problems faster and better by working with modern AI assistants and agents. You are as comfortable directing an AI agent through a configuration as you are plugging in cables on-site.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, set up, and maintain our network infrastructure across sites, including routers, switches, Wi-Fi, and firewalls (e.g. UniFi).
  • Design and manage resilient internet connectivity with multiple providers and automatic failover (e.g. satellite internet with a fixed-line or mobile backup).
  • Segment networks to separate different user groups and areas, such as office, guest, and residential networks.
  • Use AI to analyse complex existing setups and create clear graphical network plans and documentation as a basis for on-site work.
  • Configure systems with AI agents (including computer-use agents), supervising their work and verifying the results.
  • Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues systematically, test changes thoroughly, and track down remaining errors after rollout.
  • Provide first- and second-level IT support to employees, using AI to resolve issues faster and build reusable solutions.
  • Set up and manage computers, user accounts, and workplace IT equipment.
  • Identify and implement AI and automation solutions that make our IT and business processes more efficient.
  • Ensure IT security and compliance: review AI-generated configurations, protect access credentials, keep backups, and be able to roll back changes.


Your Profile

  • Strong, practical AI skills (required): you use AI assistants and agents daily for technical work, including documentation, analysis, and hands-on system configuration, and can show concrete examples of problems you solved with them.
  • Solid experience in network administration, IT administration, or IT support.
  • Good networking knowledge: IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, routing, VPN, multi-WAN and failover. Experience with UniFi, Starlink, or similar systems is a plus.
  • Ability to quickly understand complex, grown infrastructures and turn them into a clear overview.
  • Good knowledge of hardware, operating systems, and common business software.
  • A critical, security-conscious mindset: you know when to trust AI output, when to verify it, and how to undo a change safely.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and an independent, hands-on way of working, including on-site work at our locations.
  • Fluent in German and English, written and spoken.
  • Location: Our office is in Windeck, set in a beautiful area of the Sieg valley. As this is a hybrid role with regular on-site days, please consider your commute when applying: public transport connections are limited and train services can be unreliable, so the office is easiest to reach by car.

We specialize in the international trade of raw materials/ingredients (starches, sugars and plant proteins) for the food, animal feed and paper industries and operate in more than 100 countries. The company culture is relaxed when possible and businesslike when needed. In an open office environment, we aim for short and direct communication between all departments. We are looking for new talents with a no-nonsense mentality who want to actively contribute to the further growth of the company, with own initiative encouraged.

The role
As a Junior Business Data Analyst, you are the link between business and IT. You bring together processes and data to support decision-making. You help the organization to use data structurally, reliably and effectively. You look beyond data alone: you make processes clear, see opportunities for digitization and automation and use data to help departments. You become part of the IT & Data team and work with all departments, including Finance, Trade and Logistics. You translate data into concrete insights and actively contribute to the further professionalization of data-driven work within Royal Ingredients.

What will you do?

Data and insights

  • Analyze operational, commercial and financial data from various sources

  • Contribute to data governance, data quality and standardization of definitions and KPIs

  • Think along about further development of the data and analytics platform

  • Contribute to the development of AI tools to make data more accessible

Processes and digitization

  • Proactively gather questions and needs from departments, identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities and translate these into concrete recommendations

  • Map and analyze business processes and contribute to process architecture

  • Think about digitization and automation of processes

What do you bring?

  • A completed higher professional education or university degree, for example in Data Science, (Business) Informatics, Econometrics, Business Administration or a similar direction

  • Available for 24-32 hours per week

  • 0-3 years work experience

  • Initial experience with data or process improvement, for example via an internship, thesis project or first job

  • Basic knowledge of Power BI, knowledge of SQL, Python, ETL processes and modern data platforms (like Microsoft Fabric) is a plus

  • Affinity with business processes in a trading or international environment, interest in digitization and automation, and curiosity about how AI can improve your work and processes

  • Strong communication skills in Dutch and English, and ability to explain complex analyses clearly

  • A proactive, critical and structured work attitude and eagerness to develop yourself

Our offer

  • A market-conform salary matching your experience and profile;

  • Good pension scheme and bonus scheme;

  • Room for professional development and own initiative;

  • Hybrid working (including one fixed day working from home);

  • An informal and professional work atmosphere with involved colleagues;

title: Junior Gis/GEO Tester
descriptionHtml:
Je bent nieuwsgierig, werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het interessant om uit te zoeken hoe systemen en data werken. Je hebt oog voor detail en krijgt er energie van om te ontdekken waar iets beter of slimmer kan. Een combinatie van IT, testen en geografische informatie spreekt je aan. Dan is deze functie als Junior GIS/GEO Tester iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen als Junior GIS/GEO Tester?

Als Junior GIS/GEO Tester ga je aan de slag binnen een professioneel IT-team dat werkt met geografische informatie en GEO-applicaties. Je helpt mee om te zorgen dat applicaties, functionaliteiten en data goed werken voordat deze in gebruik worden genomen.

Je leert hoe je testgevallen opstelt, functionaliteiten controleert en resultaten analyseert. Je werkt daarbij met GIS/GEO-systemen en leert steeds meer over geografische data, applicaties en de technische omgeving daarachter.

Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden

  • Opstellen en uitvoeren van testgevallen voor GIS/GEO-applicaties

  • Controleren of nieuwe functionaliteiten werken zoals bedoeld

  • Testen van geografische data en controleren op juistheid en volledigheid

  • Analyseren en documenteren van testresultaten

  • Signaleren, reproduceren en vastleggen van fouten en afwijkingen

  • Meedenken over hoe applicaties en processen verbeterd kunnen worden

  • Samenwerken met ontwikkelaars, functioneel beheerders en andere IT-specialisten

  • Ondersteunen bij regressietesten en het testen van nieuwe releases

  • Werken met GIS/GEO-tools en je verder ontwikkelen in het vakgebied

Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. Juist tijdens het traineeship leer je hoe je gestructureerd test, hoe je fouten onderzoekt en hoe je steeds zelfstandiger wordt in het werken met GIS/GEO-systemen. Heb je al kennis van GIS, geografische data, softwaretesten of bijvoorbeeld SQL? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen.

Ook als je vooral een sterke interesse hebt in IT en GEO en graag wilt leren, komen we graag met je in contact.


Wat kun je verwachten van het traineeship?

Je start met een onboarding in Bunnik. Hier leer je samen met andere trainees de basis van IT en ontwikkel je vaardigheden die je direct kunt toepassen in je opdracht. Tijdens het tweejarige traineeship krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en je te verdiepen in GIS/GEO, testen en andere IT-onderwerpen die bij jou passen.

Je krijgt begeleiding van een People Manager die regelmatig met je meekijkt naar je ontwikkeling, leerdoelen en carrière. Daarnaast behaal je verschillende trainingen en erkende certificaten, zodat je niet alleen ervaring opdoet in de praktijk, maar ook werkt aan een stevig fundament voor je verdere IT-carrière.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een tweejarig IT-traineeship met veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling

  • Een startsalaris van €2.600 tot €2.800

  • Direct een vast contract

  • Jaarlijks een evaluatiemoment met de mogelijkheid om je salaris met maximaal €500 te verhogen

  • 25 vakantiedagen en vakantiegeld

  • Een passende reiskostenvergoeding

  • Verschillende trainingen en erkende IT-certificaten

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van een People Manager

  • Een jong en energiek team met regelmatig leuke activiteiten en borrels

Dit vragen wij van jou

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van IT, Geo-informatie, Geografie, GIS, Data, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Je hebt interesse in softwaretesten, GIS/GEO en IT

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het leuk om problemen uit te pluizen

  • Je bent analytisch en denkt graag in oplossingen

  • Je kunt goed samenwerken en je bevindingen duidelijk uitleggen

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig en staat open om nieuwe technieken en systemen te leren

  • Kennis van GIS, geografische data, SQL of softwaretesten is een pluspunt, maar geen vereiste

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed

  • Je bent bereid om minimaal 2 dagen per week in Assen te werken

Deze vacature is onderdeel van onze werving voor de traineeshipklas die in maart 2027 start. We komen graag nu al met je in contact. Je werkt minimaal 2 dagen per week vanuit de locatie in Assen.

title: (Junior) HR Business Partner (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Die steigenden Energiekosten treffen jeden Haushalt. Wir senken, was gerade am meisten wehtut.

Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich gerade Millionen Hausbesitzer stellen: Nicht ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird – sondern wie, und mit wem. Bei steigenden Energiekosten helfen wir Haushalten durch die Installation der richtigen Wärmepumpen und PV-Anlagen jährlich um die 1.500€ einzusparen.

Als Deutschlands führender Energieberater mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und über 90 Mitarbeitern sind wir erfahrene Pioniere in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.

Was Du mitbringen solltest.

Ich mach's mal ganz ehrlich: Wenn du Bock hast auf Start-up und ein People Department mitaufzubauen, du in andere People Bereiche perspektivisch reinwachsen willst und Drive und Eigeninitiative mitbringst, dann möchte ich dich unbedingt kennenlernen!

  • Du bist proaktiv, denkst selber mit und kommst mit neuen Ideen und Verbesserungsvorschlägen
  • Mind. 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Recruiting/HR/People & Culture in einem wettbewerbsintensiven, schnelllebigen Umfeld
  • Erste Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Fließendes Deutsch (unsere Unternehmenssprache), gutes Englisch von Vorteil

Warum Du Dich jetzt bewerben solltest.

Bei uns zählen Eigenverantwortung, Exzellenz und Energie. Wir denken in Ergebnissen und fordern uns gegenseitig heraus, um Deutschlands führende Kraft in der Umsetzung von energetischen Sanierungen zu werden. Wenn dich das abholt, melde dich.

  • Das Timing ist perfekt. Werde jetzt Teil von einem der schnellst wachsenden Energie-Startups Deutschlands - finanziert von Europas bekanntesten Venture Capitals
  • Arbeite gemeinsam mit ambitionierten Kollegen in einem Umfeld mit spürbarem Momentum
  • Unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und vielseitige Aufstiegschancen
  • Spreeblick statt Hinterhof: unser Büro liegt direkt am Wasser, mitten in Kreuzberg
  • Individuelles Benefit: Learning-Budget, Urban Sports Clubs, Jobticket- oder Kita-Zuschuss
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge für deine sichere Zukunft
  • Team-Events, die nicht langweilig werden

Unser Bewerbungsprozess.

Ich, Daniel (People Lead), bin Dein Ansprechpartner für diese Rolle.

So geht's weiter:

  1. 45 Minuten Erstgespräch mit mir, Daniel (virtuell) – innerhalb einer Woche nach Deiner Bewerbung
  2. 60 Minuten mit mir und Max (CEO) vor Ort bei uns im Büro in Kreuzberg

title: Junior Marketing and Communication Manager - IT (f/m/d*)
descriptionHtml:
Chi siamo

Nailscamp è un'azienda e-commerce innovativa specializzata nella cosmesi professionale per unghie. Con i nostri marchi principali, Ongle24 e Proglow, offriamo soluzioni di bellezza e smalti semipermanenti di alta qualità sia ai consumatori finali che ai professionisti. Ongle24 si è affermata come leader indiscusso del mercato in Francia e Belgio, e stiamo ora espandendo attivamente la nostra presenza in Italia. La nostra missione è semplice: offrire ai clienti cosmetici per unghie di livello professionale a prezzi accessibili. La bellezza di lusso non deve essere costosa!

Per guidare la nostra rapida espansione nel mercato italiano, cerchiamo una persona motivata, creativa e propositiva da inserire nel team nel ruolo di Junior Marketing & Communication Manager for the Italian Market (f/m/d/)*.


Le tue responsabilità

  • Relazioni con gli Influencer (Italia): Ricerca, negoziazione e gestione delle partnership con beauty influencer e content creator italiani, dal briefing iniziale al completamento della campagna e al monitoraggio delle prestazioni.

  • Pianificazione e creazione di contenuti: Ideazione e creazione a 360° — pianificazione, ripresa e montaggio di contenuti video e fotografici originali e coinvoggenti, pensati specificamente per la community italiana.

  • Servizio clienti & Community Management: Gestione delle richieste dei clienti italiani tramite e-mail, ticket e social media con empatia, precisione e un approccio orientato alla risoluzione dei problemi, per garantire un'eccellente soddisfazione del cliente.

  • Localizzazione del mercato & E-Commerce: Supporto alla traduzione, localizzazione e ottimizzazione continua del nostro shop online italiano, garantendo testi e presentazioni di prodotto culturalmente in linea con il pubblico locale.

  • Supporto alle campagne & Presenza davanti alla telecamera: Assistenza durante i servizi fotografici/video di marketing e il lancio delle campagne, con la disponibilità e l'entusiasmo di metterti in gioco davanti alla telecamera per creare tutorial e reel autentici.

  • Gestione dei canali: Presa in carico progressiva, sia strategica che operativa, di specifici canali social (es. TikTok o Pinterest) per il mercato italiano.

Requisiti richiesti

  • Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana (obbligatorio): Eccellenti competenze di comunicazione scritta e verbale in italiano, con una naturale familiarità con il linguaggio del settore beauty e il tono di voce dei clienti.

  • Comunicazione inglese: Inglese fluido (lingua di lavoro aziendale); la conoscenza del tedesco o del francese costituisce un plus.

  • Orientamento al cliente e alla community: Passione per l'interazione con le persone, attitudine all'aiuto e pazienza nel gestire le richieste dei clienti.

  • Gusto creativo ed estetico: Forte senso per l'armonia visiva, l'estetica moderna del settore beauty, i trend attuali e la tipografia.

  • Disponibilità e impegno: Capacità di integrare agevolmente nella propria routine un orario di lavoro di 40 ore settimanali, nella sede di Berlino.

  • Affinità con il mondo dei cosmetici: Un'esperienza pratica o un forte interesse per le unghie in gel, lo smalto o la nail art rappresentano un grande vantaggio (saremo felici di insegnarti tutte le nozioni tecniche sul prodotto).

  • Prima esperienza: Precedenti stage o esperienze pratiche nel social media marketing, nell'influencer outreach o nel servizio clienti costituiscono un plus.

Cosa offriamo

  • Social & Marketing al centro: I nostri canali digitali sono fondamentali per la crescita del brand — il tuo lavoro avrà un impatto immediato e visibile sul mercato italiano.

  • Rapido percorso di apprendimento: Un ambiente dinamico e agile in cui potrai prendere l'iniziativa, testare le tue idee ed ampliare rapidamente le tue competenze.

  • Ambiente collaborativo: Un team affiatato e disponibile che ti supporterà durante l'onboarding e in ogni fase della tua crescita professionale.

  • Base solida da cui partire: Accesso all'esperienza e agli asset di account aziendali già avviati, con un seguito combinato di oltre 160.000 follower su Instagram e TikTok.

  • Ambiente di lavoro moderno: Stipendio competitivo, orari di lavoro flessibili, sconti per i dipendenti e attrezzatura di lavoro moderna.

  • Prospettive a lungo termine: Chiare opportunità di avanzamento di carriera e di inserimento a tempo indeterminato.

Come candidarsi

Ti sembra il ruolo giusto per te? Se hai motivazione, idee e voglia di far crescere il nostro brand in Italia, saremmo felicissimi di ricevere la tua candidatura! Anche se non soddisfi ancora tutti i requisiti indicati, ti incoraggiamo comunque a candidarti: premiamo la determinazione, la curiosità e un'attitudine positiva.

Invia il tuo CV, una breve lettera di presentazione e (se disponibili) i link al tuo portfolio, a lavori svolti o ai tuoi profili social.

title: LCA Working Student
descriptionHtml:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we are building the first climate-native product management system for building material manufacturers. We aim to decarbonise building materials, making up 11% of global GHG emissions. We collect data from physical production processes, generate a digital product passport with verified environmental data and make it usable along the value chain. In short: One solution to assess, design, buy, sell and manage products - with environmental impact at the core.

With this, we are building the digital infrastructure to make it faster, easier, and more sustainable to build the world around us.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Join our LCA team as a Working Student (10-20 h/week) and support the work that sits underneath every Environmental Product Declaration (EPD) we produce. Your focus will be raw material matching, the backbone of every EPD and LCA. You will work with the ecoinvent database and our Emidat Ecomapping tool, and research LCA topics such as product category rule (PCR) requirements. You'll gain hands-on experience supporting the day-to-day LCA team, who are responsible for the correct calculation of LCA results in the Emidat App.
At the same time, you'll dive into the building materials industry itself — getting to know manufacturers of cement, steel, windows, construction chemicals, asphalt, electronic building equipment, and many more, and understanding how differently each of them approaches EPDs and LCAs. This gives you insight into a diverse product spectrum with different peculiarities from an LCA perspective, which is valuable for building broader experience in LCA.
There is also the long-term opportunity to support and supervise a practical master's thesis within the Emidat environment. Our LCA team has experience supervising academic theses.

In the first 6 months, you will

  • Match raw materials: Carry out raw material matchings, mapping the product's input materials to the ecoinvent database. Ecoinvent is the most widely used environmental database for LCA worldwide, so in-depth knowledge of it is a core advantage for working with LCAs. In the material mapping, you'll be supported by our Emidat Ecomapping tool.

  • Research LCA topics: Look into LCA questions as they come up, such as PCR requirements. Experience the process of translating LCA calculation rules into software logic that delivers both correct results and usability for customers.

  • Support the LCA team: Back up the LCA team in its day-to-day business. Gain first insights into customer requests with varying levels of LCA experience — a crucial skill for working as, e.g., an LCA consultant.

What you will bring to this role

Minimum requirements

  • Studies: You are enrolled in a degree programme in LCA, sustainability, chemistry or materials science.

  • First LCA experience: Experience working with Life Cycle Assessments, whether through coursework, a thesis, an internship or preferably, a previous intern/working student role.

  • Database: Hands on experience using the Ecoinvent database to make assessments, or run matchings

  • AI native: Hands-on experience using AI tools to automate a workflow, analyse data, or accelerate a deliverable — comfortable experimenting with new AI features as they emerge.

  • Project Management: Demonstrated previous experience taking projects from start to finish - owning, structuring and driving the measurable outcomes.

  • Languages: Business fluent in English (C1/C2).

Nice to have’s

  • Language: Fluency in German.

  • Experience: Working with Emidat or another common LCA software

  • Industry Interest: Relevant work experience, education or interest in the sector. Demonstrated through engagement with climate topics, the building materials / construction industry, or how software can capture complex technical processes.

How we support you

Your manager / team lead will be

  • Benedikt Dellawalle - Team Lead, LCA

You will work closely with

  • Anna Sander-Titgemeyer, LCA Expert

  • Jonas van der Ham, LCA Expert

  • Areeba Qureshi, LCA Expert

  • Elahe Shirkhan, LCA Expert

title: Lead AI Enabled Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Working at CreateFuture

CreateFuture is an AI-native consulting partner where people do work that matters and are supported to do it well. We work alongside organisations such as PayPal, adidas, NatWest, FanDuel and Money Saving Expert, building digital products and services that make a difference  while always putting people first.

We’re a team of creators. We write code, shape delivery, build go-to-market strategies, develop AI solutions and create the practices that support our people. We work side by side with our clients, challenging what’s not working and helping them to build the future. Our commitment to craft, quality, and culture has helped us scale to over 600 people in just a few years.

CreateFuture is a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and has won Best Workplaces UK multiple years in a row.

Join us on our journey. Let’s create tomorrow, together, today.

About the role and team:

You’ll join our  team, working side by side with clients and our delivery teams to shape architectural direction and turn it into production systems. Increasingly, our clients want products and platforms that are AI-native from the start. As a Lead AI-enabled Software Engineer, you’ll be the technical lead for a team or engagement: staying hands-on where it matters most, owning the technical approach from design through to delivery, anticipating operational and delivery risks before they land, and setting the engineering standards our teams and clients work to.

How we work
CreateFuture is an AI-native organisation. Every core technical role is expected to:

  • Work with AI-native delivery and workflow practices.
  • Practise agentic engineering through at least one harness.
  • Apply context engineering through prompts, skills, tools and harnesses.
  • Know at least one runtime or language.
  • Use CI/CD and automated quality practices to verify work in all its forms.

What you'll be doing:

As a Lead AI-enabled Software Engineer, you’ll lead the technical delivery of application features and systems using AI-assisted engineering. You’ll set the direction for how sound software engineering and agentic ways of working come together on an engagement, and make sure the team delivers to that standard.

You’ll bring deep, role-specific capability, and the judgement to lead others in:
  • Application architecture and modular design, including owning architectural decisions and trade-offs across a system.
  • Application data, state, and persistence design.
  • Application feature, API, interface, and service-integration engineering.
  • Spec-driven development, including defining how specs are written and used across a team.
  • Test-driven development and wider quality strategy.
  • Secure application development.
  • Application performance, operability and production readiness.
  • Context and workflow optimisation for agentic engineering, at team and engagement level.
  • AI Agent Orchestration & Workflow Design.
  • AI Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails, including setting the approach a team follows.
  • Java, Kotlin Multiplatform or .NET, with extensive commercial experience in at least one and a track record of leading teams that use it.

You won’t need depth in all of these, but leadership experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:
  • Front-end application development.
  • Mobile application development.
  • Back-end and service development.
  • Cloud-native application development.
  • Real-time and event-driven systems.
  • Legacy application modernisation and migration.
  • AI-enabled product features.
  • Agentic development environments and harnesses.
  • Agentic engineering evaluation and observability platforms.

We'd love to talk to you if: 

  • Lead the resolution of complex, ambiguous problems that span teams, systems or an entire engagement, and make sound calls when the right answer isn’t obvious.
  • Set and own technical direction for application design and delivery, deciding how work gets done and holding the team to it.
  • Act as the senior technical voice with client stakeholders, advising on architecture, quality, risk and engineering trade-offs, and helping shape engagements from discovery onwards.
  • Lead, coach and grow engineers, including Seniors, and contribute to hiring and capability building.
  • Raise standards beyond your own engagement, shaping practices, patterns and tooling across our software engineering discipline.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

Our hiring process

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

It usually looks like this:

  • Call with our Talent Acquisition Team

Depending on the role, we might also ask you to do a short presentation, a practical or technical task or have a values focused conversation. We will explain what is involved before anything happens.

Inclusion at CreateFuture 

We believe diverse teams build better workplaces and better products. We want CreateFuture to be a place where people feel able to be themselves and do their best work.

If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just. We will do what we can to help.

We look forward to your application!

title: Lead Database Administrator
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Overview

We are at a pivotal point in our tech progression. We're looking to grow our technical estate, architect new systems, remove technical debt and scale our platform. It's an exciting time to join Partnerize, and we are looking for a technical leader to help spearhead this evolution.

As a database engineer, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy, acting as the principal technical authority and taking end-to-end ownership of our database estate. You will be a strategic anchor within the Technical Operations team, interfacing directly with business, development, and IT functions. While you will own the database architecture and design solutions for the future, a fundamental, non-negotiable part of this role is hands-on Business As Usual incident management. You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves to handle daily operations, backups, and performance tuning alongside project delivery.

Your deep expertise in MySQL, alongside strong Linux system administration and a working knowledge of network troubleshooting, will be critical to your success. You will design, build, and secure the underlying servers our databases run on, proactively analyse current implementations, and act as the ultimate technical escalation point for our database infrastructure in both our physical datacenters as well as our public cloud estate.

While we need your advanced technical skills, we are equally focused on character. We are looking for a highly proactive communicator who collaborates seamlessly without needing to be prompted. Crucially, you must be able to independently plan out complex technical work, such as database upgrades, and clearly articulate the step-by-step process and business impacts to stakeholders. You must thrive both when working independently to tackle complex problems and when operating collaboratively within a broader team. Furthermore, you will actively seek out opportunities to coach and mentor other engineers, elevating the overall DBA knowledge across the company. This role is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in the UK or the US.

As a Database Engineer at Partnerize, You Will:

  • Primary Operational Ownership: Take complete, hands-on ownership of daily database operations. Managing and maintaining the database infrastructure for day-to-day use, including backup management, resolving slow-running queries, and performance tuning, is a fundamental pillar of this role.
  • Infrastructure & Server Support: Be comfortable in providing operational support by designing, securing, and robustly maintaining the underlying Linux servers that our large distributed databases run on.
  • Project Planning & Stakeholder Communication: Plan, manage, and deliver large technical projects like database upgrades and migrations. You will autonomously map out step-by-step execution plans, proactively communicate technical considerations, and clearly articulate the business impact of your work to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Leadership & Strategy: Scope incoming work, delegate to team members where appropriate, and act as the definitive database escalation point for support teams within the wider organisation.
  • Proactive Optimisation & Automation: Measure and optimise system performance to push our capabilities forward. Lead the automation of management and monitoring for the database platform infrastructure.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Partner closely with development teams, product owners, and other stakeholders to ensure database needs are met and to improve the testability of database aspects within software deployments. Document procedures, best practices, and troubleshooting steps for knowledge sharing.
  • Delivery & Out-of-Hours/On-Call Support: Plan, prioritise, and estimate tasks using Jira, and provide essential support for any critical database-related issues both during and outside of normal business hours.
  • Mentorship: Actively mentor and coach other engineers, providing technical leadership on database design, optimisation, and migration strategies to elevate overall team knowledge.

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • MySQL & On-Premise Infrastructure: Advanced administration of MySQL in production environments, whether on-premise or in the cloud. Crucially, as our primary database is on-premise, you must possess strong Linux system administration and networking awareness to independently support, secure, and maintain the underlying servers.
  • Independence: Experience as either the sole or lead owner for large production database infrastructure within a SaaS environment with demonstrable accountability for its availability and performance. A proven track record of managing these responsibilities while coordinating with external technical stakeholders and adhering to light change management processes.
  • High Availability & Replication: Advanced experience configuring and troubleshooting complex MySQL replication setups (such as primary-replica, multi-master, and GTID). Proven ability to quickly resolve replication lag, manage smooth failovers, and execute disaster recovery plans.
  • Monitoring: A working understanding of database monitoring tools and patterns. What to measure, appropriate thresholds, and response mechanics.
  • Performance Optimisation: Deep expertise in query tuning, slow query analysis, and advanced schema optimisation (including normalisation, partitioning, query rewrites, and indexing strategies).
  • Upgrades, Migrations & Scripting: Proven track record of executing minimal-downtime upgrades and complex migrations (in-place, cross-database, or migrating ancillary workloads). Highly skilled in automating these processes using Python and/or Bash to build robust, version-controlled scripts.
  • Database Security & Compliance: Experience securing database infrastructure through SSL/TLS encryption, user access control, audit logging, and automated backup encryption.

Desirable Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • Automation, Containers & CI/CD: Hands-on expertise using Ansible for configuration management, deploying and managing databases within Kubernetes/containerised environments, and managing version control and pipelines via GitLab for any database related change.
  • Monitoring & Troubleshooting: Hands-on experience deploying and configuring monitoring/alerting stacks (such as Prometheus, Grafana, or Percona Monitoring and Management) for proactive issue resolution and database health tracking.
  • PostgreSQL & Hybrid Estates: Advanced administration of PostgreSQL, alongside experience managing database workloads across a hybrid environment (e.g., combining on-premise architecture with AWS).
  • OLAP & Data Warehousing (Apache Druid / Snowflake): Familiarity with columnar databases and cloud data platforms, particularly Apache Druid and Snowflake. Experience with schema design, data sharding strategies, OLAP query optimisation for long-running queries, and managing zero-downtime upgrades in distributed environments.
  • Service Management Tooling: Experience using Jira and Confluence for managing workflows, project tracking, and creating technical documentation.

Growth & Innovation:

descriptionHtml:

👋 Über Grannel

Grannel ist eine Founder-led Boutique Performance Marketing Agentur aus München.

2020 als One-Man-Show gestartet. Heute bauen wir in München unser Kernteam auf und fahren die externe Arbeit Schritt für Schritt zurück.

Wir arbeiten nicht als „Dienstleister“, sondern als strategischer Wachstumspartner auf Augenhöhe mit Foundern, CMOs und Heads of Growth.

  • Unser Fokus: Paid Ads und alles, was darauf einzahlt. Tracking, Funnel, Creatives und Media.

  • Unsere Kernkanäle: Meta, Google, TikTok.

  • Unsere Stärke: Creative + Data als zentraler Wachstumstreiber.

  • Referenzen: Brands wie HOLY und Sunday Natural haben wir bereits beim Wachstum begleitet.

Und wir bauen Grannel als AI first Agentur. Reporting, Monitoring, Uploads und Analysen laufen zu großen Teilen über eigene AI Workflows. So bleibt Zeit für das, was wirklich Impact hat.

Wir wachsen bewusst über Ergebnisse, nicht über Sales-Pitches.

🎯 Warum wir diese Rolle jetzt aufbauen

Grannel ist stark über Delivery gewachsen. Der Founder (ex-Meta, ex-Google) bleibt strategisch eng an unseren Kunden dran.

Für die nächste Wachstumsstufe brauchen wir jedoch eine zentrale Delivery-Instanz in München, die:

  • Kundenergebnisse verantwortet

  • strategisch mitführt

  • Prozesse strukturiert

  • ein kleines Team vor Ort mit aufbaut

Wir suchen keinen zusätzlichen Media Buyer. Wir suchen einen Partner in der Delivery.

🧭 Deine Rolle

Als Lead Performance Marketing & Client Delivery bist du Owner der Kundenergebnisse. Du:

  • führst mehrere Kunden end-to-end

  • arbeitest auf Entscheider-Ebene

  • entwickelst kanalübergreifende Strategien

  • priorisierst Hebel mit echtem Business Impact

  • steuerst Werkstudenten, Freelancer und unsere AI Workflows

  • baust perspektivisch ein kleines Team in München auf

Du machst nicht alles selbst. Du stellst sicher, dass die richtigen Dinge richtig gemacht werden. Wenn es drauf ankommt, gehst du aber selbst in die Tools und packst mit an.

🛠️ Verantwortungsbereiche

Client Ownership & Growth Consulting

  • Strategische Beratung auf Founder- und Exec-Level

  • Weekly Syncs, Monthly Strategy Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews

  • Erwartungs- und Stakeholder-Management

  • Klare Priorisierung von Business-Hebeln, auch jenseits der Ads: Angebot, Landingpage, Funnel

Performance & Channel Strategy

  • Entwicklung kanalübergreifender Strategien (Meta, TikTok, Google)

  • Budget-Allokation und Skalierungslogik

  • Testing-Frameworks

  • Ownership von Tracking- und Attributionslogik (nicht operative Umsetzung)

Creative Strategy & Analytics

  • Analyse von Creative-Performance und Ableitung klarer Learnings

  • Entwicklung von Growth-Angles

  • Briefing von Designern und UGC-Creators

Team & Delivery Excellence

  • Steuerung von Werkstudenten und Freelancern

  • Sicherstellung konstanter Delivery-Qualität

  • Aufbau von Prozessen und Standards

📈 Was Erfolg bedeutet

Nach 6 Monaten:

  • Du führst Kunden eigenständig

  • Klare Routinen und saubere Prozesse

  • Founder nur noch punktuell operativ involviert

Nach 12 Monaten:

  • Du bist zentrale Delivery-Instanz

  • Du führst ein kleines, starkes Team

  • Du prägst die strategische Weiterentwicklung von Grannel

🔍 Wen wir suchen

✅ Must-Haves

  • Mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung im Performance Marketing (idealerweise 3 bis 6 Jahre)

  • Agentur oder schnell wachsendes E-Commerce / Startup

  • Tiefe Praxis in Meta Ads, solides Verständnis von TikTok und Google Ads

  • Business-Denken jenseits von „ROAS optimieren“: Deckungsbeitrag, CAC, CLV

  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt auf Entscheider-Ebene

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C2) und sehr gutes Englisch

  • Montag bis Donnerstag im Office in München

➕ Nice-to-Haves

  • Tracking- und Attribution-Know-how

  • Gespür für Creatives und Content

  • Erste Führungserfahrung

  • Du nutzt AI Tools bereits produktiv im Alltag

🚫 Für wen diese Rolle nicht ist

  • Wenn du hauptsächlich Ads klicken willst

  • Wenn du klare Aufgaben ohne Verantwortung suchst

  • Wenn du keinen Kundenkontakt möchtest

  • Wenn du nur einen Kanal optimieren willst

🎁 Was wir bieten

  • Founding-Role mit echtem Einfluss

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Founder

  • Anspruchsvolle Growth-Cases mit Brands aus D2C und Lead Gen

  • Aufbau eines Münchner Teams

  • Klare Perspektive: von Lead zu Head of Growth

  • 30 Urlaubstage, Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.500 € im Jahr, monatlicher Sachbezug

  • Hochwertige Hardware und Zugang zu allen relevanten AI Tools

💰 Und weil man von Obstkorb & Wellpass keine Miete zahlt

70.000 bis 80.000 € Base plus skalierbarer, unbegrenzter Performance-Bonus. Bei Zielerreichung liegst du bei circa 85.000 bis 100.000 €, nach oben offen.

Wir skalieren mit unseren Kunden über Performance-Modelle, die uns finanziell alignen. Warum sollten wir das intern anders machen? Wenn wir wachsen, wächst du mit.

Diese Rolle ist anspruchsvoll. I know.

Du musst nicht der perfekte Fit sein. Ownership und strategisches Denken sind entscheidend.

CV oder LinkedIn-Profil reichen aus. Anschreiben ist optional. Die kurzen Fragen im Bewerbungsformular helfen uns, dir schnell zu antworten. Keine Sorge, wir nageln dich auf keine Zahl fest 😄

Hinweis zur Gleichbehandlung: Unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Kandidat:innen. Mit deiner Bewerbung erklärst du dich einverstanden, dass wir deine Daten im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses speichern und verarbeiten. Daten abgelehnter Bewerbungen löschen wir nach sechs Monaten.

title: Lead Technical Recruiter
descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

As Lead Technical Recruiter, you will lead critical technical searches, raise recruiting quality across the team and help build ActAI's technical recruiting capability.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead ActAI's highest-priority technical searches across AI/ML, engineering leadership, backend, infrastructure, web and mobile.

  • Build search strategies and talent maps for scarce technical talent across global AI and engineering markets.

  • Personally source, engage, assess and close senior and difficult-to-hire candidates.

  • Set a high bar for technical profile assessment, ensuring recruiters understand candidates' actual work, technical depth and relevance before progressing them.

  • Partner closely with engineering leadership to define hiring profiles, calibrate interview standards and diagnose gaps in the recruiting funnel.

  • Coach technical recruiters on sourcing strategy, profile assessment, candidate engagement and closing.

  • Review pipeline quality and recruiting data, identify where searches are failing and change strategy quickly.

  • Develop repeatable recruiting practices that improve hiring quality and speed as ActAI scales.

 

What You Will Need

  • 7+ years of technical recruiting experience, including significant ownership of senior and difficult engineering searches.

  • Strong track record hiring high-quality engineers through direct sourcing and headhunting.

  • Deep familiarity with technical talent markets and strong understanding of software engineering and AI/ML profiles.

  • Ability to distinguish exceptional technical work from strong branding, titles or CV keywords.

  • Experience partnering directly with senior engineering leaders on hiring strategy and calibration.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach recruiters and improve the quality of their sourcing and assessment.

  • Strong judgement, urgency and willingness to remain deeply hands-on.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or leading technical recruiting at an AI company or high-growth technology startup.

  • Existing networks across AI/ML and engineering communities.

  • Experience hiring across multiple markets including the US, Europe and Asia.

À propos de Kaluza

Kaluza est l’Energy Intelligence Platform : nous transformons la complexité de l’énergie en coordination fluide. Nous aidons les acteurs de l’énergie à relever les défis d’aujourd’hui tout en accélérant la transition vers un avenir propre et électrifié.

Notre plateforme orchestre des millions de décisions en temps réel entre les foyers, les équipements, les marchés et les réseaux. En combinant algorithmes prédictifs et conception centrée sur l’humain, Kaluza rend l’énergie propre fiable, abordable et adaptée à la vie de tous les jours.

Avec des équipes en Europe, en Asie et en Australie, et une joint-venture avec Mitsubishi Corporation au Japon, nous accompagnons des acteurs majeurs comme OVO, AGL et ENGIE, ainsi que des innovateurs comme Volvo et Volkswagen.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Faire le lien entre notre technologie et celles et ceux qui l’utilisent : accompagner nos clients, partenaires et collègues, principalement sur le marché français et plus largement dans les marchés francophones, pour qu’ils comprennent la plateforme Kaluza et surtout la maîtrisent.

  • Être un partenaire de confiance : mener des analyses approfondies des besoins de formation pour comprendre les défis propres à chaque client, partenaire et équipe interne.

  • Accélérer l’adoption de la plateforme Kaluza grâce à un accompagnement et à du coaching après la formation.

  • Suivre l’efficacité de vos programmes et les améliorer en continu à partir des retours et des indicateurs de performance, pour que la formation ait un impact concret pour nos utilisateurs et pour le secteur de l’énergie.


Ce que vous apportez

Critères essentiels :

  • Bilinguisme : vous êtes à l’aise en français comme en anglais, avec d’excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale.

  • Expertise en formation SaaS : vous avez une expérience avérée de conception et d’animation de programmes de formation à fort impact dans un environnement SaaS ou technologique.

Nos valeurs

title: Legal Counsel, Commercial & IP
descriptionHtml:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

This position is remote-friendly.

⚖️ Our Legal team

The Legal team is at the heart of Joko’s growth and protection. We navigate the complexities of contracts, regulations, and risk management to ensure the company operates smoothly and seizes opportunities with confidence.

We handle all legal matters: Contracts, Corporate, Labor, Data protection, IP etc… enabling other teams to innovate with confidence.

Leveraging our expertise and external partners, we collaborate with all functions to protect Joko’s interests efficiently and proactively.

🚀 What you will do

As Legal Counsel, Commercial & IP, you will work hand in hand with our business teams to negotiate the partnerships that drive Joko's growth, and you will own our contracts, IP, commercial disputes and insurance. You will report directly to the Head of Legal (Maya).

🛡️ IP and technology

  • Define the legal framework for Juno, our AI shopping assistant: our rights to merchant content and catalogue data, the use of third-party brands and logos in the app and our marketing, and the ownership of AI-generated content.

  • Protect the Joko brands across our markets with our IP counsel, from trademarks, domain names, oppositions and renewals to action against third parties that infringe our rights.

  • Work with Product and Marketing to secure new features and brands before they launch.

🤝 Deals and commercial relationships

  • Sit alongside the business teams in their negotiations with merchants and brands: partnership agreements, data-sharing contracts, CPG and B2B deals, and the contracts for our new business lines.

  • Structure our merchant and brand relationships so they hold up under French and EU rules on restrictive commercial practices, including significant imbalance and the abrupt termination of established commercial relationships.

  • Lead or support the negotiation of contracts on exclusivity, most-favoured-nation, competition law risks and parity clauses.

  • Build the templates, playbooks, red lines and fallback positions the business teams use every day, and turn them into AI skills.

⚖️ Disputes and risk

  • Handle disputes with merchants, partners and suppliers together with the teams who own the relationship, from formal notices to settlement, protecting both our position and the relationship.

  • Brief and manage our litigation counsel when a dispute goes to court.

  • Own our insurance programme (D&O, cyber, travel and any new line), from renewals to claims, and build an international programme with our brokers so coverage follows us into each new country.

🙌 Who you are

  • You have 4 to 6 years of experience in commercial or IP/IT law, including time in a top-tier law firm. In-house experience in a tech or consumer company is a strong plus.

  • You have negotiated complex commercial agreements directly with counterparties, in French and in English, and you enjoy it.

  • Experience in commercial disputes, restrictive commercial practices or IP/IT matters related to AI is a strong plus.

  • You understand how a business makes money, and you use the contract to support it rather than to slow it down.

  • You turn your positions into templates and playbooks that non-lawyers can use on their own.

  • You hold a Master's degree in business law, IP/IT law or contract law from a leading French law school. Admission to the Paris Bar is a plus.

  • You are fluent in French and English. Another European language is a plus.

  • You write clearly, you decide with incomplete information, and you like the pace of a scale-up.

  • You are curious about AI and want to learn how to build the tools that change legal work.

What we tell you upfront. Until the three poles are staffed, every Legal Counsel works across the full legal scope with the Head of Legal. Functional ownership is formalised as soon as the Commercial & IP and Product & Privacy seats are both filled.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

title: Leitung Technik und Vertrieb (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
PantaTec ist ein innovatives Unternehmen im Bereich der Oberflächentechnik durch Strahlprozesse. Als Teil der starken Eggersmann Gruppe sind wir seit vielen Jahren in unserem Markt der erste Ansprechpartner, wenn es um Verbesserungen beim Strahlen geht.

Wir sind weltweit führend in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Implementierung des mittlerweile sehr bekannten PantaTec-Verfahrens. Die Integration unserer Technologie in alle herkömmlichen Strahlanlagen spart Zeit und senkt die Produktionskosten deutlich. Die hohe Anerkennung bei unseren weltweiten Anwendern und unsere Alleinstellung haben wir uns über viele Jahre mit fundierter Expertise, hohem Engagement und absoluter Serviceorientierung erarbeitet.

Im Zuge einer geregelten Nachfolge suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt den geeigneten neuen Leiter Technik und Vertrieb (m/w/d). Bei entsprechender Entwicklung besteht perspektivisch die Möglichkeit, die Gesamtgeschäftsführung der PantaTec zu übernehmen.

Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Weiterentwicklung der Geschäftsaktivitäten mit dem bestehenden Team zur Erreichung unserer Wachstumsziele

  • Umfassende wirtschaftliche Organisation der Produktion aller PantaTec-Produkte

  • Planung und Umsetzung technologischer Weiterentwicklungen des PantaTec-Verfahrens

  • Gesamtverantwortung Vertrieb und Auftragsabwicklung aller Produkte und Dienstleistungen des PantaTec-Verfahrens

  • Führung und Weiterentwicklung der internationalen Vertriebspartner, durch regelmäßige Präsenz vor Ort

  • Repräsentation auf Messen und Tagungen (inkl. Vorträgen) sowie bei relevanten Verbänden und Institutionen

  • Professionelle Darstellung und praktische Einführung des PantaTec-Verfahrens beim Kunden, inkl. Analyse der Ausgangssituation, Zielstellung im Gesamtprozess und Begleitung der Produktion in der Einführungsphase

  • Organisation und Steuerung der praktischen Implementierung beim Kunden durch das Team

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes technisches Studium (z.B. Maschinenbau) oder vergleichbare technische Ausbildung bzw. Berufserfahrung

  • Erfolgreich im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise in der Oberflächentechnik oder Metallverarbeitung

  • Erfahrung in der Analyse und Optimierung von Kundenprozessen sowie in der Einführung technischer Verfahren beim Kunden

  • Nachweisbare Führungserfahrung

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und hohe operative Umsetzungsstärke (Bereitschaft, auch selbst beim Kunden vor Ort Tests/Einführungen durchzuführen)

  • Solide betriebswirtschaftliche bzw. kaufmännische Kenntnisse

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen sowie mit kennzahlenbasierter Steuerung (Forecast, Pipeline-Management, Produktionsplanung)

  • Deutsch- und Englisch verhandlungssicher, weitere Fremdsprache von Vorteil

Benefits

  • Anspruchsvolle Führungsaufgabe im familiären Team mit flachen Hierarchien

  • Technologische Alleinstellung mit hohem Wachstumspotenzial

  • Attraktive Möglichkeit auch für den nächsten Karriereschritt

  • Fundierte Einarbeitung mit Begleitung durch den bisherigen Stelleninhaber

  • Attraktive Vergütung

  • Dienstfahrzeug, auch zur Privatnutzung

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

Wenn wir Ihr Interesse geweckt haben, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung (Lebenslauf und Zeugnisse). Ein zusätzliches Anschreiben ist wünschenswert.

title: Life Sciences Senior Consultant - Investor
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview 

ClearView Healthcare Partners is a premier life sciences strategy consulting firm headquartered in Boston, with offices in San Francisco, New York City, London, Zurich and Gurgaon. Serving clients in the biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic spaces, we provide world-class strategic decision-making support across a diverse range of business issues. Our goal is to inform actionable recommendations that allow companies to achieve their business objectives.

*We are not accepting any agency submissions for this position at this time

The Investor pillar is dedicated to creating best practices and frameworks for buy-side and sell-side due diligence teams while advancing the firm's expertise in valuation strategies and deal-making within the healthcare sector.  The team has extensive experience conducting diligences with our clients to maximize research value and provide strategic insights.   

At ClearView, you will encounter an entrepreneurial environment, interact with a dynamic group of colleagues, present to clients in critical business situations, and develop a deep understanding of the life sciences and biopharmaceutical industry. You will be mentored directly by ClearView managers, who have a wealth of experience in life sciences consulting. 

Responsibilities 

You will interact with both clients and teams within ClearView to address critical strategic questions within the biopharmaceutical space. During a typical project, you will engage in a number of activities, including: 

  • Conduct complex problem-solving using a hypothesis-based approach
  • Collaborate with leadership and clients to design and execute on project workstreams
  • Perform primary and secondary research to uncover critical insights
  • Deliver recommendations and manage client needs throughout the project
  • Mentor and develop junior team members
  • Utilize analytic tools (e.g., forecast models) to support decision-making

Opportunities

  • Lead projects and refine a broad range of expertise and skills
  • Build valuable connections to advance your career

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a life sciences discipline with 3+ years in life sciences consulting of PhD/post doc in the life sciences or MD with 1.5+ years experience in life sciences consulting
  • 2+ years of experience with due diligence projects is preferred
  • Ability to frame and tackle more complex problems
  • Establish rapid credibility and trust with leadership
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including complex concepts
  • Strong upward communication and active thought partnership during internal discussions
  • Trusted to drive content and process-related client communications
  • Demonstrated mentorship for junior team members
  • Independent workstream ownership
  • Ability to work in London office at least 50% of the time

What We Value

We recognize that not every candidate will meet every qualification listed. If you’re excited about this role and believe you have relevant experience or transferable skills, we encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, a growth mindset, and a commitment to collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClearView Healthcare Partners ("CV") is an Equal Opportunity employer.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: M&A Intern (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere erfahrenen Kollegen kommen von führenden Unternehmen wie BCG, McKinsey, Goldman Sachs und Oaktree Capital und haben bereits erfolgreich HealthTech-Rollups auf- und ausgebaut. Wenn du eine Karriere im M&A, Private Equity oder Investmentbanking anstrebst und hands-on Erfahrung in einem dynamischen Umfeld sammeln willst, bist du bei uns richtig!

Deine Aufgaben

  • M&A-Prozesse: Unterstützung in der Strategie und Umsetzung von Praxisakquisitionen, einschließlich Due Diligence und Finanzmodellierung.

  • Markt- und Finanzdatenanalyse: Verantwortung für die Aufbereitung und Analyse von Finanz- und Marktdaten, die für Investmententscheidungen relevant sind.

  • Sparring mit dem Leadership-Team: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Führungskräften bei wichtigen M&A-Themen und strategischen Entscheidungen.

  • Erstellung von Entscheidungsmatrizen und Hintergrundanalysen: Entwicklung von Entscheidungsgrundlagen zur Unterstützung der Akquisitionsstrategie.

  • Research und Verhandlungsvorbereitung: Unterstützung bei der Planung und Durchführung von Kaufpreisverhandlungen.

  • Accounting und Controlling: Mithilfe bei operativen Aufgaben im Finanzmanagement unserer Praxen.

Dein Profil

Wir suchen ambitionierte Talente, die mehr wollen als ein Standardpraktikum – eine anspruchsvolle Aufgabe mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und bedeutendem Impact.

  • Exzellente akademische Leistungen und analytische Stärke.

  • Hohe Affinität für Zahlen und MS Office-Skills, insbesondere Excel; Kenntnisse in Finanzmodellierung sind von Vorteil.

  • Ambition und Motivation, mit uns die Gesundheitsbranche nachhaltig zu verändern.

  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch (C2).

  • (Idealerweise) erste relevante Erfahrung im Consulting, Investmentbanking, PE, VC, oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich.

  • Diskretion und die Fähigkeit, in einem herausfordernden Umfeld fokussiert zu arbeiten.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Hands-on Mentoring durch erfahrene Kollegen aus Top-Firmen und intensiver Austausch mit unserem Leadership-Team.

  • Perspektiven und Netzwerk: Zugang zu einem starken Netzwerk in M&A und HealthTech, Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereplanung.

  • Work-Life Balance & Health Benefits: Neben spannenden Aufgaben bieten wir dir Gesundheitsleistungen wie regelmäßige Vorsorge-Checks und Beratungen.

Über PraxisEins

PraxisEins ist ein staatlich unterstützter Gesundheitsversorger mit einem Fokus auf den Bereichen der hausärztlichen Versorgung, Diabetologie und Schmerztherapie.

Unsere Mission

Versorgung sichern - Qualitätsmedizin gewährleisten. Als PraxisEins wollen wir die Primärversorgung zukunftsfähig machen – mit digitaler Unterstützung, klaren Prozessen und einem Umfeld, in dem Ärztinnen und Ärzte Medizin wieder mit Freude ausüben können!

PraxisEins ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert und Vielfalt schätzt. Wir freuen uns über alle Bewerbungen und bearbeiten diese völlig unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religionszugehörigkeit, Hautfarbe, Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Familienstand oder Behindertenstatus. title: Manager, Agent Architecture
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Manager, Agent Architecture, you will build and lead the team that transforms customer service with AI Agents, while staying in the build yourself. You run a team of Agent Architects: you hire them, coach them, set their goals, and own the quality of every AI Agent they ship, with a significant portion of your capacity on live customer engagements.

This is your opportunity to lead at the front line of enterprise AI, where your credibility comes from doing the work alongside your team, not just directing it.

Areas of ownership:

  • Team Leadership: Own hiring for Agent Architect roles, run weekly 1:1s, performance reviews, and career conversations, and build development plans that help each person grow. Set ramp expectations for new hires and coach Associate and mid-level Agent Architects on prompt engineering, conversation design, and customer-facing judgment.

  • Capacity and Stakeholder Alignment: Set team goals and OKRs aligned with Professional Services priorities, manage capacity and workload across concurrent engagements, and surface resourcing tradeoffs early. Represent the Agent Architecture team to Sales, Product, Engineering, customers, and partners.

  • Hands-on Agent Delivery: Personally guide customers through AI Agent implementations, from strategic advice to scoping to end-to-end delivery. Serve as the escalation point when agent performance degrades.

  • Quality and Best Practices: Define what good looks like for agent quality, enforce it through review, and make it repeatable across every live project. Document best practices for internal and external audiences, and turn recurring field problems into structured feedback for Product.

Who you are:

  • Experience leading people, whether as a formal manager, team lead, or through sustained mentorship where you owned a group's growth and output. First-time managers with a strong coaching track record are welcome.

  • 3+ years of conversation design and AI agent development experience, with a track record of building scalable solution architecture and conversational experiences grounded in real user needs.

  • Skilled in advanced prompt engineering, comfortable integrating REST APIs and working with Javascript.

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with significant experience working with enterprise customers, including in escalated or high-pressure situations.

  • Sound judgment on capacity and prioritization: you can say what your team can and cannot absorb, and back it up with reasoning.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

title: Manager Recruitment Onderwijs
descriptionHtml:
Wil jij op operationeel niveau bouwen aan de mensen die het onderwijs van duizenden leerlingen versterken? Als Resource Manager bij Lyceo in Leiden krijg je een sleutelpositie binnen een landelijke marktleider die volop groeit. Een baan met directe impact, veel verantwoordelijkheid en volop ruimte om recruitment en capaciteitsmanagement verder te professionaliseren.

Taken

Maak het verschil als Resource Manager in Leiden

Als Resource Manager zorg je ervoor dat Lyceo nu en in de toekomst beschikt over de juiste begeleiders om scholen en leerlingen tijdig te ondersteunen. Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor hun beschikbaarheid, kwaliteit en inzetbaarheid. Je maakt deel uit van het MT en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de directie van Lyceo. Met ondersteuning van het datateam bepaal je welke begeleiders waar en wanneer nodig zijn. Op basis daarvan laat je gerichte recruitmentacties uitvoeren en geef je richting aan selectie, matching en onboarding. Met KPI’s bewaak je de instroom, retentie, vervulling en doorlooptijden en stuur je gericht bij. Daarnaast optimaliseer je processen en geef je leiding aan een team met onder andere een Recruiter en een Coördinator Matching en Onboarding. Samen met de Operationeel Manager zorg je voor voldoende geschikte mensen en een succesvolle uitvoering van alle onderwijsprojecten. Bij afwezigheid kunnen jullie elkaars verantwoordelijkheden overnemen.

Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het:

  • realiseren van voldoende gerichte instroom en een kwalitatief sterke recruitment, selectie en onboarding;
  • verbinden van vraag en aanbod op basis van regio, vakgebied, onderwijstype, beschikbaarheid en reisbereidheid;
  • voorspellen, bewaken en bijsturen van de capaciteitsbehoefte met data en KPI’s;
  • optimaliseren van recruitment en instroomprocessen en adviseren over selectiecriteria, retentie en capaciteit;
  • aansturen van het team en bewaken van het recruitmentbudget.

Vereisten

Voor deze vacature neem jij mee:

Je vertaalt recruitmentdoelstellingen naar concrete acties en stuurt met data op kwaliteit, instroom en capaciteit. Historische resultaten combineer je met verwachtingen en ontwikkelingen in de markt. Ook wanneer nog niet alles vaststaat, kijk je vooruit, maak je keuzes en stuur je tijdig bij. Als leidinggevende sta je dicht bij je team, geef je richting en neem je mensen met positieve energie mee. Ervaring binnen recruitment, arbeidsbemiddeling, detachering of vergelijkbare dienstverlening helpt je om wisselende capaciteitsvragen snel te doorgronden.

Vink jij deze checklist ook af?

  • minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau;
  • ervaring met recruitment, werving en selectie;
  • leidinggevende ervaring binnen recruitment, capaciteitsmanagement of een vergelijkbare dienstverlenende omgeving;
  • ervaring met het sturen op data en KPI’s binnen recruitment of capaciteitsplanning;
  • ervaring met het optimaliseren van recruitment- of instroomprocessen.

Jouw werkgebied

Jouw nieuwe werkplek bevindt zich in Leiden, vlak bij Leiden Centraal. Vanuit het kantoor werk je nauw samen met de verschillende afdelingen van Lyceo. Dankzij de ligging nabij het centraal station is de werkplek goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

Benefits

Als gedreven Resource Manager kun jij rekenen op:

Een verantwoordelijke functie bij een groeiende onderwijsorganisatie waar ontwikkeling niet alleen voor leerlingen centraal staat. Lyceo biedt je ruimte voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Via de Lyceo Academie blijf je bovendien zelf leren en krijg je volop mogelijkheden om binnen de organisatie door te groeien.

Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband krijg je daarbovenop:

  • een verantwoordelijke functie van 32 tot 40 uur per week, waarbij je tijdens de drukke periodes in het schooljaar flexibel beschikbaar bent;
  • 25 vakantiedagen, waarvan je naar rato 10 vakantiedagen opneemt in de zomervakantie;
  • de mogelijkheid om 5 extra verlofdagen bij te kopen;
  • 8% vakantiegeld, uitbetaald in mei;
  • reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van OV-kosten;
  • een pensioenregeling waarbij Lyceo 6% premie betaalt;
  • een laptop en telefoon van de zaak;
  • toegang tot exclusieve kortingen via Benefits at Work;
  • deelname aan de Lyceo Academie met diverse online en fysieke trainingen;
  • volop mogelijkheden om door te groeien binnen Lyceo;
  • leuke activiteiten via onze personeelsvereniging Nablijven.

Werken bij Lyceo

Wie werkt bij Lyceo, blijft leren. Lyceo is een toonaangevende landelijke organisatie in aanvullend onderwijs en helpt jaarlijks duizenden leerlingen met onder andere huiswerkbegeleiding, bijspijkertrajecten, examentrainingen en lente- en zomerscholen. Scholen beoordelen de dienstverlening van Lyceo gemiddeld met een 8,5 of hoger.

Als marktleider is Lyceo volop in beweging en heeft de organisatie duidelijke groeiambities. Je werkt in een betrokken en energieke omgeving waarin samenwerking centraal staat en ruimte is voor initiatief, eigenaarschap en nieuwe ideeën. Samen werkt Lyceo aan de beste verbinding tussen regulier en aanvullend onderwijs, zodat ieder kind tot zijn recht kan komen.

Eén klik verwijderd van jouw nieuwe baan

Gaat jouw hart sneller kloppen van deze vacature en heb je de checklist afgevinkt? Wacht dan niet te lang, want zodra wij een geschikte kandidaat hebben gevonden sluiten we de vacature. Solliciteren doe je simpel en snel via onze solliciteer-button. Vergeet je niet om een up-to-date cv en een gerichte motivatie toe te voegen? Heb je vragen over de vacature? Neem dan contact op met Jamie via telefoonnummer 06-82073897. Misschien spreken we elkaar dan snel!
