title: Manager/Senior Manager, Financial Services - Banking & Markets
descriptionHtml:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Banking & Markets practice are looking for experienced Managers & Senior Managers to join the team. 

Banking and Markets are being reinvented. AI is transforming how institutions operate, customer and regulatory expectations are rising, and established players are under pressure to grow, modernise and perform at pace. Our team works alongside senior leaders at financial institutions to tackle the challenges that matter most - from unlocking new sources of growth and reimagining operating models, to harnessing AI, modernising technology and responding to rapidly changing markets.

Our clients include global transaction, corporate and investment banks, leading high-street banks, building societies, growing digital banking providers and more. You’ll combine strategic thinking and analytical rigour with hands-on delivery experience and an AI-first mindset, helping clients turn complex problems into meaningful, lasting change.

What you will be doing

  • Shaping and delivering large-scale technology, AI and digital transformation programmes, supporting our clients on their transformation journeys.

  • Maximising business value for our clients through the definition and delivery of effective technology, digital, AI and data projects. We see strong demand in the market for pragmatic, delivery-focused consultants who are capable of leading teams, and have the ability to adapt to hybrid delivery models (e.g. Waterfall and Agile). 

  • Helping our clients reimagine how their operations will work in an AI age - redesigning processes, operating models and ways of working to drive operational excellence, and balancing the technology change with the people and process change needed to make it stick.

  • Working directly with client stakeholders, building trusted working relationships and supporting effective communication across teams. 

  • Developing our people, coaching and managing colleagues, providing high-quality feedback and creating opportunities for others to grow.

 
Your skills and experience 
 

  • Proven experience leading complex consulting engagements or transformation programmes, with accountability for successful delivery and measurable client outcomes.

  • Product knowledge in one or more of the following domains: Retail, Commercial or Corporate Banking or Capital Markets (propositions, channels, operations and technologies). 

  • A track record of building trusted client relationships and originating or shaping new work, alongside successful delivery of complex engagements.

  • Strong commercial awareness, with experience contributing to business development, proposals, account growth or the development of new client opportunities.

  • Experience leading and developing high-performing teams, including coaching more junior colleagues and managing delivery across multidisciplinary teams.

  • A  proven track record in one or more of the following areas:

    • Leading complex programmes spanning technology, business and operations, with AI at the core

    • Delivering technology and AI solutions at pace, using Agile and hybrid delivery models

    • Defining and delivering operating models built for an AI age

    • Reinventing processes and driving operational excellence through data, automation and AI

    • Shaping payments strategy and modernising payments (e.g. real-time payments, ISO 20022) 

    • Shaping technology and AI strategy and architecture

    • Supporting digital assets and tokenisation, and navigating regulatory change (e.g. DORA, AI regulation).

What a career at Baringa will give you 


Putting People First.

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

  • Generous Annual Leave Policy: We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 
  • Flexible Working: We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 
  • Corporate Responsibility Days: Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 
  • Wellbeing Fund: We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice.

title: Mass Timber Field Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
You don't just see timber. You see the future of construction.

The construction industry is changing. Sustainable building solutions, innovative materials and more efficient construction methods are shaping the way we build tomorrow.

You understand the potential of mass timber – and know how to turn that potential into business opportunities.

At Simpson Strong-Tie, we develop solutions that help make buildings safer, stronger and more sustainable. Our expertise in structural solutions, engineering and innovation enables us to support customers in tackling the challenges of modern construction.

To drive the next phase of growth in this exciting market, we are looking for a Mass Timber Field Engineer (m/f/d).

In this role, you will play a key part in expanding our mass timber business across Europe, combining strategic business development, technical expertise and commercial drive. You will connect with key stakeholders across the construction value chain and turn opportunities into long-term business success.

What you can expect

You are more than a sales manager.

You are a business builder, a trusted partner and a driving force behind the development of our mass timber business.

Working closely with our European teams, regional sales colleagues and technical experts, you will help shape our market position, strengthen customer relationships and unlock new opportunities in the growing mass timber sector.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Drive business growth: Execute our mass timber sales strategy and deliver revenue growth by developing new accounts, building a strong project pipeline and converting opportunities into business.

  • Build strategic relationships: Establish and develop long-term partnerships with architects, structural engineers, designers, developers, contractors, engineered wood product (EWP) suppliers and prefabrication companies.

  • Develop market opportunities: Identify target customers, key projects and emerging market trends to strengthen our position in the mass timber industry.

  • Turn opportunities into projects: Engage with stakeholders early in the project lifecycle and drive opportunities from initial contact and technical specification through to commercial conversion.

  • Provide technical-commercial expertise: Support customers through technical presentations, workshops and site visits, demonstrating the value of our solutions, including their technical and sustainability benefits.

  • Be a trusted customer partner: Advise customers on product specifications, certifications and compliance requirements, working closely with our technical experts.

  • Shape our business development strategy: Identify market needs and gaps in our product and service portfolio and translate customer feedback into actionable business opportunities.

  • Work across borders: Collaborate with regional sales teams and European colleagues to develop opportunities and support international mass timber projects.

  • Own your business performance: Manage your sales pipeline, forecasts and KPIs, maintain customer and opportunity data in Salesforce and regularly report on business performance and growth opportunities.

Your primary sales responsibility will cover Germany, Austria and Switzerland (DACH). At the same time, you will contribute to the development of our mass timber business across the European regions defined in our strategy, supporting international projects where relevant stakeholders are based in DACH.

In short: You combine technical understanding, commercial thinking and a passion for developing new markets.

What you bring to the table

You don't need to tick every single box.

What matters most is your ability to understand the construction industry, build strong relationships and turn market potential into measurable business results.

Ideally, you bring:

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in sales, business development or a comparable commercial role, preferably in construction, timber or sustainable building materials.

  • A proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and successfully developing new business.

  • A strong understanding of the construction value chain and the ability to engage with architects, engineers, developers, contractors and other industry stakeholders.

  • Experience in developing customer relationships, managing complex sales processes and converting projects into commercial success.

  • An analytical mindset with the ability to assess market potential, identify business opportunities and translate insights into action.

  • Experience working in an international or pan-European business environment, with an understanding of different regional market dynamics.

  • A degree or equivalent qualification in architecture, engineering or construction – this technical background is essential for the role.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in German and English, combined with the confidence to engage and influence stakeholders at different levels.

  • A proactive, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating across functions and countries.

  • A willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80%).

Experience in mass timber, engineered wood products (EWP), timber engineering or prefabricated construction would be a strong advantage.

Above all, we are looking for someone who is curious, commercially driven and motivated to help shape the future of sustainable construction.

What you can expect at Simpson Strong-Tie

We are an international company with a clear mission: to provide solutions that help people design and build safer, stronger structures.

But we believe that great results come from more than great products. They come from people who take ownership, share ideas and make things happen.

At Simpson Strong-Tie, you can expect:

Real impact and ownership

You will have the opportunity to shape a growing business area and directly influence our position in the European mass timber market.

A strong international network

You will work with experienced colleagues across Europe, combining local market knowledge with international expertise.

Innovative solutions with purpose

You will be part of an industry that is transforming the way we build – with solutions that contribute to safer, stronger and more sustainable structures.

Room to grow

We encourage initiative, personal development and new ideas. You will have the opportunity to take responsibility and make a real difference.

Ready to shape the future of construction?

If you are passionate about sustainable construction, enjoy developing business opportunities and want to make an impact in a growing market, we would love to hear from you.

Your career path doesn't have to match every point on this list. If you bring the right mindset, experience and motivation, we encourage you to apply.

title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Switzerland
descriptionHtml:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.

In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.

You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.

We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.

You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.

You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.

You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.

Job Responsibilities

  • Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.
  • Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't.
  • Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI-generated results and ensure engineering rigor.
  • Investigating and solving complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools.
  • Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.
  • Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview.

Qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium- to large-sized organization.
  • Strong understanding of PLM & ERP systems and enterprise engineering data architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional collaborations.
  • Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems.
  • Comfort working in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of high-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts.
  • Located in Switzerland 

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation.
  • Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows.
  • Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale.

Travel Expectations

While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect:

  • Team Weeks: Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.
  • On-sites: This role will work closely with a local customer with expectations to be on site with that customer, so there will likely be far less travel than our typical MFDE roll. That being said, in the event the local customer were to no longer work with us, the following is our standard MFDE travel expectations: “For most of our large deployment customers, we will visit on-site during kick-off and key expansion opportunities. Most on-sites involve 2-3 days with the customer, with travel on either side. Travel is primarily within North America, and you can expect 4 customer on-sites per quarter.”

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options.
  • Unlimited paid vacation and extended health benefits 

Equity Note

Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Your potential is what matters most to us.

title: Mechanical Systems Designer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Mechanical Systems Designer (all genders), you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ mechanical systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s mechanical systems such as environmental control, ice protection, flight controls, landing gear, oxygen, and others, and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of multiple mechanical systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the mechanical systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Assess system, interface and certification requirements and translate them into robust and practical design solutions.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

  • Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

  • Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft mechanical systems. Experience with electric aviation is an asset.

  • Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, and drafting.

  • Sound knowledge of mechanical component design, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, assembly and inspection requirements.

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

  • Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing manufacturing and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach, attention to detail, and the ability to present clear rationale for solution proposals.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

descriptionHtml:
Our mission is to make first contact with superintelligence.

We are creating a superlearner that discovers all knowledge from its own experience, from elementary motor skills through to profound intellectual breakthroughs. This superlearning capability - the ability to endlessly discover knowledge and skills, without relying on human data - will be driven by the world’s most powerful reinforcement learning algorithms.

The superlearner is expected to rediscover and then transcend the greatest inventions in human history, such as language, science, mathematics and technology. If successful, this will represent a scientific breakthrough of comparable magnitude to Darwin: where his law explained all life, our law will explain and build all intelligence.

Role brief

Intelligence cannot emerge in a void. It needs a place to grow and flourish. As a Simulated Universes Engineer, you’ll help us craft, shape and maintain the worlds in which superlearners can emerge and thrive. That means making those worlds accurate, reliable and intricate, and scaling them to unprecedented highs in terms of both parallelism and speed. It’s a challenging quest and one that’s critical to our mission. In this role, you will:

  • Build the engineering foundations of our new environments; designing, implementing and maintaining them as they grow

  • Partner closely with the team creating the blueprints for the worlds we need to build

  • Close the loop between blueprint and build, enabling fast, iterative research cycles

  • Scale the environments up, while utilising state-of-the-art hardware

title: Mid-Market Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

 

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

 

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

 

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them.

 

We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 12x YoY.

The Role:

  • We are looking for Mid-Market Account Executives.

  • This role is focused on selling into global mid-market businesses with distributed teams, multiple buying centres, layered governance, and high data sensitivity. These are strategic accounts where the impact of accurate hierarchies and clean CRM data is measured in millions.

  • Our first ramped AEs are far exceeding quota, so we know the motion works.

  • Our mid-market motion is working. We are generating strong demand and building pipeline within large organisations.

  • You will be responsible for driving high six-figure opportunities and are confident that we will close the first 7 figure deals this year through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Our targets call for millions of additional ARR over the next year. You will play a major role in that.

Important to Know:

  • Hours - This will be an exciting but intense job. Kernel is growing extremely fast and hours can often be long. Many of our customers are on the West Coast, and meetings can be held late in the evening.

  • Working location - Minimum 4 days a week in the London office (most people do 5). There will be international travel involved for this role in visiting prospects.

Responsibilities:

  • You’ll manage complex sales cycles with some of the best mid-market businesses out there, from mid six-figure through to seven-figure+ deals.

  • Multi-thread within accounts and build executive-level relationships, including VP and C-level stakeholders.

  • Most opportunities will be sourced for you by the SDR team and Growth team, however sourcing additional pipeline is expected.

  • You’ll collaborate with the wider team on GTM strategy as we expand our ICP & experiment in other verticals.

  • You’ll help to create our sales processes as you build them.

  • You’ll become the best person in the company at explaining & pitching the product.

  • You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and customer success, bringing in insights from across the company and performing an essential part of our product feedback loop.

Your Traits:

  • Entrepreneurial: creative, resourceful.

  • Executive presence: You are comfortable engaging VPs, CROs, CIOs, and senior RevOps leaders.

  • All-in: hard-working, excited to stretch yourself, willing to take out the trash.

  • Clear thinker, good writer: you can crisply articulate your ideas, goals, and plans and help our customers make sense of hairy consulting-like problems.

Essential Qualifications:

  • 2-5 years of experience.

  • At least 1 year consistently closing deals worth $50k+/year in a multi-stakeholder sales process, consistently hitting six- to seven-figure targets.

  • Ability to execute on a consultative, solutions-oriented, value-based selling methodology (MEDDPICC).

  • Track record of consistent over-achievement in past sales roles.

  • Ability to discuss technical concepts with prospective customers and translate requirements into a demonstrable product.

  • Comfort negotiating and navigating contracts, security and legal discussions without support.

  • Strong verbal, written, and interpersonal skills.

Nice-To-Have:

  • Startup/scale-up experience is a plus.

  • Experience selling to Revenue Operations, GTM and/or Sales teams.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce.

What We Offer

We will do our best to offer you a ride of a lifetime. It will not be easy, but it will be thrilling.

  • 💰 Salary: £110k-£140k OTE + equity

  • 🗓️ 24 days holiday per year + bank holidays

  • 🥕 £450 Monthly Office Dinner Allowance

  • ✈️ 2 weeks work-from-anywhere

  • 🍼 Generous parental leave policy

  • 💼 Pension plan

  • 💻 Top-spec equipment and central London office

  • 🎉 Team events and dinners

  • 🚀 Work directly with the founders to scale the systems that power enterprise AI

  • 🏆 High-autonomy, high-trust environment with a small team shipping at pace

Interview Process

Stage 1 – 30-minute intro call with Talent Partner. You’ll discuss your sales experience and motivations.

Stage 2 – 1-hour interview with Head of Sales. You’ll deep dive into your experience, sales targets & achievements, and Mid-Market AE at Kernel.

Stage 3 – Discovery role play (≤ 2 hours prep).

Final Stage – Founders interview with Anders (CEO) for culture and values alignment.

If there is mutual fit, we move to references and offer.

Compensation: £110K – £140K • Offers Equity

title: ML Engineer - Internship
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

We are looking for a motivated Machine Learning Engineer Intern to join our Data & AI team and contribute to the development of our end-to-end ML pipelines.

You will help improve how we train, evaluate and deploy computer vision models, working on internal AI infrastructure and model lifecycle management.

This internship is ideal for someone interested in applied machine learning, computer vision and MLOps, who wants to gain hands-on experience building reliable AI systems for real-world defence applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Model training: Improve and optimise training pipelines for computer vision tasks, including object detection, segmentation and tracking.

  • Model evaluation: Develop evaluation frameworks using standard metrics such as mAP, IoU, precision and recall, and automate experiment tracking.

  • Data management: Build reproducible workflows for dataset versioning, augmentation and preprocessing of large-scale image and video datasets.

  • Model deployment: Contribute to deployment workflows for optimised AI models running on edge devices and embedded systems.

  • Monitoring and reliability: Implement tools to monitor deployed models and assess their robustness and performance.

  • Documentation and collaboration: Work closely with the Data & AI team to document best practices and help build scalable ML infrastructure.


Candidate Profile

  • Strong foundations in Python, data science and machine learning.

  • Knowledge of deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Ability to analyse, visualise and preprocess large-scale image and video datasets.

  • Familiarity with experiment tracking tools such as MLflow or Weights & Biases, and/or data versioning tools such as DVC.

  • Understanding of Docker, Git and cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP.

  • Ability to work autonomously in a research and prototyping environment.

  • Strong collaboration skills and an interest in working in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

title: Nachwuchsberater (M/W/D)
descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Diagnostik & Künstliche Intelligenz | Organisationsentwicklung

Sie möchten nicht nur analysieren, sondern verstehen, was Menschen und Organisationen wirklich bewegt?

Wie werden aus guten Führungskräften erfolgreiche Führungsteams? Was macht Organisationen zukunftsfähig? Wie lassen sich Persönlichkeit, Führungspotenzial und Zusammenarbeit fundiert beurteilen? Mit diesen und vielen weiteren Fragestellungen beschäftigen wir uns bei PILLONG.

PILLONG verbindet anspruchsvolle Personal- und Managementberatung mit neuen Perspektiven auf Menschen, Führung und Organisationen.

Wir begleiten Unternehmen und Führungskräfte in komplexen Veränderungsprozessen und entwickeln unsere Beratungsansätze kontinuierlich weiter – insbesondere durch die Verbindung systemischer Organisationsberatung, wissenschaftlich fundierter Diagnostik und moderner KI-Anwendungen.

Dabei setzen wir auf analytische Kompetenz, eigenständiges Denken und die Überzeugung, dass technologische Innovation und menschliche Urteilskraft gemeinsam die Qualität zukünftiger Beratung bestimmen.

Wir verstehen Weiterentwicklung nicht nur als Aufgabe gegenüber unseren Mandanten, sondern als eigenen Anspruch. Deshalb investieren wir gezielt in neue Kompetenzen, Methoden und Menschen, die unsere weitere Entwicklung mitgestalten möchten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir im Rahmen dieser Weiterentwicklung eine analytisch starke, neugierige und engagierte Nachwuchspersönlichkeit (m/w/d), die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft anspruchsvoller Beratung gestalten möchte.

Sie arbeiten unmittelbar mit erfahrenen Beratern an anspruchsvollen Mandaten und gewinnen Einblicke in die Herausforderungen von Geschäftsführungen, Führungsteams und Organisationen.

Wir suchen keine fertige Beraterpersönlichkeit.

Wir suchen jemanden, der das Potenzial, die Neugier und den persönlichen Anspruch mitbringt, sich zu einer solchen Persönlichkeit zu entwickeln.

Erste praktische Erfahrungen in der Unternehmensberatung, Personalentwicklung, Diagnostik oder in HR-Projekten sind willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Wichtiger als ein bereits perfekter Lebenslauf sind uns Ihre intellektuelle Neugier, Ihre Persönlichkeit und Ihr Anspruch an die Qualität Ihrer eigenen Arbeit.

Das bieten wir Ihnen

Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich in einem etablierten Beratungsunternehmen zu einer qualifizierten und eigenständig handelnden Beraterpersönlichkeit zu entwickeln.

Sie entwickeln sich mit uns weiter – und bringen zugleich Ihre eigenen Ideen und Perspektiven in die Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens ein.

Unser Ziel ist eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit, in der Sie fachlich und persönlich wachsen und zunehmend eigenständige Beratungsverantwortung übernehmen.

title: Operations Strategy Lead
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is that we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region, including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

The Operations Strategy Lead – UK owns the operational backbone of BJAK's UK business. You'll make sure daily operations, internal systems, and customer-facing execution run smoothly, efficiently, and at a standard that supports scale.

This is not a P&L role, and it's not a "manage from a distance" role either. You'll partner closely with the CEO to turn business objectives into strong execution on the ground, building systems, leading teams, and stepping in directly when execution breaks.

 

What You'll Own

  • Define and execute operational strategies that support growth and align with BJAK's objectives in the UK market.

  • Run day-to-day operations across customer service, administrative operations, and internal workflows so execution stays frictionless.

  • Hire, lead, and develop a high-performing operations and admin team with a strong culture of ownership and accountability.

  • Own process improvement, finding bottlenecks, automating where possible, and implementing systems that cut cost and increase speed.

  • Lead the customer support function and step in hands-on during high-stakes or escalated cases.

  • Oversee company administration and internal operations, including office management, documentation, vendor coordination, and adherence to internal policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong background in operations, execution, or internal business operations in tech, fintech, or fast-scaling environments.

  • Proven experience leading operations and admin teams in high-expectation environments.

  • Hands-on mindset with the ability to solve problems directly, not just delegate them.

  • Strong organisational, execution, and problem-solving skills.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure to fast-moving situations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally and drive execution without formal authority.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who want to direct operations from a distance instead of stepping in when things break.

  • Candidates who need fully-built systems and processes handed to them.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid escalations, messy cases, or hard conversations with vendors and staff.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

Location

  • This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

  • English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1-2 weeks from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

descriptionHtml:
At OneStream, we're on a mission to empower every Finance organization and professional to exceed their potential. Our global teams span continents, cultures, and time zones, united by a shared purpose as we build the operating system for modern Finance and help organizations move with greater speed, clarity, and confidence.

That mission comes to life through our people. Behind every innovation, customer success, and milestone are talented people working together to make a difference. That's why we're looking for people who are bold enough to think big, authentic in how they lead and collaborate, curious about what's possible, and committed to delivering results.

Want a closer look before you apply? Explore our Careers site to learn more about our people, culture, and benefits.

Summary

As a Partner Success Manager (PSM), you will play a critical role in driving the success of the OneStream partner ecosystem. You’ll be responsible for developing, supporting and growing all skillsets within a portfolio of strategic partners. This role blends relationship management, enablement strategy, and operational excellence to help partners build a scalable, high performing and self-sufficient practice. 

The Partner Success position bridges the gap between OneStream’s internal teams—such as customer success, partner alliances and partner enablement —and its partners, managing the functional and technical aspects of partner implementations, making sure partner needs are addressed promptly and thoroughly, and fostering lasting relationships to enhance the partner experience. This includes project tracking, partner health and growth, partner program tier levelling, measurement through scorecards, OnePass utilization and ensuring skill level certifications. 

Orchestrating engagements centrally with project involvement will strengthen the understanding of how and when to engage the wider CSRC teams and provide opportunities for enablement/training of our partners. 

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Partner Relationship & Support 

  • Act as the primary point of contact for implementation partners, ensuring the partner has the necessary resources and both technical and functional support. 
  • Own regular partner status calls to discuss partner project delivery status and delivery concerns. 
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with partners to drive success of OneStream implementations and partner success. 
  • Provide guidance on overall partner health and future planning with the partner. 
  • Serve as a co-liaison with Partner Alliances between partners and internal teams (Support, Remote Consulting, Partner Enablement, Engineering, Customer Success), focusing on creating value for the partner by guiding them to appropriate teams and processes when needed. 
  • Alert Partner Alliances and other internal leadership concerns related to the delivery of project timelines mitigating risk. 
  • Provide input to Partner Delivery Managers on the leveling of partners based on experience working with specific implementation partners and their perceived skillsets. 
  • Maintain clear and concise communication with partners and internal stakeholders. 
  • Responsible for driving the partners to develop and maintain a COE function within their practices.

Project Oversight & Functional Support 

  • Monitor and support partner led implementations to ensure adherence to project delivery and partner success. 
  • Review projects plans and provide recommendations to project timelines and go-live success. 
  • Seek opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and adoption via Functional enablement to our partners. Recommend the use of enablement materials to partners based on customer requirements and expectations. 
  • Review partner cases and their nature to ensure they are utilizing their internal COE correctly. 
  • Review and identify key deliverables for partner success. 

Enablement 

  • Develop and deliver partner Seismic pages with functional information, new features and solution content. 
  • Actively engage partners with COE with online (i.e.Navigator) courses, content and enablement materials. 

Process Improvement 

  • Identify opportunities to improve partner processes and develop strategies to improve efficiency. 
  • Identify opportunities to improve proactive enablement and proactive services and develop strategies and new services to prevent customer escalations. 
  • Create SOP documentation on engaged projects and look to role this out further for governance on projects 
  • GAP analysis with alliances to help build a more robust framework for our partners for processes and active projects/project management. 

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in fields such as (but not limited to) Accounting, Business, Finance, Information Systems, Mathematics, or CIS, or equivalent work experience. 
  • Minimum 2 years of experience with project management, stakeholder management, or account management. 
  • Minimum 5 years of experience consulting or Functional account management for software implementations for CPM/EPM platforms. 

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master’s degree in business, Accounting, Finance, or Information Technology.  
  • A professional accounting designation (e.g. CPA, CMA, CGA, CA), advanced degrees (MBA, MFA), and/or other professional designations or certifications (applicable to accounting/finance and information technology) 
  • Project management, program management or account management expertise. 
  • Prior experience in Partner Success or Customer Success. 
  • Deep experience with SQL, C#, VB.net, or Visual Basic. Any object-oriented programing a plus. 
  • Prior experience and expertise in Scalability and Performance of EPM/CPM products. 
  • Prior experience with Azure based SaaS platforms. 
  • Prior experience using Telemetry tools to monitor EPM/CPM applications. 
  • Prior experience with any of the following products is a plus: 
    • SAP Outlooksoft BPC or SAP BOFC (Cartesis). 
    • Hyperion Planning, Hyperion Essbase, Hyperion Financial Management (HFM). 
    • FDM (Financial Data Quality Management) or UpStream. 
    • IBM Cognos. 
    • Other EPM solutions. 
    • Other GSI/RSI partner implemented SaaS solutions i.e. BlackLine, Trintech, Workiva etc.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Excellent project skills related to product implementation. 
  • Excellent customer service skills. 
  • An ability to effectively communicate concise functional guidance and recommendations. 
  • Ability to develop trust and strong relationships. 
  • Ability to deliver difficult feedback regarding product implementations and project status. 
  • Desire to enable others and continuously grow functional knowledge. 
  • Self-directed and strong desire to succeed. 
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. 
  • Ability to manage and complete multiple streams of work in a timely manner. 
  • Presentation skills and strong interpersonal communication abilities. 
  • Ability to collaborate and solve problems alone and as a team. 
  • Strong knowledge of financial accounting processes. 
  • Ability to create drafts of project status. 
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot issues. 

Why Join The OneStream Team

  • Transparency around corporate structure, salary, and benefits
  • Core value of customer success
  • Variety of project work (not industry-specific) 
  • Strong culture and camaraderie
  • Multiple training opportunities

title: Partnership Manager - Accountant Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: People Operations Manager, UK
descriptionHtml:
TL;DR: Own Lovable’s UK People Operations, from payroll and commissions to benefits and day-to-day employee support. You’ll be a hands-on operator and a trusted point of contact for our London team, partnering with a coordinated global People Ops function to deliver reliable, people-first experiences. You’ll use data, systems and AI to make the work more scalable without losing the human touch.

This is an in-office role, five days a week.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

  • 5–6+ years in UK People Operations or HR, with hands-on ownership of UK payroll, commissions and employee benefits.

  • Strong operational judgment and attention to detail: you can keep complex processes accurate and on time, handle sensitive information with care, and know when to bring in specialists.

  • An analytical mindset and a track record of using data to spot issues and improve how work gets done.

  • Clear, empathetic communication and the confidence to influence without authority, challenge constructively and work through trade-offs with senior stakeholders.

  • A team-first, hands-on approach and the ability to take ownership in a fast-moving, changing environment. You’re excited to be in our London office five days a week.

  • Experience with or strong interest in building automations, workflows and AI agents in People Operations.

  • Preferred: Experience in a startup or high-growth environment, including scaling beyond 500 employees; exposure to European labor law or multi-country operations; or experience implementing HR systems and automation.

What you’ll do

  • Own UK payroll and commissions: Coordinate inputs, checks and handoffs to ensure accurate, timely delivery, resolve exceptions and improve processes as the business grows.

  • Run UK benefits: Own implementation, administration and employee communications in partnership with our Head of Total Rewards.

  • Support immigration and compliance: Coordinate UK immigration processes with our mobility and immigration team, and help keep local People policies and operations running smoothly.

  • Support our people: Be a primary point of contact for the UK team, providing responsive, thoughtful support and making moments like onboarding, payroll and benefits feel effortless.

  • Improve how work gets done: Use data to identify trends and operational issues, and design automations, workflows and AI agents that reduce manual work while protecting employee data and trust.

  • Partner across the business: Work with Finance and global People Ops on reporting, audits, systems and process improvements. Help senior stakeholders navigate people-related decisions, objections and trade-offs.

How you’ll fit in

  • With global People Ops: You’ll own UK delivery while collaborating closely with a coordinated global team and contributing to international initiatives, especially around systems and tooling.

  • With specialist partners: You’ll work with Total Rewards on benefits and with mobility and immigration specialists on UK cases, bringing the right people in when their expertise is needed.

  • As a builder: You’ll keep the day-to-day running reliably while finding practical ways to make existing processes simpler and more scalable. Automation should free up time for the moments when people need a human.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Pricing & Packaging Senior Lead (x/f/m)
descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen Dich als Pricing & Packaging Senior Lead (x/f/m) für unser Revenue Operations Team in Berlin.

Doctolib bietet Arztpraxen in Deutschland ein Portfolio, das von Terminmanagement und Patientenkommunikation über KI-Assistenten für Telefon und Dokumentation bis zur vollständigen Praxissoftware reicht, vertrieben über Field Sales, Inside Sales, Customer Success und Partner. Du verantwortest die Preis- und Paketarchitektur dieses Portfolios: wie wir Preise differenzieren, was ein Einstiegspaket leisten muss, wie unsere Bundles aufgebaut sind und nach welcher Logik wir abrechnen.

Die Rolle verbindet Strategie und Umsetzung. Du entwickelst Preisentscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlungsbereitschaft, Wettbewerb und Unit Economics, vertrittst sie gegenüber dem Leadership und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Markt so ankommen, wie sie gedacht sind: im Angebot der Seller:innen, in den Rabattregeln und im realisierten Preis.

Nach sechs Monaten hast Du unsere Paketarchitektur auf den Prüfstand gestellt und die nächsten Schritte mit dem Leadership entschieden, eine erste Preis- oder Paketänderung umgesetzt und eine belastbare Sicht darauf aufgebaut, welcher Preis nach Rabatten tatsächlich realisiert wird.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Paketarchitektur: Du entwickelst unsere Paketstruktur vom Einstiegspaket bis zum Komplettangebot weiter und legst fest, welche Produkte und Leistungen wo liegen, wie sich die Stufen voneinander abgrenzen und welche Zusatzoptionen sie ergänzen

  • Preislogik und Differenzierung: Du definierst, worauf sich ein Preis bezieht, etwa pro Behandler:in, pro Praxis oder nach Nutzung, und wie wir nach Fachrichtung, Praxisgröße oder Vertragslaufzeit differenzieren

  • Evidenz und Business Cases: Du misst Zahlungsbereitschaft, analysierst Preiselastizität, Conversion und Churn nach Segment, beobachtest den Wettbewerb und rechnest mit Finance die Umsatz- und Margenwirkung jeder Option durch

  • Preisänderungen im Markt: Du planst Preisanpassungen und Paketwechsel für Neu- und Bestandskund:innen, inklusive Migrationslogik und Kommunikation, und begleitest sie bis in alle Sales Motions

  • Rabatt-Governance und Deal Desk: Du verantwortest Rabattregeln, Freigabelogik und Sonderkonditionen und machst transparent, wie viel vom Listenpreis tatsächlich realisiert wird

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre Pricing und Packaging in B2B-SaaS oder einem anderen Subscription-Geschäft gestaltet, im Unternehmen oder in der Pricing-Beratung, und Preis- oder Paketänderungen bis in den Markt gebracht

  • Du weißt, wie man Zahlungsbereitschaft herausfindet, aus Kundengesprächen, Umfragen, Preistests im Markt und Daten zu Abschlüssen, Nutzung und Churn, und baust Deine Preis- und Margenmodelle selbst, in Spreadsheets und SQL

  • Du übersetzt Analysen in klare Empfehlungen zu Preismetrik, Paketgrenzen und Preisniveau und vertrittst sie vor Senior Leadership und Sales Leadership

  • Du setzt KI routiniert in Analyse und Arbeitsabläufen ein, z.B. für Wettbewerbs-Monitoring oder die Auswertung von Deal-Anfragen

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und fließend Englisch

Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:

  • Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, mit Health-Tech oder in einem anderen regulierten Markt

  • Erfahrung mit nutzungsbasierten Preismodellen, Self-Service-Buchung oder Testphasen

  • Erfahrung mit Rabatt-Governance, einem Deal Desk oder CPQ-Systemen

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest

  • 28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)

  • Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten

  • Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)

  • Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)

  • Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth

  • Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält

  • Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner

  • Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine

  • Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club

  • Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet

Der Interviewprozess

title: Principal Connectivity Planner
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Principal Connectivity Planner, you will be Volta's planning authority for network connectivity. You will own the integrated connectivity plan across the portfolio, linking carrier services, long-haul routes, Data Center Connectivity Infrastructure, network equipment installation and turn-up to compute capacity dates.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role, reporting to the Senior Director, Global Network Connectivity Delivery. Your forecasts will be what leadership relies on to commit capacity dates, and your planning standards will be used by every connectivity workstream and supplier.

What you will do

Integrated planning

  • Own the global integrated connectivity schedule, aligned to the master, commissioning and deployment schedules.

  • Set Volta's connectivity planning standards: work breakdown, coding, durations, progress rules and reporting.

  • Lead program schedule reviews and analytics, analyzing data and executing reports to ensure project schedules are aligned

  • Lead contractor schedule reviews as required with sites to ensure consistent delivery of connectivity and network Infrastructure across Voltas Sites.

Risk and recovery

  • Lead schedule risk analysis on supplier lead times, permits, civils and activation, and advise leadership on trade-offs.

  • Build recovery and alternative delivery options when connectivity risks threaten site turn-up.

  • Report milestone confidence and supplier commitments to delivery and project controls leadership.

Capability and improvement

  • Use actual delivery data to set benchmark durations and improve supplier forecasts.

  • Raise planning capability across connectivity leads and suppliers.

What we are looking for

  • Recognised senior authority in planning telecoms, network or data centre programmes, typically 10+ years of experience.

  • A proven track record of owning integrated schedules across a portfolio of sites or routes.

  • Expert in Primavera P6 or equivalent, including critical path and schedule risk analysis.

  • Strong understanding of carrier lead times, fibre delivery, equipment installation and activation.

  • Credibility with senior leadership when forecasting dates and recommending recovery options.

Nice to have

  • Experience in Hyperscale or AI infrastructure capacity delivery.

  • Background managing Long-haul fibre, permits and carrier provisioning programmes.

  • Experience with Portfolio-level planning governance.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

title: Principal Data Engineer - AWS
descriptionHtml:
Principal Data Engineer – AWS

Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Engineer future-ready data platforms that power financial transformation.

The Role

We’re looking for a Principal Data Engineer with AWS to join our growing team of engineering experts driving next-generation transformation for Tier 1 financial services clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in designing, building, and deploying cloud-based data pipelines that enable trusted, scalable data platforms. Working across greenfield initiatives and enterprise-scale programmes, your work will directly influence how data is ingested, transformed, and consumed across the financial services industry. You'll also embrace AI-enabled ways of working, using approved AI and automation tools where appropriate to enhance productivity, improve delivery quality, and accelerate engineering outcomes while applying sound engineering judgement and responsible AI practices.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build end-to-end data pipelines using AWS-native services and modern cloud data architectures, ensuring scalable, secure, and resilient solutions.
  • Partner with clients and cross-functional teams to understand business requirements, define technical solutions, and deliver production-grade data platforms.
  • Apply AWS Well-Architected Principles, engineering best practices, CI/CD, and AI-enabled development approaches to improve quality, efficiency, and operational excellence.
  • Lead the development of robust, tested, fault-tolerant data engineering solutions while promoting responsible engineering standards and governance.
  • Mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and encourage the effective and responsible use of approved AI tools and automation to enhance collaboration and delivery.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java, with hands-on experience of Big Data technologies including Spark, Hadoop, or similar distributed processing frameworks.
  • Experience building real-time event streaming solutions using technologies such as Kafka, Spark Streaming, or Amazon Kinesis within AWS environments.
  • Proven expertise designing modern data architectures including Data Lakehouse and Data Warehousing solutions, alongside CI/CD, DevOps practices, and data governance including GDPR.
  • A collaborative engineering mindset with experience delivering scalable cloud solutions and using AI-enabled tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate human oversight and quality assurance.
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements into practical, high-quality technical solutions.
