title: Strategic Project Lead - Multimodal AI (London)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

The Strategic Project Lead – Multimodal AI supports frontier AI development through complex, high-quality data programs for leading AI companies. We’re looking for someone with experience in multimodal AI data, such as image, video, 3D, sensor, or robotics-related workflows.

You’ll lead projects that turn complex real-world data into reliable training and evaluation resources. Combining project management with hands-on domain knowledge, you’ll partner with clients and internal teams to design workflows, maintain quality, and solve challenging data delivery problems in a rapidly evolving AI market.


Your Impact
  • Own end-to-end project delivery across scope, timelines, budgets, staffing, and risks.
  • Lead client communication, status reporting, planning sessions, and escalations.
  • Translate technical and client requirements into data collection workflows, annotation guidelines, tooling, and quality standards.
  • Define quality metrics and acceptance criteria for multimodal data and annotation outputs.
  • Monitor delivery quality, troubleshoot data issues, and resolve ambiguous requirements with clients.
  • Advise on project feasibility, collection methods, annotation approaches, and tooling based on your domain expertise.
  • Build reusable SOPs, guidelines, and QA frameworks to support consistent delivery.
  • Mentor Operations Specialists and contribute to project scoping, pilots, and emerging multimodal AI capabilities.

    • What You Bring
  • 1–2+ years of experience in AI data operations, project coordination, or delivery, ideally in a GenAI or frontier AI environment.
  • Familiarity with at least one multimodal data workflow involving images, video, 3D data, sensors, or robotics.
  • Experience coordinating projects or workstreams, managing stakeholders, and communicating with clients.
  • Understanding of data quality, annotation workflows, and quality assurance methods.
  • Ability to translate project requirements into clear data collection workflows, annotation guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • Interest in current AI developments, including multimodal models, spatial AI, or embodied AI.

    • Nice to Have
  • Experience with image or video annotation, 3D data, point clouds, or sensor data.
  • Familiarity with robotics data collection or real-world perception workflows.
  • Exposure to 2D or 3D labeling, segmentation, tracking, or structured annotation tasks.
  • Experience with autonomous systems, spatial AI, or embodied AI.
  • Bilingual capabilities, particularly German or a Nordic language.

    • Why You'll Love Working Here

    At Appen, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence. We value curiosity, accountability, and a commitment to delivering the highest quality AI solutions for frontier models.

    You'll work on complex challenges that shape the future of AI across industries and geographies, alongside talented people in a culture that values humility over ego. You'll have the flexibility to deliver in a way that works for you and your team, supported by tools, resources, and development opportunities to continue to build your capability over time.


    About Appen
    Appen has been a leader in AI training data for over 30 years. We specialise in human generated data to train, fine tune, and evaluate models across generative AI, large language models, computer vision, and speech recognition. Our AI assisted data annotation platform and global crowd of more than 1 million contributors in over 200 countries support model pre training, supervised fine tuning, evaluation and benchmarking, safety and red teaming, and multilingual global expansion.

title: Talent Pool: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Do you care as much about why we build something as how we build it? At RoomPriceGenie, Data Engineers work where software engineering, data analytics and business impact meet. You won’t just build pipelines: you’ll understand who relies on your work and which decisions it enables. Our data powers pricing recommendations for 3,000+ hotels worldwide on a modern data stack (Snowflake, Databricks, Dagster, dbt, AWS), helping independent hoteliers set the right prices. When you ship something here, you see the direct impact on real businesses and the people who run them.

We take both culture and product seriously, and we’ve been recognised for both: Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech (2026) and Best Revenue Management Software (2026). Our engineers get real ownership and autonomy, with support whenever they need it.

We regularly hire Data Engineers, fully remote, especially in these locations:

  • Germany (DACH)

  • Spain

  • Portugal

  • UK & Ireland

  • Netherlands

This is our talent pool for Data Engineer roles. There may not be an open position right now, but by applying here you’ll be the first to hear from us when a role opens up in your location.

Your Role

  • Build and own: Design scalable data pipelines on our modern stack (Snowflake, Dagster, dbt) and take them from idea to production to monitoring.

  • Modernise with purpose: Help migrate legacy Django/Celery pipelines to our modern platform and reshape how data flows through our product.

  • Bridge the gap: Work closely with Product, Analytics and Engineering (Backend, Frontend and Data Science), turn business questions into technical designs and make sure analysts and data scientists can actually use what you build.

  • Care about quality: Champion data reliability through testing, observability and documentation, because multiple teams depend on your work every day.

Your Profile

  • 4+ years of professional Python experience, ideally in data engineering and/or backend systems

  • Strong experience building and maintaining production ETL/ELT pipelines on modern cloud data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery or Redshift)

  • Strong data modelling skills, including analytics-ready schema design, fact/dimension modelling and performance optimisation, plus solid data testing and documentation practices

  • Experience with orchestrated data pipelines (e.g. Dagster, Airflow or similar)

  • Experience building backend or ingestion services with Python web frameworks such as Django, FastAPI or Flask

  • Familiarity with background task processing and asynchronous workflows (e.g. Celery)

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS (e.g. S3, RDS/Aurora)

  • Strong understanding of software design principles and data pipeline architecture

  • Experience working with large datasets using pandas, polars or NumPy

  • An analytical mindset with an interest in data quality, KPIs and data-driven decision-making

  • Able to explain complex technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • High ownership: you take responsibility for reliability, quality and long-term maintainability

  • A collaborative, egoless team player who enjoys working across teams

  • Fluent in English and comfortable in technical discussions

  • Based in a European time zone (UTC+0 to UTC+2)

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with dbt (modelling, testing, documentation, performance tuning)

  • Experience with or interest in modernising legacy data pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with Celery & RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Django/FastAPI, Datadog and/or Sentry

  • Semantic layers or metrics modelling tools (e.g. Cube, Looker/LookML, dbt metrics or MetricFlow)

  • Experience building data observability and monitoring solutions

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

Here’s what you can expect when you become part of our Genie family:

  • Remote-First Model: Work from (almost!) anywhere. 🌍🧑‍💻 Some roles need you in a specific country or time zone — we'll always flag that in the job ad. And whenever you like, come co-work with us in Mannheim, Berlin, or Sydney. 🏢

  • One Team, One Vision, One Goal: We’re in this together! 🤝 Our Genies are laser-focused on our mission, collaborating to make magic happen. ✨ It’s no wonder we score a stellar 9.3 from our team members! 🌟

  • Epic Team Gatherings: Every year, we bring our global crew together 🌎 for a week of networking, brainstorming, and fun. 🎉 Plus, enjoy regular hangouts in our offices to keep the camaraderie alive.

  • Growth and Development: We’re all about lifelong learning! 📚 Level up your skills with personal and professional development opportunities. You’ll even snag up to three extra days off each year to focus on your growth. 📈

  • 5 Years? 5 Weeks! Stick with us, and we’ll reward your loyalty. After five years, you’ll earn an incredible five weeks of bonus vacation time 🏖️ to recharge and explore the world. 🌍

  • Birthday Celebrations: It’s your day, so take it off! 🎂 Celebrate your birthday the way you want, guilt-free.

title: Tax Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve. 

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

The Global Tax team is expanding to support Hims & Hers' continued growth across EMEA. We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented tax professional to serve as the tax lead for our EMEA region. The Tax Manager, EMEA will take ownership of all tax provision, compliance, and tax audit matters for the region, working closely with external advisors and local finance/accounting teams and partnering with the U.S.-based corporate tax team on cross-border tax matters. This role will report to the Senior Manager, International Tax.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage quarterly and annual tax provisions for the EMEA entities under U.S. GAAP and local statutory standards.

  • Ensure the timely and accurate preparation and submission of corporate income tax and indirect tax filings across multiple EMEA jurisdictions, working closely with accounting/finance teams and external tax advisors.

  • Assist with operational tax matters such as withholding taxes and tax registrations.

  • Support and manage tax audits, enquiries and correspondence with local tax authorities.

  • Partner closely with the U.S. tax team, as well as corporate legal and accounting teams, on complex initiatives including entity restructuring, transfer pricing documentation, and permanent establishment (PE) risks analysis.

  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments across the region and assess business impact.

  • Partner with the global tax team to develop and implement tax-efficient structures for new business and existing operations in EMEA.

  • Effectively communicate status/issues to the Senior Manager, International Tax in the U.S. for all EMEA entities.

  • Perform general EMEA tax research to resolve issues and work with external advisers where needed to support business initiatives.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date tax compliance calendars and documentation, ensuring robust control and risk management.

  • Develop tax staff by managing performance, setting goals, providing ongoing training, and maintaining strong employee relationships.

Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or tax required.

  • At least 5 years’ experience in corporate tax gained within a multinational organisation or Big 4/public accounting environment.

  • Professional qualification in Tax, Accounting, or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA) preferred.

  • Strong technical knowledge of EMEA direct and indirect tax rules, reporting obligations and tax accounting standards.

  • Experience with US GAAP tax provision preparation and review (ASC 740) preferred.

  • Familiarity with transfer pricing principles and international tax frameworks (e.g., BEPS, Pillar Two).

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with the U.S.-based tax team across time zones.

title: Technical Integrations Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Vio we believe booking accommodation should feel smart, fair, and effortless — never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing travel tech platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites — so they can find the perfect place, at the best price, anywhere in the world. We cut through the noise and complexity of hotel and vacation rental booking, surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays — booked with confidence. With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology travelers can trust.

We are looking for an experienced Technical Integrations Manager to join our Supply Integrations team and help us onboard new hotel suppliers, keep 70+ live integrations healthy, and be the technical voice our partners talk to.

Vio connects to hotel suppliers through APIs: wholesalers, bed banks, hotel chains, and connectivity platforms. The Supply Integrations squad builds and runs those integrations. You will join a second Technical Integrations Manager and a team of backend engineers, reporting to the squad's Engineering Manager. This is a hands-on technical role, not a coordination role: you own each integration in your portfolio from the first look at a partner's API documentation through implementation, QA sign-off, launch, and live operations. You decide when an integration is good enough to go live, and you are the person a partner's representative emails when something looks wrong.

What you will do:

  • Assess new partner APIs: read the documentation critically, make test calls, find the gaps and limitations before our engineers hit them, and document what we need from the partner.

  • Run technical onboarding with partners: credentials, environments, communication channels, and everything an engineer needs to start on day one.

  • Act as the single technical point of contact for both partners and engineers during implementation, answering questions and unblocking issues fast.

  • Own pre-launch quality: test search, booking, cancellation, and modification flows end to end; verify prices, availability, and tax and fee breakdowns; and sign off on go-live. No integration launches without your approval.

  • Watch the live portfolio: use dashboards and alerts to catch throttling, error spikes, and data-quality drift early, investigate, fix what is in reach (configuration, CMS, small pull requests), and work with partners on the rest.

  • Keep a per-supplier incident history, spot recurring patterns, and drive the automation and process changes that remove manual work.

  • Maintain the integrations roadmap with the Engineering Manager, Product, and Partnerships, and keep stakeholders informed on progress and risks.

  • Continuously improve our integration lifecycle checklist based on what each launch teaches us.

Who you are:

  • You have 3+ years in a partner-facing technical role, such as technical integrations manager, integration or solutions engineer, technical account manager, or connectivity manager, and have owned a portfolio of live API integrations.

  • You are comfortable in Postman or similar software, not afraid of JSON and XML payloads, and can tell from a response what is wrong with it. Logs and dashboards are tools you reach for, not something you ask engineers to check.

  • You read API documentation critically and can assess technical viability.

  • You write clearly and briefly. A partner engineer can act on your email without a call.

  • You manage many parallel threads without dropping follow-ups and are resourceful when a partner is slow or the documentation is incomplete.

  • You improve processes rather than repeat them: you have built checklists, templates, or automation that made your previous team faster.

  • Hotel distribution experience (rate types, board codes, merchant vs agency models) is a strong plus; we will teach it to someone with the skills above.

Why join us now?

  • We are one of the most innovative and fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of over 100 million unique visitors worldwide each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of power features and managed to overcome the corona crisis remarkably fast;

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 are already a big success, reaching 5 million installs with great customer reviews, as we are beginning to build Vio as the brand for value-seeking travellers worldwide;

  • We are a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives with a commitment and focus on the traveler above all else - and it shows in our industry-leading TrustPilot score;

  • We place huge importance on rewarding our employees for the value they generate by giving Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture which promotes knowledge sharing, trust and transparency;

  • A great compensation package, perks and benefits (including significant stock appreciation rights);

  • Flexible time off (take as many holidays as you need) and a chance to work remotely;

  • You will be part of a highly international team that enjoys working, eating and playing together in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam;

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden;

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins with company events in Amsterdam and abroad;

  • A budget for your dream home office;

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp.

title: Retail Store Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
TALA has been on a rocket ship since its founding in 2019 by entrepreneur Grace Beverley. Built on largely organic social, today we are a digital-first, multichannel women’s activewear brand with a multifaceted growth and retention strategy.

Following a £5m fundraise from world-class institutional investors and growing global media attention, TALA is entering an exciting new phase of growth, including the opening of two stores in London.

Now, we’re taking TALA beyond London, and Bicester Village, you’re next.

*This will be for a FTC from November 26 to January 27*

Tasks

What you'll be doing

Goods In & Stock Flow

  • Own the end-to-end flow of stock from delivery to shop floor, taking full accountability for backroom performance.
  • Plan and manage delivery days around Bicester Village's service yard access and delivery windows, ensuring the team is resourced and ready ahead of every drop.
  • Receive, check and book in all deliveries accurately and on the day of arrival, escalating discrepancies, shortages and damages to Logistics within agreed timeframes.
  • Set and hold a clear delivery-to-floor turnaround standard

Processing, Pricing & Retail Ready

  • Own the "retail ready" standard end to end: steamed, sized, hung or folded, correctly hangered, security tagged, ticketed and floor-ready before it leaves the stockroom.
  • Manage the outlet pricing and ticketing process with total accuracy, ensuring every unit carries the correct price and any was/now ticketing is applied in line with brand and regulatory guidelines.
  • Execute promotional changes, markdowns and price changes to deadline, including overnight or pre-trade implementation where needed.
  • Build simple, repeatable processing routines and workstation set-ups that let the team move at volume without losing accuracy.
  • Track and improve processing productivity, using units-per-hour measures to plan labour and forecast the resource needed for peak drops.

Stock Accuracy & Inventory Integrity

  • Be the store's owner of stock file accuracy, treating the integrity of our data as a core deliverable rather than an admin task.
  • Run a disciplined cycle counting programme across the store, prioritising high-value, high-volume and known problem lines.
  • Investigate and resolve negative stock, unknown barcodes, duplicate barcodes and mis-scanning patterns, feeding root causes back to HQ rather than simply correcting the symptom.
  • Lead the store's preparation for and execution of full stocktakes, including pre-count housekeeping, team briefing, counting discipline and post-count exception resolution.
  • Own shrinkage performance for the store alongside the Store Manager, identifying loss drivers and putting practical controls in place.

Replenishment & Trading Support

  • Ensure the shop floor is fully sized and replenished at open, through the day and at close, so we never lose a sale to a size sitting in a box.
  • Partner with the Store Manager on floor moves, launches and campaign execution, making sure stock is available in the right quantity at the right moment.
  • Provide the Store Manager and Merchandising with clear, timely feedback on size and line performance, sell-through, over-stocks and gaps.
  • Support omnichannel fulfilment activity in store, including click and collect and any in-store fulfilment we introduce, to the service levels we set.

Backroom Management & Space

  • Design and maintain a stockroom layout that works at volume: logical, labelled, densely but safely stored, and quick to pick from.
  • Manage stockroom capacity actively, flagging space risk ahead of major intakes and working with HQ on solutions before it becomes a trading problem.
  • Own backroom housekeeping, packaging management, waste and recycling, in line with TALA's sustainability commitments.
  • Keep all equipment, consumables and ticketing supplies stocked and functioning.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the stockroom team, building a small operation that takes genuine pride in pace, accuracy and standards.
  • Own rota planning for the backroom team, matching labour to the delivery schedule and trading peaks within payroll budget.
  • Recruit, onboard and train new team members on all BOH processes, and build stockroom capability across the wider store team.
  • Set clear daily targets and priorities, and hold the team to them through visible, on-the-floor leadership.

Compliance, Safety & Deputising

  • Ensure health and safety compliance across all back of house areas, including manual handling, safe stacking, fire exits and equipment checks, with regular audits and documented training.
  • Embed loss prevention procedures across goods in, stockroom and waste routines.
  • Ensure the store meets all Bicester Village centre operating standards and requirements.
  • Act as a key holder, opening and closing the store, and deputise for the Store Manager in their absence - including on trade, service and team decisions.

Requirements

About you:

  • Experience in a retail environment, preferably in fashion, activewear, or wellness—but above all, a genuine passion for these areas is a must.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, allowing you to connect effortlessly with customers and inspire your team.
  • A natural problem-solver—proactive, quick to learn, and able to thrive both independently and as part of a dynamic team.
  • Strong visual merchandising instincts, with a keen eye for detail to keep the store looking stylish and on-brand at all times.
  • Excellent multitasking skills, balancing customer service, sales, and store operations seamlessly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English (reading, writing, and speaking) to ensure clear and engaging customer interactions.
  • Passionate about building customer relationships, from discussing upcoming collections to gathering customer insights that foster long-term loyalty.

Benefits

Some of our core benefits include:

  • 28 days holiday a year inclusive of bank holidays
  • You'll be automatically enrolled in our company pension scheme with Aviva
  • Employee discount after probation period
  • Clothing allowance spending gift
  • TALA Uniform

About us

TALA is an activewear brand built to actively solve problems without creating new ones for people, the planet, or anyone else. Every collection prioritises functionality and thoughtful design, combining premium fabrics with multi-way versatility and flattering fits that deliver maximum impact with minimal effort. Each piece is crafted with attention to detail, ensuring women can look and feel their best with ease.

When founder Grace Beverley shifted from fast fashion to more sustainable options in her everyday clothing, she found a host of responsibly made options in every category other than activewear. Founding TALA in 2019, the proud female-led brand is on a mission to make consciously made active and off-duty styles accessible and inclusive without sacrificing performance or fit.

Read about TALA's people, purpose and product work here.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you’ll do

  • Support our Sales, Marketing, and customer-facing teams, which might include:

    • Driving end-to-end GTM processes, including building pricing proposals, developing customer presentations, and delivering financial analyses to enable team success.

    • Analyzing, optimizing, and implementing sales territories and processes for a fast-growing sales team.

    • Building out prospecting programs, marketing campaigns and events cadences, helping the sales team to drive net new demand.

    • Help define and scale the playbook for how Sierra builds, evaluates, launches, and expands AI agents at large enterprises.

  • Take on special projects and initiatives related to international expansion, pricing, marketing, legal, deal strategy, and agent development

  • Work with Pricing, Legal, Operations, Sales, Agent Development & Finance teams to identify inefficiencies in current GTM operations and design solutions to help Sierra scale.

  • Turn insight into action: Analyze complex datasets and translate findings into clear, executive-ready recommendations that drive high-leverage decisions.

  • Serve as a versatile, proactive team player, taking on both foundational tasks and high-impact strategic initiatives that drive the GTM team’s success.

  • Leverage AI-native tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to build lightweight internal systems, automate workflows, and create operational leverage.

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations.

  • Proficiency in financial modeling and data analysis (e.g., Excel, Google Sheets); experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Power BI).

  • A detail-oriented, methodical, and process-driven mentality that is focused on both accuracy and efficiency.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritize effectively, and meet deadlines.

  • A proactive mindset with the ability to navigate ambiguity, drive and execute initiatives, and deliver results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex ideas and problems into straightforward, actionable recommendations, especially to executives.

Even better…

  • SQL experience.

  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and marketing automation tools.

  • Previous 0-1 startup or operational experience.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. title: Safety Officer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Safety Officer to support the safe day-to-day operation of our facilities, workshops, test areas, construction activities, and wider company operations.

This is a practical, site-focused role for someone who is comfortable working directly with employees, contractors, engineers, technicians, and visitors. You will help ensure that safety procedures are followed in practice, risks are identified early, and the company maintains a strong and consistent safety culture.

Fluent German and experience working with German authorities are essential.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Carry out regular site inspections, safety walks, toolbox talks, and operational safety checks.

  • Support the implementation of safe working procedures, permits, PPE requirements, signage, and access controls.

  • Monitor the work of contractors, technicians, and operational teams, raising and helping resolve unsafe conditions.

  • Support emergency preparedness, drills, incident response, near-miss reporting, and corrective actions.

  • Maintain safety records, inspection reports, training records, action trackers, and compliance documentation.

  • Liaise with German authorities, inspectors, emergency services, and external safety partners when required.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in a safety officer, site safety, HSE, workshop safety, construction safety, or similar operational role.

  • Experience working in an industrial, technical, construction, manufacturing, aerospace, or high-risk environment.

  • Fluent German and proven experience communicating with German authorities, inspectors, contractors, or regulatory bodies.

  • A practical understanding of workplace hazards, risk controls, safe systems of work, and incident reporting.

  • A confident and approachable communication style, with the ability to influence behaviour at every level.

  • A hands-on, organised, and highly visible approach to supporting safe day-to-day operations.

Desirable experience

  • Aerospace, space, rocketry, propulsion, manufacturing, construction, testing, or hazardous-process environments.

  • Chemical handling, explosives, energetic materials, pressure systems, machinery, lifting operations, or electrical safety.

  • Experience supporting emergency response, fire safety, first aid, drills, or evacuation planning.

  • Experience delivering toolbox talks, safety inductions, contractor briefings, or operational training.

  • Relevant health and safety, occupational safety, fire safety, or environmental qualification.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

title: Sales Manager CH, KI-Software für Psychotherapeut:innen
descriptionHtml:
Über VIA HealthTech

VIA macht aus einer Therapiesitzung ein fertiges Sitzungsprotokoll und aus Sitzungsprotokollen vollständige psychologische Berichte. Arbeit, die Therapeut:innen bisher mehrere Stunden pro Woche gekostet hat.

Wir sind die marktführende KI-Assistenz für Psychotherapeut:innen. Über 4.000 Psychotherapeut:innen im DACH-Raum nutzen VIA, wir verarbeiten Hunderttausende Sitzungen pro Monat. Wir sind nach ISO 27001:2022 zertifiziert und verfügen über ein BSI-C5-Testat.

Wir sind ein multidisziplinäres Team in Berlin-Mitte. Marktführer in Deutschland zu sein, ist erst der Startpunkt. Die Schweiz ist unser nächster Markt, und du baust ihn mit auf.

Die Rolle

Du bist unsere erste Person im Schweizer Markt. Du baust die Pipeline von Grund auf, entwickelst das Playbook und führst es selbst aus.

In Deutschland läuft unser Funnel vor allem über Webinare: Therapeut:innen melden sich an, testen VIA 14 Tage und buchen selbst. Du findest heraus, was davon in der Schweiz funktioniert und was anders laufen muss: Qualifizierung am Telefon, Cold-Calling, andere Outbound- und Inbound-Kanäle, Verbände, Weiterbildungsinstitute, grössere Organisationen als eigener Kanal. Du testest, misst und skalierst, wo der Hebel am grössten ist.

Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing an Zielgruppen, Kampagnen und Botschaften für den Schweizer Markt und gibst direkt zurück, was im Gespräch wirklich zieht.

Die Rolle ist senior gedacht. Wenn du mid-level, aber aussergewöhnlich schnell und hungrig bist, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Den Markt öffnen. Du identifizierst die wichtigsten Zielgruppen in der Schweiz: selbstständige psychologische Psychotherapeut:innen, Psychiater:innen, Organisationen der psychologischen Psychotherapie, Ambulatorien und Kliniken. Du priorisierst, wo wir zuerst gewinnen.
  • Leads in Kund:innen verwandeln. Qualifizierungsgespräche, Webinare, Demos, Follow-up während der Testphase, Abschluss. Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für Schweizer Kund:innen.
  • Neue Kanäle erschliessen. Berufsverbände wie FSP, ASP und SBAP, Weiterbildungsinstitute, Fachveranstaltungen und Kongresse. Erstansprache per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn, wo sie sich lohnt.
  • Playbook bauen, während du verkaufst. Was konvertiert, welche Einwände in der Schweiz wirklich kommen (etwa zu Datenschutz und Datenhaltung), welche Sequenz funktioniert.
  • Zahlen verantworten. Deine KPIs entlang des Funnels, gemeinsam mit unserem Commercial Engine Lead, der Tracking und Infrastruktur baut.
  • Sales-Enablement-Material. Du passt an, was zum Verkaufen und Vermarkten in der Schweiz am besten wirkt, von Sprache bis Preisdarstellung in CHF.
  • Feedback ins Produkt bringen. Was Schweizer Kund:innen brauchen und woran Deals scheitern, besprichst du direkt mit dem Produktteam.

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Nachgewiesene Abschlüsse im B2B-Vertrieb in der Schweiz, idealerweise SaaS oder Digital Health, belegbar in Zahlen
  • Echte Hunter-Mentalität. Du hast bereits aktiv Erstkontakte am Telefon gemacht und hast damit kein Problem. Wenn dich 40 Gespräche am Tag abschrecken, ist das die falsche Rolle
  • Kenntnis des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens oder die Fähigkeit, dich sehr schnell einzuarbeiten: Grundversicherung, Anordnungsmodell, Rolle von Kantonen und Verbänden
  • Glaubwürdigkeit gegenüber Therapeut:innen. Psychotherapeut:innen vertrauen vor allem Psychotherapeut:innen. Entweder bringst du diesen Hintergrund mit, oder du arbeitest dich so schnell und so tief ein, dass man es dir im Gespräch nicht anmerkt
  • Systemdenken. Du baust reproduzierbare Prozesse statt Einzelfälle, mit dem Ziel, dass dein Ansatz auch ohne dich funktioniert
  • Hunger und unternehmerischer Ehrgeiz. Du willst einen neuen Markt aufbauen, nicht eine Quote abarbeiten
  • Kommunikationsstärke mit Abschlussfokus. Empathisch und auf Augenhöhe, denn Psychotherapeut:innen merken sofort, wenn jemand verkauft, statt zu verstehen
  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, auch remote und ohne Team vor Ort, sowie sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen
  • Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2), auch Schweizerdeutsch, gutes Englisch
  • Verfügbarkeit am frühen Abend. Unsere Zielgruppe ist häufig erst nach der letzten Sitzung erreichbar, Termine zwischen 17 und 19 Uhr gehören dazu. Im Gegenzug gestaltest du deinen Tag frei

Von Vorteil

  • Französisch und/oder Italienisch, um später auch die weiteren Gebiete anzusprechen
  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk in der Schweizer Psychotherapie- oder Psychiatrieszene
  • Erfahrung mit Funnels, in denen Marketing und Vertrieb ineinandergreifen: Performance-Marketing, Webinare, Trials, Self-Service
  • Anerkennung als Psychotherapeut:in, psychologische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen
  • Vertriebserfahrung mit Praxen, Heilberufen oder Spitälern in der Schweiz
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Sales-Automation, LinkedIn Sales Navigator oder Outbound-Tooling
  • Erfahrung im Markteintritt oder Aufbau eines Vertriebs von 0 auf 1

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • Du ein Team suchst, das für dich telefoniert.
  • Du eine fertige Pipeline oder ein bestehendes Länderteam erwartest. Du baust beides.
  • Du weder Hunger noch besonderen Ehrgeiz mitbringst. Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team und stellen entsprechend ein.

Was wir bieten

  • Einen Markt, den du prägst. Du bist die erste Person von VIA in der Schweiz. Was du aufbaust, wird zum Fundament unseres Schweizer Geschäfts
  • Ein Team, das überperformt. DACH-Marktführer für KI-Assistenz in der Psychotherapie in zwei Jahren, bootstrapped. Unsere Pläne von hier sind deutlich grösser, und wir stellen Menschen ein, die das mitgestalten wollen
  • Hohe Autonomie und Erfolgsbeteiligung. Bei uns zählen Kompetenz und Umsetzung. Wir legen dir keine Steine in den Weg, und du verdienst an dem, was du aufbaust
  • Attraktives Paket. Wettbewerbsfähiges Fixum in CHF plus ungedeckelte Provision, dazu Beteiligung am Unternehmen
  • Direkter Draht. Du arbeitest täglich mit den Gründern und dem multidisziplinären Team, Entscheidungen fallen in Stunden statt in Wochen
  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit. Jede Praxis, die du gewinnst, bedeutet mehrere Stunden pro Woche, die wieder Patient:innen zugutekommen
  • Flexibel arbeiten. Remote aus der Schweiz, freie Zeiteinteilung, moderne Ausstattung und regelmässige Teamtage in unserem Büro in Berlin-Mitte

Wir suchen keine:n klassische:n Vertriebler:in, sondern eine:n Macher:in, die oder der mit Hunger und Hands-on-Mentalität VIA in der Schweiz zur ersten Wahl macht.

title: Senior Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
🧡 About Alma

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers.

Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt.

As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.

With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team

Our Account Manager team key role is to position Alma as a true business partner with our top merchants. In short, our Account Managers are in charge of a portfolio of large accounts, with whom you'll work closely to make them successful.

You'll be arriving at the beginning of the experience, as our team was created in March 2021. There is still a lot to create! This means you'll have a key role in shaping the function.

Reporting to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will work closely with the Sales team, the Onboarding team, the Retail Training team and the Merchant Support team.

This position is a permanent role, based in Paris. 

💼 About the job

In a nutshell, your key responsibilities will consist in:

  • Manage, negotiate and retain a portfolio of large accounts. Establish trustful relationships with Alma’s large merchants. Be the key point of communication for the merchants' stakeholders, while working closely with the other functions (Onboarding, Training, Support).
  • Deliver meaningful insights. Analyse merchants' performance to provide superior insights on their businesses. Develop expertise in your field to constantly position Alma as a strategic partner, helping the merchants achieve their goals.
  • Identify key business opportunities. Identify up-sell/cross-sell opportunities on your accounts and develop strategic plans with the merchants. Ensure your accounts get the most out of Alma (maximise conversion, increase turnover, increase basket size) by leveraging the tools we have developed.
  • Be the voice of merchants. Share insights and feedback from merchants with the Product & Engineering team and the wider organisation, helping to constantly improve our solution and the merchants' experience.

🧰 You will work with

  • Salesforce
  • Gong
  • Aircall
  • Dust
  • SalesNavigator

🧩 About you

To succeed in this job

  • You have ideally more than 5 years of relevant experiences (full-time permanent positions) in similar functions such as a Sales or an Account Manager / Shop manager in the Retail industry.
  • We are seeking individuals who demonstrate coachability and a strong willingness to learn and grow.
  • You’re fluent in French and a full professional proficiency in English are mandatory. 
  • Commercial skills: You like finding new opportunities for mutual gains. You are at ease in negotiation & closing discussions.
  • KPI Driven: You are comfortable and autonomous in managing your portfolio using identified key KPIs, you like talking numbers!

And it will be nice if you also

  • Demanding and reliable: You set high goals for yourself. You don't compromise on the quality of your work, and you always deliver on your commitments.
  • Empathetic: You easily get into other people's shoes. You are always keen to do the extra mile for clients to make them successful.
  • Autonomous and driven: You know how to find the solution to an issue and look for the information you need. You are comfortable obtaining information from the Alma teams who can help you obtain solutions quickly (product, finance, risk, sales etc...)
  • Great communicator: You have excellent written and oral communication skills. You know how to adapt to your audience.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.

🧘 What's in it for you?

  • Join a growing company that's reshaping how merchants and consumers connect
  • High ownership from day one, with real impact on business growth
  • A fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas and results matter
  • The chance to help build a category and be part of something meaningful

🤑 Compensation & benefits

  • Competitive salary based on 12 months
  • Profit-sharing and employee savings plan
  • Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package
  • Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma
  • Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities
  • Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.
  • Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)
  • Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma
  • Mental health: free access to MindDay platform
  • Paid time off: 25 days/year ****(+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)
  • Access to our Learning & Development Platform
  • 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

🎯 Interview Process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)
  • Remote Hiring Manager interview (45 min)
  • On-site/Remote Business Case Study presentation (60 min)
  • On-site Final interview with the VP Sales (45 min) + Team Fit (45 min)
  • Reference check

title: Senior Account Manager | Toxic
descriptionHtml:
Op duizenden werkvloeren in Nederland wordt dagelijks gewerkt met gevaarlijke stoffen. Dat kan veilig, als je weet wat je in huis hebt, wat het doet en welke regels erbij horen. Daar helpt Sdu Toxic organisaties bij. Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veilig te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. En een succesvol marketing- en salesteam dat zorgt dat steeds meer organisaties ons vinden.

Toxic is onderdeel van Lefebvre Sdu, dat al 200 jaar bouwt aan juridische en fiscale kennis, en van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider op dat gebied. De vraag groeit. Onze Commercieel Medewerkers Binnendienst en marketing plannen meer afspraken in dan we nu kunnen afronden. Daarom zoeken we een Senior Accountmanager die van die gesprekken klanten maakt.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Jij bent het gezicht van Toxic. Voor de veiligheidskundigen, managers en directies die met ons werken, word jij degene die ze kennen en vertrouwen. Je leert hun organisatie kennen, luistert naar wat er speelt en denkt mee over wat ze nodig hebben. Zo bouw je relaties die jaren meegaan, en groeit Toxic met je klanten mee.

  • Je leert je klanten kennen: hun mensen, hun processen en wat er bij hen speelt. Zo word je hun vaste gesprekspartner en denk je mee over de volgende stap.

  • Elke nieuwe relatie begint met een goed gesprek. De binnendienst en marketing plannen de afspraken, jij bereidt je voor en ontdekt wat een organisatie nodig heeft. Daarnaast zoek je zelf nieuwe kansen.

  • In je demo's laat je zien hoe Toxic werkt en wat het oplevert. Gaat de vraag verder dan het standaardplatform? Dan werk je met collega's een oplossing op maat uit, met API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met veiligheidskundigen, inkopers en directie, brengt hun belangen samen in 1 voorstel en sluit deals met een hogere dealwaarde.

  • Met strategische accountplannen houd je overzicht op je belangrijkste klanten. Je ziet kansen voor up- en cross-sell en herkent retentierisico's vroeg. Samen met Customer Success zorg je dat nieuwe klanten goed starten.

  • Je houdt je pipeline en forecast actueel in Salesforce en deelt wat je bij klanten hoort met marketing en product.

  • Als senior ben je mentor en sparringpartner voor collega-accountmanagers.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent iemand bij wie klanten zich gehoord voelen. Je luistert goed, stelt de juiste vragen en vertaalt een complex vraagstuk naar een helder voorstel. De markt van gevaarlijke stoffen hoef je nog niet te kennen. Wat je wel meebrengt, is ervaring met het opbouwen van klantrelaties en interesse in software.

  • Je hebt meerdere jaren ervaring als accountmanager, bij voorkeur in SaaS of met digitale oplossingen.

  • Je hebt interesse in software en wilt begrijpen hoe een platform als Toxic werkt, inclusief API-koppelingen en AI-toepassingen.

  • Je bouwt relaties met meerdere stakeholders tegelijk en beheerst het volledige salesproces, van eerste kennismaking tot getekend contract.

  • Je stuurt op data en haalt je targets, met nieuwe klanten en binnen je eigen portefeuille.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je hoeft de markt nog niet te kennen. Klanten, stoffen en regelgeving leer je bij ons, van collega's die het vak door en door kennen.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je tekent voor een rol die past bij je ambitie. Je werkt aan grotere deals, bouwt je eigen netwerk op en ontwikkelt je in een groeiend SaaS-team. Dat doe je binnen Lefebvre Sdu, een legaltechbedrijf met 200 jaar kennis en de energie van een scale-up. Dit krijg je ervoor terug:

  • Een inwerkperiode waarin je Toxic, de markt en onze klanten leert kennen.

  • Een plek waar je vanaf dag 1 invloed hebt op de aanpak, de processen en de richting.

  • Collega's met diepgaande kennis van stoffen en regelgeving, van wie je elke dag leert.

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden naar Teamlead, Key Accountmanager of Propositiemanager.

  • Een salaris vanaf €4.477 per maand, op basis van een werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een variabele bonusregeling die kan oplopen tot 30% van je jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar aan extra vakantiedagen of salaris.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een leaseauto of een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer, en een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor een reisafstand onder de 10 km of boven de 60 km geldt een aangepaste regeling.

  • Thuiswerkvergoeding en hybride werken: reken op 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag.

MEER WETEN?

Benieuwd hoe Toxic werkt? Kijk alvast op toxic.nl/en. We vertellen je graag meer over het team en de rol. Stuur je cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog vragen? App of bel Mak via +31 6 18 60 98 89.

title: (Senior) Accountant/ Buchhalter*in (all genders) in Berlin
descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du arbeitest in unserem Finance-Team und verantwortest die korrekte und zuverlässige Buchung der Geschäftsvorfälle unserer Gesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Accounting-Team stellst du sicher, dass notwendige Zahlungen in allen Unternehmensbereichen korrekt abgewickelt und verbucht werden. Der Einsatz moderner Software-Lösungen beschleunigt und digitalisiert unsere Prozesse. Du nimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Unternehmen ein und stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen.

Diese Position richtet sich an eine Person, die eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, Prozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und gemeinsam mit Homaris langfristig wachsen möchte.

What You'll Do

Geschäftsvorfälle prüfen und buchen. Du stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Geschäftsvorfälle in DATEV korrekt erfasst werden.

Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung verantworten. Du erfasst die Vorgänge ordnungsgemäß und betreust außerdem die Anlagen- und Bankbuchhaltung.

Zahlungseingänge und Zahlläufe steuern. Du kontrollierst die Zahlungseingänge und erstellst die erforderlichen Zahlläufe.

Steuermeldungen übermitteln. Du übermittelst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen und Übernachtungssteuererklärungen.

Konten abstimmen. Du führst Abstimmarbeiten im Sachkonten-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbereich sowie für Intercompany-Konten durch.

Abschlüsse vorbereiten. Du übernimmst vorbereitende Tätigkeiten und arbeitest bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit.

Kreditkartenabrechnungen bearbeiten. Du bearbeitest und buchst die Kreditkartenabrechnungen über Pleo.

Prozesse digital weiterentwickeln. Du optimierst proaktiv Prozesse und erhöhst dabei den Digitalisierungsgrad.

What Makes You a Fit

Relevante Ausbildung und Erfahrung. Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung.

Kenntnisse im deutschen Rechnungswesen. Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGB und des Umsatzsteuergesetzes.

DATEV-Erfahrung. Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware DATEV mit.

Weiterbildung als Pluspunkt. Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung zum/zur geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) abgeschlossen.

Digitale Sicherheit. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, und offen für eine digitale Arbeitsumgebung.

Eigenständigkeit und Teamgeist. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich, bist zugleich teamfähig und schaust gerne über den eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus.

Verbesserungsorientierung. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Interesse daran, deinen Bereich aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Sprachkenntnisse. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B1-Niveau.

KI-Affinität. Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst ihr Potenzial und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann.

Präsenz. Du arbeitest in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu kommen. Du arbeitest gerne persönlich mit anderen zusammen – denn genau so entsteht gute Arbeit.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir nehmen uns Zeit, alle Bewerbungen sorgfältig zu prüfen, daher kann es 1-2 Wochen dauern, bis wir uns bei dir zurückmelden. Wir bitten dich um ein wenig Geduld und danken dir dafür!

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Naomi unter oder +49 1579 2465851.

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Kulturen und Hintergründe.

title: Senior AI Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As a Senior AI Deployment Strategist, you will bridge the gap between vision and execution, ensuring our customers not only see the potential of AI but realize its value in their operations. This role is a unique blend of strategic advisory and hands-on deployment leadership, spanning both presales and postsales phases. You will act as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, architecting AI solutions that drive transformation and delivering measurable business outcomes.

 

You will be embedded in our most strategic accounts, diagnosing business challenges, designing AI-powered solutions, and leading their deployment from concept to full-scale adoption. This role demands a rare combination of executive presence, technical credibility, and commercial acumen, with a focus on both winning and delivering high-impact AI initiatives.

 

What You Will Do

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Required Education/Certification:

    • Bachelors Degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • Technical Skills & Tools (Must-Haves):

    • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

    • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

    • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

    • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Core Competencies & Scope:

    • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

    • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

    • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

    • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

Nice to Have Traits for this Role

  • Geospatial data experience: routing, geocoding, POI or address data, OpenStreetMap, or conflation of overlapping sources.

  • Public API or SDK design experience, particularly for developers you never talk to.

  • Experience building against MCP or similar tool transports.

  • Experience running evals in CI, with a commercial harness or one you built.

  • Automotive, in-vehicle infotainment, CarPlay, or Android Auto experience.

  • Voice pipeline experience: streaming ASR, TTS, barge-in, endpointing, wake word.

  • Work under constrained compute, offline, or intermittent connectivity.

  • Experience operating a product through its first external integrations, where the customer finds the gaps before you do.

Employment Requirements

  • Employment Type: Full-time

  • Weekly Hours: 40 h per week

  • Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany)

What We Value

In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders:

  • We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities.

  • We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people.

  • We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company.

  • We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply.

 

How we support you

  • Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable.

  • Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits.

  • Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family.

  • Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth

  • Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents.

  • Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies.

  • Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have received the Mapbox Non-US Privacy Notice for applicants, which is linked here. Completing this application requires you to provide personal data, such as your name and contact information, which is mandatory for Mapbox to process your application.

We are committed to a fair and equitable hiring process. We do not discriminate against any protected class.

title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations EMEA (L3)
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Role outline

Proposed title: Senior Associate, Dasher & Logistics - Strategy & Operations

Location: London Head Office (The River Building) - Hybrid working (60% in Head Office)

Mission: Ensure a reliable and scalable courier network across EMEA markets by continuously optimising the end-to-end lifecycle experience. You will translate data-driven insights into practical actions that strengthen engagement, performance, and long-term participation. Your role is to maintain the right balance of supply to meet changing operational and customer demand across markets.

Core interfaces: EMEA Dasher & Logistics Operations (Regional Operations, Planning & Performance, Content & Engagement), Product, Data Science, Analytics Engineering as needed.

Job Description (ready to paste into Greenhouse)

The team

The EMEA Strategy & Operations team is responsible for ensuring our Dasher network remains stable, engaged, and responsive across multiple markets. We oversee the processes behind courier onboarding and activation, focusing on enabling new couriers to get started successfully and supporting ongoing participation over time.

Our mission is to maintain a reliable and adaptable supply base that can flex in line with changing customer and operational demand. We combine data insights, operational strategy, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure our network remains healthy, resilient, and ready to scale.

The role

As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role in shaping the performance and stability of our courier network across multiple markets. You will focus on supporting the teams responsible for onboarding and activation through data driven insights.

This is a fast-paced and high-impact role, centred on understanding network dynamics, identifying emerging risks or opportunities, and implementing effective operational responses. You will be accountable for maintaining a healthy and responsive supply base throughout the lifecycle, ensuring it aligns with business and customer needs.

You will operate as a hands-on operator, executing upon team initiatives and driving continuous improvement. Working closely with cross-functional partners across operations, product, analytics, and other central teams, you will translate data and insights into scalable processes and frameworks. 

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience delivering operational improvements through complex data analysis and modelling in fast-paced environments. You have a track record of identifying gaps or opportunities and working across teams to build scalable solutions.
  • Strong analytical capability. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, structuring problems clearly and using data to inform decisions and prioritisation.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and confidence working with large datasets. You can use data to answer business questions and track performance, combining strong logical thinking with the ability to learn quickly. Experience building dashboards or automating reporting is a plus.
  • Confidence using AI tools to improve how work gets done. You can integrate AI into existing processes to improve efficiency and the quality of outputs, applying sound judgement to validate results.
  • A strong bias for outcomes. You focus on delivering impact, measuring results, and iterating based on evidence and learning.

Preferred, but not required

  • Familiarity with experimentation, measurement design, and operational change management.
  • You have experience using basic automation tools (like Zapier, smart spreadsheets, or basic scripts) to automate repetitive tasks and build simple systems that handle high-volume operations.
  • Experience with courier, logistics, or gig economy operations.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to be the definitive food company. We are transforming the way the world eats by making food more convenient and accessible. We are a technology-driven company working at pace, with the autonomy to build, test, and ship. If you enjoy solving messy problems and turning them into scalable systems, you will find plenty to do here.

Location and working pattern

This role is based in our London Head Office (The River Building) and follows our hybrid working approach, with an expectation of around 60% of your time in the office. We aim to be flexible where possible, balancing individual needs with collaboration, stakeholder engagement, and delivery.

Benefits and diversity

At Deliveroo, people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer a wide range of competitive benefits across health, family, finance, community, growth, and time away.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. We welcome people from all backgrounds and identities. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of building one of the fastest growing technology businesses in an exciting space.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
