title: Azure Cloud Security Senior Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

You will be joining NVISO’s Cloud Security team as an Azure Cloud Security Senior Consultant (m/w/d). The ideal candidate has knowledge in Azure cloud services, with a particular focus on security.

As part of a team of security consultants and engineers, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues and our customers to understand their business and security requirements, assess their current security posture, and develop tailored cloud security solutions for them.

Responsibilities

We are aware that cloud security features and products are abundant; the following list apply to the ones of interest to us. If you have experience or feel capable of conducting only some of them (not the full list), please reach out!

Strategy and Governance

  • Assess cloud security posture against frameworks (e.g., CIS, NIST, ISO 27001) and Microsoft benchmarks (Azure Security Benchmark, M365 baseline).

  • Define cloud security strategy, target operating model, and roadmap aligned to business and regulatory requirements.

  • Develop and maintain cloud security policies, standards, and guardrails for Azure and M365.

Identity and Access Management (IAM)

  • Design and implement Microsoft Entra tenant architecture, including identity lifecycle, conditional access, and MFA.

  • Implement and tune Conditional Access policies, risk-based access, and device compliance integrations with Intune/Endpoint Manager.

  • Deploy and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including PIM for Azure and M365 roles, just-in-time access, and break-glass accounts.

  • Integrate on-premises identities (hybrid) with secure synchronization and hardening of federation where used.

Platform Security and Hardening (Azure)

  • Build secure landing zones using Azure Policy, Blueprints/Bicep/Terraform, and management groups.

  • Enforce baseline controls for networking (NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link), compute (secure images, patching), and storage (encryption, private endpoints).

  • Configure Azure Key Vault for secrets, keys, and certificates management with RBAC and purge protection.

  • Ensure encryption at rest and in transit, customer-managed keys (CMK), and double encryption where required.

  • Implement workload isolation, tagging, and resource locks; manage identity-based access (managed identities).

Threat Protection and Monitoring

  • Deploy and tune Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Cloud Apps (MCAS), Defender for Endpoint, and Defender for Identity.

  • Configure Microsoft Sentinel: data connectors, analytics rules, UEBA, watchlists, workbooks, and SOAR playbooks (Logic Apps).

  • Develop detection use cases, threat hunting queries (KQL), and incident response runbooks specific to Azure and M365 threats.

  • Establish alert triage, escalation paths, and continuous tuning to reduce noise and improve mean time to detect/respond.

Microsoft 365 Security – (Nice to have)

  • Configure and manage Microsoft Purview (Compliance portal) for DLP, information protection labels, data lifecycle, and insider risk.

  • Implement Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams security baselines, safe links/attachments, and anti-phishing policies.

  • Enforce device compliance via Intune, app protection policies, and conditional access for BYOD and corporate devices.

  • Secure collaboration and external sharing with sensitivity labels, access reviews, and entitlement management.

Data Protection and Encryption – (Nice to have)

  • Design data classification and labelling strategies with Microsoft Purview; enforce DLP across endpoints, Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams.

  • Implement eDiscovery, legal hold, and audit configurations for regulatory needs.

Requirements

  • You hold a citizenship of a NATO member state or the Austrian citizenship;

  • At least 3 years of experience in information security specific to Azure or Microsoft 365 cloud environments.

  • Proven expertise with Microsoft’s cloud security services, including Entra ID, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Identity, Intune, and/or Purview.

  • Experience with cloud security best practices and related frameworks. For example: CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark, etc.

  • Strong communication, documentation and reporting skills.

  • Relevant current Microsoft cloud certifications. For example: AZ-104, SC-900, SC-200, SC-300, SC-401, or SC-500.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or related studies.

  • Experience in consulting.

  • Other vendor-agnostic cybersecurity certifications. E.g. SSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent.

  • Experience with scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python.

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working with and learning from the best people in the European cyber security “scene”. We have several SANS Instructors working for us and we are also represented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc.). In addition, our employees can take advantage of prestigious continuing education opportunities (GSE, GXPN, CISSP, OSCP, etc.);

  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;

  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 69.000 EUR p.a. – 91.000 EUR p.a.;

  • Regular team-building and fun events;

  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!

  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);

  • Business Bike Leasing;

  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;

  • 30 holidays;

  • Company Pension Scheme;

descriptionHtml:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The Buyer Domain at Vinted is dedicated to creating a seamless and highly engaging experience for our members as they search, discover, and purchase items. Our challenge is unique: unlike standard e-commerce, our peer-to-peer catalogue consists of hundreds of millions of entirely unique, single-inventory listings, with millions of new items uploaded daily. Connecting the right buyer with the perfect item in real-time is at the very core of Vinted's success.

The CVP team owns the core platform and services that govern how content is geofenced, balanced, and surfaced across Vinted's growing international network of markets. We build robust systems and tooling that manage cross-border visibility, enabling smooth and gradual market connections (e.g., FR-DE, BE-FR-ES) while optimising key liquidity metrics like Sell-Through Rate (STR%) and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) by balancing the content in multiple channels.

Our team works closely with Content Visibility Management, Search, and Recommender relevance teams to accelerate product development. Currently, we are driving the automation of content visibility experimentation & analysis. Rather than having different content channels independently re-implement visibility controls, we are building a unified platform to provide autonomy to Decision Scientists. In addition, we are highly contributing in growing new large markets such as the USA and Australia.

In this position, you’ll 

  • Drive technical execution: Design, implement, and maintain highly scalable, reliable, and secure backend systems to ensure efficient content visibility and search mechanisms.
  • Guide technical decisions: Contribute to and challenge the technical direction of our backend services, leading system design reviews and ensuring high-quality, maintainable code.
  • Scale features globally: Implement and shape A/B tested features that positively impact our 80+ million users. Code changes are rolled out instantly to production.
  • Own your services: Monitor and improve backend service performance and stability. The team owns and monitors service-layer measurements (SLIs, SLOs, etc.) and has an on-call rotation which you will participate in.
  • Lead team-level initiatives: Lead and drive technical initiatives within the team, while collaborating on domain-wide integrations with other engineering teams (such as Search and Recommender relevance teams).
  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with engineering and product managers, analysts, and other stakeholders, facilitating clear communication within the team and across domains.
  • Contribute to product direction: Provide technical feasibility assessments, identify technical risks, and provide effort estimations to help shape our team's product roadmap.
  • Foster engineering excellence: Mentor, guide, and share knowledge with other engineers in the team to support their technical growth and promote collaborative best practices

About you 

  • You have extensive experience in backend software engineering, with a proven track record of designing and building scalable, distributed, and highly available systems.
  • You are highly proficient in backend development. We primarily use Go, Kotlin, Ruby, Python — while prior experience in these specific languages is beneficial, a strong foundation in modern backend engineering and a willingness to learn is what matters most.
  • Experience with event streaming platforms like Kafka, Apache Flink, or others for real-time data processing and message queueing.
  • A track record working with search engines, information retrieval and ranking optimisations technologies (e.g., Vespa, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch) is a high advantage. If not, we expect you to have a strong willingness and motivation to learn.
  • You are enthusiastic about AI technologies, use AI tools daily in your work, and proactively learn and experiment with how to adopt AI to boost engineering outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of continuous integration and deployment pipelines, with experience in tools like Jenkins for automating builds and deployments.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools (we use Grafana, Kibana, and others) to keep services healthy and define SLIs/SLOs.
  • Experience working with relational and in-memory databases.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with experience working with cross-functional peers (Product, Analytics, SRE).
  • Experience in mentoring other engineers, providing constructive feedback, and promoting engineering best practices within your team.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Work perks 

  • The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
  • 25 days of paid annual leave
  • Newest MacBook models
  • Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
  • Frequent team-building events

  • Monthly budget for a flexible benefits platform
  • Work from Home allowance
  • Collective Defined Contribution Pension plan
  • A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted
  • An NS mobility card
  • A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
descriptionHtml:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

  • Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • The ability to move quickly and independently. This is a hands-on delivery role with clear scope, not an architecture or advisory engagement.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You are passionate about building systems that serve other engineers.

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis.

  • 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options.

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Core skills test: An async AI-assisted programming test to assess your coding fundamentals.

  3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute chat deep diving into your experience.

  4. Pleo Challenge: A 75-minute system design interview focusing on your architecture, infrastructure and problem-solving skills.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI - it’s a big focus for us internally too- but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you - not AI - know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.

  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • This role focuses heavily on building services for internal / external users consumption. It is absolutely critical to have extensive API design and development experience, expertise in OLAP systems and to be able to work in Kotlin. Ensure your CV reflects clearly of the actual experience you have across those areas.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior Bids Manager
descriptionHtml:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

We are looking for a strategic and ambitious Senior Bids Manager to lead our most complex, high-value opportunities across the public and private sectors. At Faculty, we are transforming how organisations operate using AI, and you will be at the heart of this mission.

You will orchestrate end-to-end bid processes, distilling technical brilliance into persuasive, customer-centric proposals. As a core role within our Central Sales function, you will drive revenue growth and refine the frameworks that empower Faculty to win and scale our global impact.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading the end-to-end bid lifecycle for high-value strategic opportunities, from initial kick-off through to final presentation. You're comfortable both writing and managing bids when needed.

  • Driving critical Bid/No Bid evaluations and defining comprehensive resource requirements to ensure we pursue the right opportunities with excellence.

  • Crafting high-quality, persuasive prose by synthesising intricate technical and commercial information into compelling value propositions.

  • Collaborating with senior subject matter experts and C-suite stakeholders to align complex bid strategies with Faculty’s broader commercial objectives.

  • Optimising our bid operations by identifying process improvements and implementing best practices for framework management and tender monitoring.

  • Mentoring junior bid managers and co-ordinators, fostering a culture of technical excellence, professional growth and continuous learning.

  • Facilitating milestone meetings and managing client interactions to ensure clarity, alignment, and high-quality outcomes throughout the delivery phase.

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring advanced experience in managing large-scale, complex bids within the private or public sectors, backed by a proven track record of success.

  • You possess exceptional communication skills, with a flair for translating sophisticated AI concepts into clear, actionable, and persuasive narratives for diverse audiences.

  • You are a natural relationship-builder, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders to extract high-quality insights under tight deadlines.

  • You exhibit a highly organised and proactive mindset, thriving in fast-paced environments where you can navigate multiple priorities with scientific rigour.

  • You demonstrate strong commercial acumen and a strategic lens, allowing you to identify market opportunities and drive meaningful business growth.

  • You lead with integrity and a collaborative spirit, enjoying the process of guiding team members and contributing to a high-performing, inclusive culture.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction interview with Hiring Manager (45 mins)

  3. Written / Take Home Task

  4. Final Panel Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

  • Programming: Production experience in C++ and Python, working with CMake, Git, and shell scripting.

Beneficial Skills

  • Vision-Based Manipulation: Experience using camera input to guide grasping or manipulation, for example grasp pose estimation or visual servoing.

  • Motion Control: Working knowledge of robot motion planning and control.

title: Consultant Digitale Transformatie
descriptionHtml:
Bouw mee aan succesvolle IT-projecten bij ambitieuze MKB-organisaties

Digital Motions helpt MKB-bedrijven bij complexe IT-vraagstukken, softwareselecties en implementaties. Veel organisaties starten een softwareselectie terwijl processen nog niet scherp zijn, belangen uiteenlopen en verwachtingen verschillen. Daardoor worden verkeerde keuzes gemaakt, ontstaan discussies tijdens implementaties en wordt software aangepast aan processen die eigenlijk eerst verbeterd hadden moeten worden.

Bij Digital Motions geloven wij dat succesvolle digitale transformaties beginnen met inzicht, structuur en draagvlak. Daarom brengen wij processen, mensen en technologie samen voordat software wordt gekozen.

Voor deze vraagstukken zoeken wij een Senior Consultant Digitale Transformatie.

Taken

Jouw rol

Jij helpt organisaties om de juiste softwarekeuzes te maken door bedrijfsprocessen, knelpunten en behoeften helder in kaart te brengen. Daarmee draag je bij aan een goede voorbereiding van softwareselecties en succesvolle implementaties.

Je werkt zelfstandig met management, key-users en proceseigenaren. Je begeleidt workshops, stelt kritische vragen en brengt structuur aan in bedrijfsprocessen en klantvraagstukken. Je helpt organisaties om verbeterkansen te herkennen en keuzes te maken die aansluiten bij hun dagelijkse praktijk.

Samen met collega's vertaal je deze inzichten naar duidelijke requirements en software-uitvragen. Je bent betrokken bij de beoordeling van softwareleveranciers tijdens demo's, leverancierssessies en fit-gap analyses. Daarbij werk je volgens de methodiek van Digital Motions en stem je complexe vraagstukken af met ervaren collega's.

Je werkzaamheden

In deze rol werk je aan de inhoudelijke voorbereiding en uitvoering van softwareselecties en IT-transformaties. De belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Analyseren van werkprocessen, knelpunten, afhankelijkheden en verbeterkansen.

  • Zelfstandig begeleiden van werksessies met management, key-users en proceseigenaren.

  • Ontwerpen en uitwerken van huidige en gewenste processen, procesflows en matrices.

  • Vertalen van bedrijfsprocessen en klantbehoeften naar requirements, prioriteiten en beoordelingscriteria.

  • Meewerken aan het opstellen van software-uitvragen richting leveranciers.

  • Begeleiden en ondersteunen van leveranciersdemo's, fit-gap analyses en inhoudelijke verdiepende sessies.

  • Signaleren van risico's, afhankelijkheden en besluitpunten en deze bespreken met het projectteam.

Vereisten

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken een consultant die processen bij bedrijven in productie, handel en installatie begrijpt en helpt om structuur aan te brengen in uiteenlopende vraagstukken. Analytisch vermogen is belangrijk, maar niet genoeg. Deze rol vraagt ook om adviesvaardigheden, communicatieve kracht en het vermogen om mensen mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je begeleidt zelfstandig klantworkshops, stelt kritische vragen en weet bedrijfsprocessen en klantbehoeften helder in kaart te brengen.

Een sterke kandidaat luistert goed, vraagt door en vertaalt informatie naar duidelijke inzichten en praktische oplossingen. We zoeken geen procesnotulist, maar een consultant die inhoud toevoegt, initiatief neemt en klanten helpt om betere keuzes te maken.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring als business consultant, procesconsultant, business analist, ERP-consultant of implementatieconsultant.

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en optimaliseren van bedrijfsprocessen en het zelfstandig begeleiden van workshops.

  • Vaardigheid in het ontwerpen en uitwerken van bedrijfsprocessen, procesflows en procesdocumentatie.

  • Affiniteit met de implementatie van applicaties zoals ERP, WMS, PLM, PIM en aanverwante software in operationele processen.

  • Kennis van softwareselectie- en implementatietrajecten.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden richting management, key-users, leveranciers en andere stakeholders.

  • Een gestructureerde manier van werken, eigenaarschap en een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard.

Benefits

Wat bieden wij?

Een rol voor 32 of 40 uur per week met veel verantwoordelijkheid, directe klantimpact en ruimte om mee te bouwen aan Digital Motions.

  • Uitdagende opdrachten bij MKB-organisaties in productie, handel en installatie, waar je direct impact maakt op bedrijfsprocessen en digitale transformaties.

  • Een ondernemende werkomgeving met een klein, ambitieus team, korte lijnen en veel autonomie. Je krijgt direct klantcontact, werkt volgens onze eigen bewezen methodiek en hebt volop ruimte om mee te bouwen aan de verdere groei van Digital Motions.

  • Een team waarin kennisdeling, samenwerking en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan.

  • Samen lunchen op kantoor, kennisdelingssessies en leuke teamactiviteiten.

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van € 4.500 tot € 5.600 op basis van een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur per week, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.

  • Een jaarlijkse bonusregeling tot maximaal 150% van één bruto maandsalaris, gekoppeld aan persoonlijke bijdrage, klantresultaat en de ontwikkeling van Digital Motions.

  • 28 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Een goede mobiliteitsregeling passend bij de rol en klantwerkzaamheden.

  • Een collectieve pensioenregeling.

  • Laptop, telefoon en alle middelen die je nodig hebt om professioneel te werken.

Wanneer pas je goed bij ons?

Je voelt je thuis bij Digital Motions als je graag wilt werken in een klein, gedreven team met ambitie om te groeien. Samenwerken is vanzelfsprekend, daarom helpen we elkaar, delen we actief kennis en geven we elkaar eerlijke feedback om continu te blijven groeien.

Deze rol vraagt om zelfstandigheid, een kritische blik en het vermogen om met verschillende stakeholders samen te werken. Je durft vragen te stellen, denkt actief mee met klanten en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werkzaamheden. Je weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer het waardevol is om met collega's te overleggen.

We zijn succesvol omdat we dicht bij onze klanten staan. Je bent regelmatig aanwezig bij klanten om processen te analyseren, workshops te begeleiden en samen met stakeholders verbeteringen vorm te geven. Op kantoor werken we bewust samen aan kennisdeling, projectafstemming en de verdere ontwikkeling van onze methodiek. We werken hard, vieren onze successen samen en staan voor elkaar klaar wanneer dat nodig is.

About the team:

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both our existing products and the planned launch of new initiatives. We aim to create a genuine feel-good factor when it comes to personal credit, and we’re looking for driven, analytical and creative individuals to help us achieve this goal.

We’re great believers in powerful, real-time analytics and empowering the wider business. All our data lives in one place and is easy to use. Over 90% of day-to-day data-driven decisions are supported through self-serve analytics in Looker, giving analysts the headspace to focus on solving high-impact business problems.

Our Credit Platform squad builds the shared infrastructure that powers lending decisioning across Monzo. We develop the core credit valuation (NPV) infrastructure, decisioning capabilities and data foundations that enable our Product Credit teams to develop, evaluate and deploy lending strategies across products and markets. As we scale internationally, our platform is at the heart of delivering consistent, scalable credit capabilities globally. You'll lead a team of five Credit Analysts, shaping the evolution of our platform, pushing the boundaries to unlock the next generation of lending capabilities and drive efficiencies.

Join a team where your ideas can rapidly transform into reality, leveraging our cutting-edge technology and agile ways of working. Credit Platform is a cross-functional squad bringing together Credit, Product, Engineering and Data expertise to build shared capabilities that power Borrowing across Monzo. 

How you’ll contribute:

  • Shape our Credit Platform: Define the roadmap for Monzo's Credit Platform, evolving the shared infrastructure that enables Product Credit teams to develop, evaluate and deploy lending strategies across our retail and business lending products in the UK and new global markets.

  • Build Credit Valuation Infrastructure: Lead the evolution of the infrastructure that supports Monzo's credit valuation capabilities, including our NPV modelling framework, ensuring it is scalable, reliable and enables Product Credit teams to optimise lending economics.

  • Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team: Hire, coach and develop a high-performing team of Credit Analysts, fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership and continuous improvement while delivering platform capabilities with broad organisational impact.

  • Partner Across Monzo: Work closely with Credit, Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, Data and Risk teams to build platform capabilities that accelerate experimentation, simplify strategy deployment and improve the speed and quality of credit decisioning.

  • Influence Through Technical Leadership: Represent the Credit Platform across Monzo, translating complex technical concepts into clear recommendations for senior leaders and helping shape the future direction of our lending platform.

  • You understand lending economics inside out, with deep experience in NPV modelling and the infrastructure and frameworks that enable effective credit decisioning
  • You are highly motivated by fast-paced environments, enjoy ambiguity, designing frameworks from scratch, and delivering meaningful change.
  • You are an exceptional cross-functional leader who thrives when partnering with Engineering, Product, Risk, Machine Learning and Credit teams to deliver shared platform capabilities.
  • You have a track record of leading and developing analytical talent, and you are excited by the prospect of leading a high-impact team.

title: Senior CRM Manager
descriptionHtml:
We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

London (hybrid, 3 days in office)

 

CRM at Marshmallow

CRM sits within the User Experience team, helping Marshmallow build more effective, joined-up communication with our customers across the business. CRM is a meaningful driver of impact for the organisation, with clear opportunities to improve how we engage customers and measure the value of that work.

This role will help shape how CRM is used at Marshmallow by building strong foundations, enabling others to use the platform effectively, and creating the governance needed to make customer communications work better across multiple teams. We’re looking for someone who is excited by ownership, enjoys working cross-functionally, and wants to help scale CRM in a thoughtful, high-impact way. This is an individual contributor role with deep platform and governance ownership, rather than a people-management track. Your impact and progression come from the scale and quality of the systems, frameworks, and cross-team relationships you build, not from growing a team.

What you'll be doing

  • Own and evolve Marshmallow’s CRM operations capability, helping shape how the platform is used across the organisation.

  • Build strong governance frameworks for CRM activity, including how campaigns are prioritised, sequenced, and managed across teams

  • Enable and support stakeholders across the business to use CRM effectively, increasing adoption while maintaining quality and consistency.

  • Partner cross-functionally with teams across the organisation to identify opportunities, align on priorities, and improve customer communications.

  • Use data and testing insights to inform decisions, optimise performance, and ensure CRM activity is driving measurable impact

  • Drive high-quality campaign execution through strong operational processes, audience segmentation, scheduling, and platform management.

Who you are

  • You’re a self-starter who is comfortable with a high level of autonomy and enjoys taking ownership of ambiguous, high-impact work.

  • You’re curious and collaborative, and you like working with lots of different stakeholders to move work forward.

  • You’re someone who believes in enabling others, not gatekeeping expertise, and you’re motivated by helping teams do better work together

  • You’re commercially minded and pragmatic, with a strong instinct for where to focus your time to unlock the most value

What you'll bring

  • Experience working in CRM operations or CRM management within an in-house, tech-led business, with a strong understanding of growth-focused customer communications.

  • Recent hands-on experience with Braze is preferable for the role, alongside practical experience building and managing CRM campaigns, segmentation, metadata, scheduling, and audience setup

  • Proven experience creating CRM governance and enabling other teams to use CRM effectively across an organisation

  • Strong data literacy, including analysing campaign or email test performance, pulling audiences and segments, and working independently with data rather than relying entirely on analyst support.

  • Confidence in using data tools or AI-assisted analysis to generate insights and support decision-making.

Perks of the job

  • Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance

  • Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva

  • Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year

  • Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose

  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

  • 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year

 

We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position.

 

Our process

  • Initial call with a member from our Talent Team (30 mins)

  • Past Experience interview with Hiring Manager (60 mins)

  • Onsite case study interview with a couple of the team (90 mins)

  • Culture interview (60 mins)

Diversity of thought

We know the best ideas come from having different perspectives in the room - and we're committed to hiring fairly, regardless of background, identity or experience. If you see yourself in this role, we'd encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (m/f/x)
descriptionHtml:
Please Note: This is a future-planning talent pool rather than an active, immediate opening. We’re gathering expressions of interest ahead of upcoming headcount so we can build a warm community of great people! Feel free to submit your details below, we’ll keep your profile on our radar and reach right out as soon as this role officially goes live.

About commercetools

Real innovation starts with a strong foundation, and at commercetools, that comes from the perfect balance of our product and our people.

Behind every leap forward is a collective of builders, explorers, doers, makers, and problem-solvers. The kind of people who not only created composable commerce but also shaped the culture of experimentation that idea unlocked. Together they are the engine of commerce innovation today.

At commercetools, we power the next era of commerce for our customers. Whether it’s AI-driven solutions that help enterprises make smarter business decisions, bridging digital and physical shopping experiences, or enabling entirely new ways for industries to connect with their customers, we help the world’s most ambitious companies experiment, scale, and grow without limits.

Here the best idea wins, not the loudest voice. You will have the tools, trust, and space to not only build the future of commerce, but to build your own.

Über unser Customer Success Team

Hallo! Ich bin Enrico, Customer Success Team Lead bei commercetools. Mein Team konzentriert sich auf den Aufbau langfristiger, beratungsorientierter Partnerschaften mit unseren Enterprise-Kunden.

Unser Customer Success Team gestaltet und skaliert mit Leidenschaft eine außergewöhnliche Upmarket Customer Experience im gesamten Enterprise-Segment. Im Zuge unseres weiteren Wachstums freuen wir uns darauf, unser Team in EMEA um eine:n Senior Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) zu erweitern.

In dieser Rolle bilden Sie das entscheidende Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und den modernsten Commerce-Produkten auf dem Markt. Sie betreuen unsere größten und komplexesten Enterprise-Kunden – von schnell wachsenden Marken bis hin zu börsennotierten Unternehmen. Dabei konzentrieren Sie sich auf Account Health, die Post-Sales-Adoption und die Positionierung von commercetools als vertrauenswürdigen strategischen Partner.

Sie arbeiten eng mit unseren internen Support-, Produkt- und Vertriebsteams zusammen, um optimale Voraussetzungen für den Erfolg unserer Kunden zu schaffen. Da commercetools leistungsstark, modern und hochgradig flexibel ist, setzen Sie Ihr tiefes technisches Verständnis, Ihre Vertriebsaffinität und Ihre erstklassigen Kommunikationsfähigkeiten ein, um große Marken bei der Gestaltung außergewöhnlicher Commerce-Workflows zu unterstützen und langfristigen Mehrwert zu schaffen.

Über das Account Management hinaus tragen Sie aktiv dazu bei, unsere Customer-Success-Praxis sowohl regional als auch global mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln.

Wenn Sie bereit sind, innovative Lösungen für bekannte Marken voranzutreiben, die Kundenkommunikation über verschiedene Kanäle hinweg zu steuern und in einer einflussreichen Rolle aufzublühen, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

Der Interviewprozess für diese Position findet auf Englisch statt. Wir suchen daher eine Person, die sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch sicher mit unseren Kunden kommunizieren kann.

Ihre Mission

  • Sie begleiten Enterprise-Kunden dabei, den Mehrwert unserer Agentic-Commerce-Architektur – einschließlich Composable Commerce, Frontend und Connect – zu maximieren und flexible, zukunftssichere Tech-Stacks aufzubauen.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager - DACH
descriptionHtml:
About You


You're a jack-of-all-trades with a passion for cool technology and interacting with people and making them happy. You're a self-starter who's good at triaging problems and working on the most important one. You've worked directly with customers for a long time and are comfortable being the face of the company to them. One of the things that pleases you most in life is customers successfully using your product, being thrilled with its value, and telling you they're happy they partnered with you. Further, you're a curious person, and you'd love the opportunity to work with a technology team that includes data scientists, algorithm experts, back-end and front-end engineers to expand your knowledge.

About Us

Constructor.io powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you've probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We're approximately doubling year over year despite the market slow down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We're a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

About The Position

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll be joining a rapidly growing team that helps our customers increase their revenue by improving the search and product discovery experiences of their websites and mobile apps through integrating with our services.

Your specific responsibilities will include:

  • Own the customer journey from project kick-off, launch, adoption, and ongoing value realization, ensuring customers achieve meaningful business outcomes and are delighted with the partnership.

  • Build trusted relationships across complex enterprise organizations, engaging confidently with stakeholders ranging from engineers, data and product teams to Heads and Directors of Ecommerce, Digital, Product, and Technology, as well as VP and C-level executives.

  • Understand the goals, priorities, and influence of different customer personas, and align technical and business stakeholders around a shared success plan.

  • Translate technical concepts, product capabilities, and performance data into clear business value, connecting Constructor’s work to outcomes such as conversion, revenue, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

  • Plan and lead effective QBRs and EBRs that go beyond reporting: communicate measurable impact, facilitate strategic conversations, make recommendations, and align stakeholders on priorities and next steps.

  • Identify risks, blockers, and changing customer priorities early. Lead escalations with clarity and urgency by defining the business impact, engaging the right internal teams, setting expectations, and maintaining customer confidence through resolution.

  • Advocate effectively for customer needs while exercising strong judgment about when engineering involvement is required, how requests should be prioritized, and when an alternative solution can deliver the desired outcome.

  • Use customer insights, performance data, and ecommerce best practices to provide proactive, strategic recommendations, not simply respond to requests.

  • Maintain clear success plans, stakeholder maps, account documentation, training materials, and agreed actions so that both the customer and Constructor teams remain aligned.

  • Partner closely with Account Management to support retention and growth by demonstrating value, strengthening executive relationships, and identifying opportunities to expand the partnership.

  • Continuously improve how we onboard, integrate, and support customers, sharing repeatable best practices that make our processes more scalable and the customer experience more effective.

Requirements

  • Based in EMEA, ideally in the DACH region —particularly Germany. Fluency in German is an advantage but not required.

  • At least three years of experience managing relationships with enterprise customers in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or a similar customer-facing role.

  • Experience working with complex enterprise organizations and building trusted relationships with stakeholders ranging from technical teams and product leaders to Ecommerce Directors, VPs, and C-level executives.

  • Strong executive presence and the confidence to lead strategic customer conversations, including QBRs and EBRs.

  • Strong influencing and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to create momentum and drive progress without direct authority.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly in a fast-moving, technically sophisticated environment.

  • Experience in ecommerce, digital commerce, search, product discovery, or a related field is highly valued.

Benefits

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year

title: Senior Data Center Pre-Construction and Capacity Delivery Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Anthropic

Anthropic's mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Senior Data Center Preconstruction & Capacity Delivery Manager at Anthropic, you'll make sure our EMEA deals are ready to execute before we commit to them, and you'll take time out of every program before the lease is signed. Delivery dates and costs on AI infrastructure deals are largely fixed at signature. What is missed before then is hard to recover afterwards, and our leverage over the schedule is at its highest while the deal is still open.

About 75% of your time goes to preconstruction and pre-lease management, from first desktop review through Letter of Intent (LOI) to lease execution. You'll test whether each opportunity can be delivered, rigorously accelerate its program, and shape the deal so that what a developer commits to can be held to, verified and delivered.

The other 25% goes to delivery. You'll carry that work through mobilization, embed with the partners building leased and partnered capacity, and lead them to deliver on the fastest possible schedule while maintaining a safe construction site and protecting the finished quality of the data center.

Our EMEA pipeline is getting off the ground, so you'll set the standard for how deals become ready for execution here. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Anthropic secures and activates the compute infrastructure needed to train and deploy frontier AI systems, working at the intersection of real estate, construction, and cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

Responsibilities - preconstruction and pre-lease management (about 75%):

  • Lead.  This is a role where leadership trumps management and process.  You will be expected to engage developers, contractors, utilities and our transaction teams early enough to shape the outcome of each deal rather than report on it afterwards.

  • Confirm deal readiness and serve as the gatekeeper to validate transaction viability from LOI through lease execution, ensuring all predevelopment, planning, technical and business requirements are met before commitment

  • Give transaction leads an early delivery view from desktop study on capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, schedule and cost, so that the sites moving to LOI are ones that can be delivered

  • Run independent, evidence-based delivery due diligence on each opportunity, tested against source documents rather than relayed claims, covering capacity, power, permitting, connectivity, procurement, schedule, cost, and whether the developer's team, contractors and supply chain can deliver

  • Interrogate every developer schedule from the native file rather than summary dates, testing logic, durations, production rates and critical paths, planning backwards from commissioning, and establishing the unconstrained date before any commercial protection is added

  • Rigorously accelerate programs during the pre-lease phase by making schedule work a priority for the developer while the deal depends on it, pulling forward design, permitting, power, early works and procurement, and sequencing the build around how capacity turns up

  • Assess contractor and supply-chain capacity and long-lead equipment needs for each opportunity, setting a long-lead strategy that secures delivery capacity ahead of need and making the case for early equipment funding where it protects a date

  • Challenge Total Development Cost and delivery schedules against the assumptions behind Yield-on-Cost and IRR, flagging where time-to-power or cost exposure puts the investment case at risk

  • Shape the delivery terms of the LOI, lease and supporting exhibits with transaction and legal teams, including phasing and target dates, landlord scope, diligence cost, ownership and reliance, risk allocation and governance, and check that the developer's contract with its general contractor carries the same milestones and aligns incentives around accelerated delivery

  • Give deal and delivery leadership a clear go/no-go recommendation at each decision point up to signature, with the risks, conditions and mitigations behind it

  • Keep one delivery-readiness record and one risk register across all EMEA opportunities, assigning every risk to an accountable owner, tracking it to resolution, and escalating where cost or schedule is threatened

  • Direct owner's representatives and third-party advisers and assure what they produce, bringing design and engineering, cost, schedule, commercial, contracts and procurement into a single view of risk and readiness

  • Develop and refine the preconstruction playbook, a reference log of unit costs and benchmarks, and the operating model needed to scale the function, using AI tools including Claude for first-pass assessment, document review and benchmarking so your time goes to judgment and negotiation

  • Prepare and present regular executive reporting on readiness and risk for each opportunity and across the portfolio, including time from signature to construction start, risks found before versus after signature, and baseline-to-actual variance, supporting forward capacity planning and strategic decision-making

Responsibilities - delivery leadership (about 25%):

  • Document the baseline at signature for design, budget, schedule, long-lead position, open risks and conditions, so delivery starts from an assured position whether you carry the project forward yourself or hand it to a delivery colleague

  • Partner with landlords and developers post-deal to serve as Anthropic's primary point of contact, coordinating across internal stakeholders, tracking construction progress, and facilitating critical information exchange between development partners and Anthropic stakeholders

  • You will be expected to be at one or more project sites in adequate amount to shape the culture, approach, and aggressiveness that define those extended site teams. The goal is to impact outcomes in a favorable manner.

  • You are expected to be a force multiplier that develops and enhances the skillset that development partners, contractors, and key trades bring to the project(s) you are overseeing.  That means being a subject matter expert in the various cross functional elements of data center delivery and increasing the team's performance with that knowledge and commitment to alignment.

  • Represent Anthropic in key technical and operational decisions required by partners during the development process, ensuring our infrastructure requirements are met while maintaining strong partnerships

  • Drive seamless handoffs to operational state with heavy focus on engagement across networking and deployment teams, enabling rapid workload turn-ups and minimizing time-to-production

  • Identify and mitigate risks throughout the delivery lifecycle, proactively addressing blockers that could impact timeline, cost, or technical requirements, and feed what you learn on site back into diligence and the playbook

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 8+ years of experience in preconstruction, development, or cost and commercial management on data center or other large mission-critical programs within EMEA, including time leading delivery on site.  You won't have a big direct team to delegate to but will instead be able to treat the entire cross functional organizations around each deal and jobsite as your team.

  • Have a track record of testing developer and contractor claims on cost, schedule, power and permitting against source documents, and of telling a deal team when a date does not hold up.

  • Have taken time out of programs before construction started, and can show how.  You read a native schedule fluently and know which levers in design, permitting, power and procurement move a date.

  • Have shaped delivery terms in development, lease or construction agreements, working with legal teams, and have led tendering and bid analysis.  You understand how cost and schedule flow through to the investment case.

  • Have a strong understanding of the end to end (dirt to delivery) data center development process to include entitlements and permitting, planning and supply chain, execution, commissioning, and handover. You are not an administrator but an active player in the arena comfortable making decisions without the need to consult across multiple external parties.

  • You should understand the nuances of data center design and construction across EMEA markets- who the players are, how power and permitting differ, what contractual norms get in the way of speed of delivery, how teams can be incentivized to build and deliver faster than normal.

  • Have built or scaled a team or function, including directing third-party advisers.

  • In this role you will often be on an island and responsible for your own destiny.  You will have free rein to develop your own approaches with the mission guidance being your only bounds.  No one will be there to empower your efforts, you will create your own influence by building relationships and diving in at all phases to deliver success.

  • You must thrive operating with ambiguity and have a willingness to own outcomes, knowing that the buck stops with you.

It's a bonus if you:

  • Understand AI/ML infrastructure requirements, including high-density power and advanced cooling systems

  • Have had preconstruction or leadership positions (Preconstruction Manager, General Superintendent, Project Manager) within a GC, EPC or developer on hyperscale data center projects or in self performance of hyperscale data center development projects.

  • Prioritize extreme ownership and have the ability to create winning cultures across diverse teams and job sites.

  • Are deeply familiar with lease negotiations, construction contracts, or real estate development processes and have strategies to move those arrangements from traditionally transaction and risk managed arrangements to collaborative efforts that align incentives around accelerated delivery of facilities.

  • Have secured long-lead equipment or manufacturing capacity ahead of a signed deal, including through frame agreements or early funding arrangements.

  • Have run quantitative schedule risk analysis, or built parametric cost benchmarks across a portfolio of sites.

  • Speak additional European languages.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£1—£1 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

title: Senior Director - EMEA Solutions Engineering
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You’ll Do:

The EMEA Field Engineering organization is the technical engine of CoreWeave’s regional go-to-market. It brings together account-aligned technical teams and deep specialists to help customers design, validate, deploy, and scale production workloads on CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform.

About the role: The Senior Director of Product & Engineering, EMEA reports to the VP and Managing Director of EMEA, with a matrix reporting line to the Global VP of Field Engineering and SVP of Product. As the senior field technology leader for the region, you will lead all EMEA field technical functions, with direct management accountability for account-aligned technical teams and matrix leadership of specialist teams. You will set the regional technical strategy, build a consistently high level of mastery across the specialisms required to serve AI infrastructure customers, and ensure teams are motivated, appropriately deployed, and equipped to succeed. Working across EMEA and global leadership, you will turn customer and business priorities into a disciplined technical operating model that accelerates adoption, expansion, and measurable value from CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform. You will be responsible for ensuring the product strategy of CoreWeave is assimilated across field teams in EMEA and - working with field enablement - ensuring that all teams maintain a high level of product competency. 

  • Set and execute the EMEA Field Product & Engineering strategy, operating model, and priorities in partnership with the VP and Managing Director of EMEA, Global VP of Field Engineering and SVP of Product.
  • Act as the senior field technology voice for EMEA, shaping go-to-market priorities, customer engagement models, technical positioning, and regional investment decisions.
  • Lead the account-aligned technical organization with direct accountability for organization design, performance, coaching, succession, hiring, retention, and leadership development across EMEA.
  • Provide matrix leadership to specialist technical teams, aligning priorities, coverage, engagement standards, and accountability while partnering effectively with their global functional leaders.
  • Build a measurable technical mastery system—including skills assessments, learning plans, communities of practice, playbooks, reference architectures, and proof frameworks—that keeps teams current across AI infrastructure, compute, Kubernetes, networking, storage, security, observability, and AI/ML workloads.
  • Create repeatable engagement mechanisms that move customers from discovery and architecture through validation, onboarding, production readiness, adoption, optimization, and expansion on CoreWeave’s AI Cloud platform.
  • Serve as executive technical sponsor and escalation leader for strategic customers, advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders and mobilizing field, specialist, Product, Engineering, Support, and Operations resources around successful outcomes.
  • Partner with EMEA sales leadership on account strategy, technical qualification, executive alignment, and resource allocation, sharing accountability for technical win rate, qualified pipeline, deal velocity, time to production, workload adoption, and expansion.
  • Establish a rigorous regional operating cadence covering goals, metrics, forecasting, capacity and coverage planning, business reviews, and annual planning so performance and investment choices are visible and evidence based.
  • Create a structured feedback loop from EMEA customers and field teams into Product and Engineering, translating recurring requirements, adoption blockers, competitive signals, and market dynamics into clear roadmap input.
  • Represent CoreWeave’s technology vision through executive briefings, customer forums, conferences, and thought leadership, while bringing relevant market insight back into the business.
  • Represent EMEA in global Field Engineering leadership, scale regional best practices across the company, and create an inclusive, high-performance environment in which teams are motivated and enabled to help customers adopt CoreWeave.

Who You Are:

  • 15+ years of experience in technical design, implementation, consulting, pre-sales, solutions architecture, or another customer-facing technical discipline within cloud infrastructure, AI/ML platforms, enterprise software, or adjacent markets.
  • 10+ years of technical leadership experience, including 7+ years leading managers, senior individual contributors, or multi-country Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Sales Engineering, or comparable customer-facing technical organizations.
  • A record of leading distributed technical organizations through rapid growth, transformation, changing market conditions, and complex organizational dependencies.
  • Strong technical credibility in cloud-native and distributed-systems architecture, with depth across several of the following domains: accelerated compute, Kubernetes, networking, storage, security, observability, data platforms, or AI/ML workload architecture.
  • Demonstrated success guiding complex enterprise customers from strategy and solution design through validation, production deployment, operationalization, measurable adoption, and expansion.
  • Experience advising C-suite and senior technical stakeholders and translating complex architecture into business value, investment choices, delivery risk, and operating decisions.
  • Experience supporting complex enterprise sales cycles and connecting technical strategy to qualified pipeline, technical wins, deal progression, customer adoption, and expansion.
  • A record of hiring, developing, and retaining technical leaders, together with building measurable enablement, accreditation, or continuous-learning programs that close capability gaps.
  • Experience operating a metrics-based field organization, including goals, forecasting, capacity and coverage planning, resource prioritization, business reviews, and performance inspection.
  • Demonstrated ability to align Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, partners, specialist teams, and global leaders without relying solely on positional authority.
  • Experience operating across EMEA markets, with the ability to travel regionally and internationally as required to support customers, teams, and company priorities.

Preferred:

  • Leadership experience in a high-growth AI cloud, hyperscale cloud, data-center infrastructure, enterprise platform, or developer-platform business.
  • Deep familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing, large-scale AI training or inference, high-performance computing, and the operational requirements of distributed AI workloads.
  • Experience navigating EMEA-specific customer requirements, including data sovereignty, security, regulation, procurement, and cross-border operating considerations.
  • Experience establishing specialist communities of practice or centers of excellence, influencing product roadmaps, and representing a company through external technical thought leadership.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; postgraduate technical or business study is valued.

Wondering if you’re a good fit? We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

  • You love building technical leaders and teams that combine deep expertise, commercial awareness, and a relentless focus on customer outcomes.
  • You’re curious about the fast-moving AI infrastructure landscape and turn new learning and customer insight into practical enablement and better products.
  • You’re an expert at creating clarity, accountability, and momentum across direct and matrixed organizations operating at high speed and across cultures.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

  • Be Curious at Your Core
  • Act Like an Owner
  • Empower Employees
  • Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
  • Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.

What We Offer

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:

  • Family-level Medical Insurance
  • Family-level Dental Insurance 
  • Generous Pension Contribution 
  • Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
  • Critical Illness Cover 
  • Employee Assistance Programme 
  • Tuition Reimbursement

Equal Opportunity 

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Recruitment Agencies

CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.

Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

title: Senior Director, ML Software
descriptionHtml:

Your organisation delivers the machine learning software and analysis tools that enable AI models to run on Graphcore’s platform. You’ll translate business objectives into multi year roadmaps, aligning resources, investment and delivery commitments.
