You’ll lead through senior engineering leaders, shape organisational structure and develop successors. Beyond your function, you’ll shape wider software priorities, influence executive decisions and sponsor initiatives across the organisation. 

The team and culture

You’ll partner with silicon, hardware, architecture, system software, product and operations leaders to align roadmaps and resolve integration risks. With architecture leaders, you’ll challenge design assumptions across frameworks, simulation, collectives and tooling. Your leadership team will own achievable, adequately resourced plans, with clear expectations for milestones, quality and outcomes. You’ll resolve risks promptly, make portfolio trade-offs and escalate decisions requiring executive alignment. Delivery and quality measures will guide investment in continuous integration, automated testing, hardware-in-the-loop validation, regression coverage and release governance. You’ll turn incidents into lasting improvements, with reliability, security and testability treated as engineering outcomes. 

What we’re looking for

  • Organisational leadership: You’ve led sizeable system software organisations through managers and senior technical leaders, accountable for complex, multi-team hardware and software programmes. You set clear expectations and hold leaders accountable for delivery, quality and business outcomes.

  • Building leadership capacity: You’ve scaled engineering organisations, shaped structures and workforce plans, and led performance management and organisational change. You coach senior leaders, develop successors and build the capabilities needed to meet changing product and business priorities.

  • Strategy and investment: You’ve owned multi-year roadmaps and delivery portfolios, aligning investment, capacity and commitments with business objectives. You make portfolio-level trade-offs under resource constraints, resolve critical technical dependencies and manage risks across competing programmes.

  • Engineering quality and governance: You’ve set organisation-wide quality and release standards, supported by hardware-based automation, regression coverage and robust validation. You use delivery and quality measures, incident learning and risk governance to drive improvements across teams.

  • Executive influence: You’ve aligned senior stakeholders across organisational boundaries, resolved complex decisions and communicated strategic risks and investment choices. You translate technical trade-offs into implications for products, customers, operational resilience and business outcomes, contributing beyond your immediate function.

Experience with machine learning software, hardware-software interfaces, AI accelerators, GPUs or high-performance computing would be valuable.

title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs. 

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:

  • Linux running on embedded hardware
  • C/C++, Python & Bash codebases
  • Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion

Responsibilities

  • Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.
  • Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.
  • Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.
  • Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.
  • Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.
  • Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.

Qualifications and Skills

  • B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.
  • Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.
  • Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.
  • Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender).
  • Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.
  • Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.
  • Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.
  • Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.
  • Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.
  • Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.
  • Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.
  • Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.
  • Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.
  • Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.
  • A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.
  • EU Citizenship required.

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Stock Options
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Company pension plan 
  • Car parking  
  • Enhanced maternity & paternity leave
  • Mental health and wellbeing support
  • Learning and development opportunities

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

What will I be doing?

You'll join the Engineering Experience & AI Foundations team within our broader Kaluza Technology community. Your work will directly impact how Kaluza scales productivity safely and with high quality, and defines the gold standard for Agentic Software Development in the organisation.

As a Senior II Engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for our Internal AI Engineering Platform and the Kaluza Agentic SDLC Framework (KASF). You'll design and implement the infrastructure, from Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to shared agentic workflows, and use your influence across teams to make it the way Kaluza builds software. In 2027, our goal is org wide adoption of KASF across engineering, and you'll be a technical owner of getting there safely, securely and with measurable impact on quality and velocity.

  • Technical Direction & Architecture: Drive the architecture and technical roadmap for our EngEx & AI Platform Foundations team, including the Kaluza AI Control Plane (KAIC), the AI governance layer (MCP and LLM gateways), and shared Agents, Skills, Workflows and Standards. Shape and document build-vs-buy decisions and balance fast-moving vendor capabilities against long-term platform stability.

  • Hands-On Delivery: Stay close to the implementation. Design, build and ship core platform components, set the engineering bar through your own code, and prototype new approaches to prove them before the team scales them.

  • Agentic SDLC (KASF) Adoption: Drive KASF from early adoption to all engineering teams during 2027. Oversee creation and evolution of reference architectures, standards and adoption playbooks, work with engineering leaders to embed KASF in how teams plan, build, review and ship, and use feedback and metrics to remove blockers.

  • AI Tooling Evaluation & Deployment: Lead structured, time-boxed trials of emerging engineering tools with clear success criteria and go/no-go recommendations. Keep Kaluza at the forefront of the AI space while retiring tools that don't earn their place.

  • Governance, Security & Risk: Act as the technical authority on AI risk for engineering. Work with Security, Legal and Data Protection to design approval processes and guardrails (data leakage, prompt injection, model access) that protect the business without slowing innovation.

  • Champion Engineering Experience: Support the definition and evolution of engineering experience at Kaluza and enable our engineers to do more. Drawing on established frameworks such as DORA and SPACE alongside integrated tooling to surface trends, feedback and points of friction to drive improvements and optimisations across the organisation. Evolve our understanding and assessment of AI Metrics and their impact on outcomes.

  • Cost Optimisation: Partner with Finance and Security to keep AI usage secure and cost-efficient at scale, including guardrails and unit economics for model spend.

  • Technical Leadership: Mentor Senior and mid-level engineers, lead design reviews, and raise the technical standard of the team and the wider engineering community. Influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, turn ambiguous problems into clear plans, and build a network of AI champions in engineering teams. Pragmatic and open-minded and able to see things from different perspectives with both technical and non-technical cohorts.

About You

Ideally you'll have/be:

  • Technical Leadership Experience: A substantial engineering background, with a track record of leading technical direction on platform, infrastructure or developer-experience work, and still hands-on in the code.

  • Production-Grade AI Implementation: Experience building and running production systems, ideally including LLM-based or agentic systems, and a deep interest in the "LLM-ops" lifecycle beyond chat interfaces, including evaluation, observability and reliability. Ideally experience across multiple model providers and multi-agent systems.

  • Systems Thinker: Strong distributed systems foundations and the judgement to integrate third-party AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI and others) without compromising reliability or latency.

  • Full-Stack Experience: You have hands-on experience across the stack and know what good looks like. Ideally you have experience with AWS in production, and you treat AI prompts, MCP configurations, and agent definitions with the same version-control rigor as your infrastructure.

  • The EngEx Mindset: You are passionate about engineer productivity. You don’t just build tools; you build experiences that make an engineer's day-to-day life easier and more creative. Supportive and empathetic towards others and able to make connections between symptoms and underlying causes.

  • Security & Governance First: You understand AI risks such as data leakage and prompt injection, and can design guardrails and approval processes that protect the business without slowing it down.

  • Data-Informed: You define success measures up front, automate the metrics AI-generated code volume, PR velocity, adoption), and change course when the data says so.

  • Influence & Communication: You can bring senior stakeholders and sceptical teams with you, and translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs and shared best practice.

  • Collaboration: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex AI concepts into clear guides, onboarding docs, and shared best practices for the wider engineering. community. Consideration for different audiences, including non-technical, being friendly, approachable and non-judgemental are key.

  • Curiosity & Judgement: The AI landscape changes weekly. You enjoy trialling new tools, and you have the judgement to pivot, or to say no, when a better option emerges.

Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

Our mission is clear: deliver robust, enterprise-grade, resilient, and reliable AI solutions at speed. In a fast-moving market where sales cycles for multimillion-dollar deals can be as short as 1-2 months, speed is our currency. We are competing head-to-head with the big-tech companies and fast-moving AI-native startups.

Our engineering organization is structured into Customer Experience Automation (CXA), Product Platform, and Technology Platform together delivering a Composable Customer Experience Platform built from Packaged Business Capabilities (PBCs). Think AWS-like granularity, but built to empower enterprises with speed, flexibility, and resilience.

About The Role

A Senior Engineering Manager at Parloa does the same job as an Engineering Manager, at a bigger and harder scope. You own delivery and business outcomes for a large team, for two or more teams, or for a domain whose work spans several teams. Sometimes the scope is defined by size; sometimes it is defined by difficulty, such as a problem area where the technical and organisational complexity is genuinely hard, and where getting it right matters to the company's roadmap.

What changes at this level is altitude and durability. You communicate credibly to Directors and VPs without your manager in the room, framing recommendations and trade-offs rather than reporting status. You own the narrative for cross-functional work that travels beyond your teams. You take the conversations that Engineering Managers escalate to you - performance edge cases, prioritisation conflicts between teams, hard disagreements with peers - and you resolve them. And you are building the next layer of leaders: the tech leads who will become EMs, the senior engineers who will become Staff.

You are not primarily a manager of managers. Some Senior EMs move that way, on the path to Director, but most do not and this role does not require it. The people work gets harder at this level, not lighter.

Areas Of Ownership

  • Own delivery across a multi-team or multi-domain scope. Set milestones, critical path, and quality gates. Manage cross-team dependencies actively rather than reporting on them. Hold a consistent bar for Definition of Done and quality across the scope.

  • Set strategy and roadmap with Product, not unilaterally. Frame engineering investment in commercial terms - revenue, retention, margin - and surface customer and market signals into the plan.

  • Own the narrative for cross-functional initiatives. Stakeholders walk away aligned, not merely informed. Author durable artefacts - plans, RFCs, escalation memos, postmortems — that still stand up months later and travel beyond the people in the room.

  • Create the conditions for coherent technical direction. Partner with Staff+ ICs to shape the technical agenda and own tech debt strategy across your scope. Champion experimentation and prune low-signal bets early. Codify and share the learnings from failures.

  • Hold operational discipline to a consistent standard. On-call, incident response, and postmortem practice across your scope; reliability targets aligned to product expectations; cost and unit-economics trends tracked and corrected before they spike. Treat blockers as priority work and clear them hands-on across team boundaries.

  • Design the operating model for your scope. Roles, ownership, and on-call rotations; multi-team operating rhythm; aggregated DORA and SLO metrics; 3–6 month dependency mapping and capacity rebalancing.

  • Grow the next layer of leaders. Hire senior ICs up to Staff level and, where applicable, first-line team leads. Build a pipeline for hard-to-fill roles. Identify and develop future managers and senior ICs from within. Drive calibration across your scope and coach peer managers on promotion standards.

  • Eliminate classes of blockers, not just individual ones. When something breaks twice, you fix the system that lets it break.

Who You Are

  • A proven engineering leader, typically 10+ years in software engineering with 4-6+ years of people leadership. You have owned outcomes for more than one team or for a domain spanning several teams.

  • Credible with senior leadership. You can walk into a room with a VP or a CPO and frame a trade-off, not just present a status update. Your written work is concise and decision-driving.

  • A builder of leaders. You can point to specific people you hired, grew, and promoted(e.g. a tech lead who became an EM, a senior engineer who became Staff) and describe what you actually did.

  • Technically credible without needing to be the decision-maker. You partner with Staff and Principal engineers to shape technical direction through influence, and you know when to hold a standard versus when to let a team choose.

  • Commercially fluent. You understand what your scope costs, what it returns, and how to have that conversation with Product and Finance.

  • Comfortable with the hard conversations. Performance edge cases, prioritisation conflict between teams, and disagreements with peers are part of the job, and you take them on early rather than letting them fester.

  • Pragmatic under real pressure. You have recovered a stalled cross-team initiative, or taken on a scope that had lost predictability, without burning out the engineers or making the EMs feel stepped on.

What This Role Is Not

  • An Engineering Manager with a bigger title. The scope or impact has to be real.

  • A step on the way to managing managers. Some Senior EMs go that way; most do not. This is a complete job on its own terms.

  • Distance from your team. If you are looking for a role where the people work gets lighter, this is not it.

Why Join Parloa's Engineering Organization?

  • Impact at Scale: Define the future of enterprise AI in a market ripe for disruption.

  • Elite Talent Density: Work alongside top-tier engineers, Staff, and Principal leaders in a reverse-pyramid structure optimized for speed and innovation.

  • Culture of Builders: Ownership, autonomy, and fearless iteration are not slogans—they are how we win.

  • Uncapped Growth: Be part of an org growing 4x annually, where career opportunities multiply as fast as our business.

Global Ambition: Help establish Parloa as Europe’s most admired engineering organization, competing head-to-head with FAANG and beyond.

 

Our Recruiting Process:

Recruiter Interview → Peer Interview → 360° Technical Interview Loop → Bar Raiser Interview

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more. If you receive an offer of employment from Parloa, you will need to go through the E-Verify process of digital verification of your employment authorization documents as provided on the Form I-9. Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

* We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.

title: Senior Finance Manager
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Integral was founded in October 2024 and is already one of the fastest-growing startups in Germany. We're building the leading AI-native platform for accounting, payroll, and tax for European SMEs, and we're looking for the sharpest people to help us get there.

As our first dedicated Senior Finance Manager, you will build the financial planning & analysis function from the ground up and report directly to the CFO. You will own the group's forecasting and planning engine, sharpen ARR and liquidity steering, and be a core partner on fundraising, board reporting and go-to-market economics. This is a high-visibility, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build.

 

Your Tasks

  • Planning & forecasting: Own and continuously improve the integrated business plan (P&L, cash flow, balance sheet), including consolidation logic.

  • Budgeting: Run the annual budget and rolling re-forecast; translate strategy into a defensible operating plan and use-of-funds.

  • Performance steering with KPIs & BI: Define and report the KPIs that matter and build them into our BI dashboard. Flag risks and levers early.

  • IR & fundraising: Support board and investor reporting and potential future funding rounds with models and investor-grade materials.

  • GTM & cohorts: Build and own cohort analytics tied to go-to-market (e.g. retention, payback period, LTV/CAC and margin by acquisition channel). Turn these into concrete recommendations on spend and channel mix.

  • Business partnering: Partner with Commercial and Service Operations leaders on unit economics, pricing, funnel efficiency and investment decisions.

  • Scalable processes & automation: Design processes that scale with rapid growth by using AI and agentic tooling to make planning faster, cleaner and repeatable.

  • Operational Finance: Own accounts payable and receivable, and drive timely, accurate month-end and year-end closes together with our tax advisory team.

 

Your Profile

  • Experience: 5+ years in FP&A, accounting/controlling, investment banking or a comparable analytical finance role, ideally with high-growth / VC-backed / scale-up exposure.

  • Modelling: Expert financial modelling; you build clean, three-statement models and defend the assumptions.

  • Commercial: Fluent in unit economics, recurring-revenue and cash metrics; comfortable turning messy data into decisions.

  • Tools: Advanced Excel/Sheets; experience with BI/planning, DATEV and AI tooling a strong plus.

  • Language: You operate in English and German; investor and board materials are produced in English.

  • Mindset: Hands-on, structured, comfortable with ambiguity and first-of-role ownership in a scaling environment.

  • Agentic mindset: You default to AI and agentic tools to automate the repetitive and build leverage - you think in reusable processes and systems, not one-off spreadsheets, so finance scales faster than headcount.

  • Qualification: Degree in finance, business or a quantitative field; CFA, MBA or qualified-accountant background welcome.

What we're not looking for

  • People who wait to be told what to do.

  • "That's not my job" energy at the handoff between teams.

  • Anyone who treats compliance and documentation as red tape to skip rather than the thing that protects the client.

 

Process

We move fast. For the right candidate the whole process takes less than two weeks.

  1. Virtual call ​with our Talent Team

  2. Virtual Case Study based on a real challenge we're facing that you'd solve

  3. Invitation to our office to meet the team, product, and run through your case study

  4. Reference call

 

Our Offer

  • Direct line to the CFO and Co-Founder/CEO exposure

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 28 vacation days per year, plus half-days on December 24 and 31

  • Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft, Sachbezüge/Coupons to over 200 partners or a Deutschland Ticket

  • Company pension scheme (bAV)

  • Modern equipment setup for your needs to succeed

  • Modern office in the heart of Berlin Prenzlauer Berg

  • Weekly team lunches on us, office BBQs, and a dinner budget for late nights after 8 p.m.

  • A team of 50+ (and growing) ambitious, diverse experts, 20%+ ex-founders, learning and building together

  • A category-defining growth story in a large, underserved market, with an AI-enabled operating model.

We value diversity and hire people based on their abilities and capabilities to succeed in this role. We welcome people of every background, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status, political belief or marital status.

Wij zijn voor de Gemeente Zwolle op zoek naar een Senior Financieel Strategisch Adviseur. Binnen de afdeling Concernstaf werk je aan een strategische en impactvolle opgave: het ontwikkelen van een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een horizon van tien jaar en een bijbehorend financieel sturingskader.

De gemeente staat de komende jaren voor grote investeringen op het gebied van woningbouw, gebiedsontwikkeling, onderwijshuisvesting en infrastructuur. Tegelijkertijd vragen financiële schaarste, beperkte uitvoeringscapaciteit en netcongestie om scherpe keuzes en integrale afwegingen. In deze opdracht zorg je voor een toekomstbestendige financiële aanpak die inzicht geeft in investeringen, risico’s, financiële consequenties en prioriteiten binnen de gemeentelijke investeringsportefeuille.

  • Je ontwikkelt en implementeert een integraal Meerjarig Investeringsplan (MIP) met een looptijd van tien jaar.

Eisen:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo-bacheloropleiding.

  • Je hebt minimaal 10 jaar ervaring als strategisch financieel adviseur of in een vergelijkbare financieel-strategische adviesfunctie.

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen een gemeentelijke organisatie.

Aanvullende wensen:

  • Je hebt ruime kennis van en ervaring met gemeentefinanciën.

  • Je hebt ervaring met financiële vraagstukken binnen het fysieke domein, zoals gebiedsontwikkeling, woningbouw of infrastructuur.

Competenties

  • Je beschikt over uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Je bent daadkrachtig, resultaatgericht en brengt complexe opgaven tot een concreet eindresultaat.

descriptionHtml:
Freelance Senior Product Designer (Outside of IR35)

Duration: 6 months

Start Date: End of August or ASAP

Day Rate: Please specify in your application

Contract: (Outside of IR35)

Join Our Team as a Freelance Senior Product Designer (Outside of IR35) at Beyond Sports!

Are you passionate about complex product systems, pixel-perfect UI, and leading the design of next-generation digital experiences that capture global audiences?

At Beyond Sports, we don’t just visualize sports, we reinvent how fans experience them. Together with partners like NFL, NHL, FIFA, and Disney, we push the boundaries of real-time sports data, 3D graphics, and AI-driven storytelling across web and native mobile platforms.

If you're an experienced Senior Product Designer with an exceptional visual craft, deep UX strategy expertise, and a track record of driving complex design initiatives alongside fast-moving engineering squads, this 9-month contract is an exciting opportunity to make a massive impact.

What Your Day Will Look Like

As a Senior Product Designer, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how some of the most followed clubs and organizations in world sport engage and inspire millions of fans over the next 9 months on a major project.

Working alongside Lead Designers, Product Managers, and cross-functional delivery squads, you'll take full ownership of end-to-end UI and UX execution for major client initiatives across web and native mobile apps (iOS and Android).

One day you might be architecting complex user journeys and facilitating design workshops for high-stakes fan engagement features. The next, you could be setting component-driven design system standards in Figma, presenting executive-level design rationales to client stakeholders, or mentoring midweight designers within your squad.

You'll serve as a key creative lead within delivery teams, driving design quality, technical feasibility, and seamless developer handoff. Your work will directly define how millions of sports fans interact with live match data and interactive media worldwide.

What We Value

At Beyond Sports, we move fast, collaborate closely, and build things that haven't existed before.

You'll fit right in if you:

  • Bring high-level design craft, producing scalable UI architectures and seamless UX workflows

  • Take full end-to-end ownership of project workstreams from discovery through design implementation

  • Communicate complex design strategies clearly to leadership, development teams, and external partners

  • Confidently lead client discussions, articulate design decisions, and align multi-disciplinary teams

  • Excel at managing your own deliverables, prioritizing high-impact work within active sprint cycles

  • Champion continuous design quality and offer constructive feedback to elevate the wider design team

  • Drive strong, proactive collaboration across creative, product, engineering, and data teams

Your Background

You don't need to tick every box, but we're generally looking for:

  • Minimum 5+ years of commercial product design experience (agency, high-growth tech, or digital sports media)

  • A standout portfolio demonstrating complex end-to-end product design, scalable systems, and polished UI/UX for iOS, Android, and responsive web

  • Advanced mastery of Figma, including advanced prototyping, tokenized component libraries, and design system governance

  • Deep expertise in user-centered design methodologies, information architecture, and responsive design frameworks

  • Proven experience working directly with engineering squads to guide successful design handoff and QA implementation

title: Senior Growth Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Tracksuit exists to help marketers prove their brand building is working. We give teams the data they need to make smarter decisions, convince stakeholders, defend budgets, and track their progress. We're doing things differently by being built for the modern marketer: always-on, accessible, and approachable.

We're now tracking more than 16,000 brands across 25 countries globally. With offices in Auckland, Sydney, London and New York City, we're scaling fast with a brilliant team of collaborative and ambitious humans. Our culture is defined by "high care, high performance". We strive to be the best and look after each other while we do it.

Are you our next Senior Growth Account Executive in London?

Brand matters. Most marketers know that already. The hard part is proving it to a CFO. Our customers use Tracksuit to do exactly that, and many of them could get even more from it.

As a Senior Growth Account Executive in London, you'll help them get there. You'll own expansion across a portfolio of UK and European customers, working hand in hand with our Brand Champions (our version of Customer Success Managers). You'll start in the new year, just as we reveal the next chapter of brand tracking in January 2027.

  • Run practical, repeatable plays to uncover needs and grow accounts, from new markets and categories to multi-year deals

What you'll bring

  • A record of growing accounts against a target. You've carried an expansion, renewal or new business number in B2B software and beaten it. We'd love to hear from you whether you've carried a number for 2 years or 5.

  • Drive that holds up after a "no". You stay organised, keep your forecast honest, and see a lost deal as something to learn from.

  • You want to be coached. You ask for feedback and use it quickly. (Fair warning: you'll get to show us this in the interview.)

  • You move decisions forward. A thoughtful, kind and commercially sharp communicator, with marketing leaders and procurement alike.

Bonus points if you love brands, or know marketing or marketing technology.

Why you'll like it here

  • You'll start with a cohort. You'll join alongside other new starters, so you'll learn and ramp up together, not on your own.

Salary

£65,000 to £80,000 base salary, with on-target earnings (OTE) of £108,000 to £133,000. Pay is fixed, so what you see is what we offer.

OTE is your base salary plus commission when you hit 100% of your target. Commission depends on performance and isn't guaranteed.

The details

  • Location. London, our Clerkenwell office. We're office-first, so you'll be in with the team 3 to 4 days each week.

  • Start date. Offers by the first week of January, with hires starting from mid-January into February.

How our process works

We want to get to know more of the people who apply, not just the ones whose CV tells the whole story. So instead of shortlisting on CVs alone, we'll invite more applicants into the first stage of our process.

That first stage happens in your own time. You'll record a short video interview and complete any other quick online steps, whenever suits you over a few days. It's your chance to show us how you think and what drives you. AI tools help us review these, and a real person makes every decision.

Once we've reviewed the video interviews, shortlisted candidates get a chance to speak with our Talent team about the role and their application in more detail. Then you'll come into our office to interview with the team. We'll let you know exactly what to expect, and anything to prepare, when we invite you.

  • Sunday 29 November: applications close

  • From mid-January into February: new hires start

You'll hear from us either way.

  • Drive continuous improvement in production processes by identifying design bottlenecks and engineering scalable solutions
  • Serve as the technical authority on industrialization, guiding hardware teams and setting the standard for how we transition products from prototype to production
  • Define GD&T and tolerance stack-ups with R&D, derive measurement requirements, and lead First Article Inspections with suppliers and ISO/IEC 17025-accredited labs through to part release
  • Qualify assembly processes and suppliers: control plans, work instructions, fixtures and technical transfer to manufacturing partners
  • Own engineering changes and production master data (BOM, PDM/ERP/MES), and drive root cause analysis on non-conformities

    • Your Profile
  • Demonstrated experience owning industrialization or manufacturing engineering for complex, high-reliability electromechanical products
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in DFM, DFA, and DFX for precision mechanical components and assemblies
  • Proven expertise in applying GD&T (ASME Y14.5 / ISO 1101) and tolerance stack-up analysis, with hands-on experience deriving measurement requirements and leading First Article Inspections with suppliers and external labs
  • Proven background in industries such as aerospace, automotive, or specialized robotics, with a focus on high-complexity rather than mass manufacturing
  • Strong proficiency in CAD software (SolidWorks preferred) to evaluate, review, and modify mechanical designs for manufacturability
  • Willingness to work on-site in our Zurich headquarters 4 days a week to closely collaborate with hardware and production teams

    • Bonus Points
  • Fluency in German or Italian to effectively collaborate with our regional manufacturing partners
  • Prior experience scaling the production of autonomous robots or advanced capital equipment
  • Familiarity with setting up advanced quality control processes for low-volume, high-mix manufacturing
    • We offer you a very exciting and dynamic work environment, the opportunity to become part of a fast-growing company and an ambitious team that is on a mission to change the industrial inspection market, a chance to leverage your experience and bring in your own ideas, a fair market salary, an attractive employee stock ownership plan, and a job in the city of Zurich. title: Senior Information Security Manager / ISMS Consultant (gn)
descriptionHtml:
Deine nächste Projektperspektive mit New Monday

Wir sind New Monday und bringen erfahrene Spezialist in Kundenprojekte entlang des digitalen Produktentwicklungsprozesses. Unsere Wurzeln liegen im UX- und UI-Design. Diesen Fokus erweitern wir um Softwareentwicklung, Architektur, Cloud, Data und Informationssicherheit.

Für zukünftige Kundenprojekte möchten wir erfahrene Expert kennenlernen, die Informationssicherheit strukturiert aufbauen und im Unternehmensalltag verankern. Bei einer passenden Projektanfrage sprechen wir gemeinsam über Aufgaben, Starttermin und Rahmenbedingungen.

Deine möglichen Aufgaben

  • Du begleitest den Aufbau, Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung von Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystemen auf Basis von ISO/IEC 27001 und/oder BSI IT-Grundschutz.

  • Du führst Risiko- und Gap-Analysen durch, identifizierst Handlungsbedarf und leitest geeignete Sicherheitsmaßnahmen ab.

  • Du entwickelst Sicherheitsrichtlinien, Konzepte und nachvollziehbare Dokumentationen.

  • Du bereitest interne und externe Audits vor und begleitest die Umsetzung daraus entstehender Maßnahmen.

  • Du unterstützt bei Schutzbedarfsfeststellungen und der Abstimmung von Notfall- und Business-Continuity-Themen.

  • Du berätst Fachbereiche, IT und Management und vermittelst Anforderungen in Workshops und Abstimmungsterminen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens fünf einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Informationssicherheitsmanagement oder in der ISMS-Beratung.

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit ISO/IEC 27001 und/oder BSI IT-Grundschutz sowie ein gutes Verständnis der jeweils ergänzenden Standards und Methoden.

  • Erfahrung in der Bewertung von Informationssicherheitsrisiken und der Umsetzung organisatorischer und technischer Maßnahmen.

  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sicherheitsthemen verständlich zu vermitteln und Maßnahmen gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern voranzubringen.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes einschlägiges Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Reisebereitschaft für projektabhängige Kundeneinsätze innerhalb Deutschlands.

Zertifizierungen wie ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, Lead Auditor, CISM oder eine Qualifikation im BSI IT-Grundschutz sind willkommen. Erfahrung im öffentlichen Sektor oder in regulierten Branchen ist ebenfalls ein Plus.

Für einzelne Projekte kann eine Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.

Die Zusammenarbeit

Es erfolgt eine Festanstellung bei New Monday, während der du deine Expertise beim Kunden einbringst. New Monday arbeitet remote; die Kundenprojekte finden je nach Anforderung remote, hybrid oder vor Ort statt. Die konkreten Bedingungen besprechen wir gemeinsam.

Schick uns deinen aktuellen Lebenslauf mit aussagekräftigen Projektbeschreibungen und vorhandenen Zertifizierungen. Ergänze bitte deine Verfügbarkeit beziehungsweise Kündigungsfrist und deine Gehaltsvorstellung als Bruttojahresgehalt.

Wir prüfen dein Profil und kommen bei einer passenden Projektmöglichkeit auf dich zu.

New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. descriptionHtml:
PLANETHOME INVESTMENTS


Senior Investment Consultant Wohn- & Geschäftshäuser (m/w/d)

Standort: Berlin | Fokus: Neuaufbau PlanetHome Investments

Der Berliner Investmentmarkt schläft nicht. Und wir auch nicht.

Mit unserem exklusiven Zugang zu namhaften Banken, Wealth-Management-Einheiten, Unternehmenskundenbereichen und Finanzdienstleistern verfügen wir über ein einzigartiges Netzwerk. Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten strategischen Schritt.

Für den Aufbau von PlanetHome Investments suchen wir keine Verwalter bestehender Strukturen. Wir suchen Unternehmer im Unternehmen: Macher, die einen Geschäftsbereich von Anfang an mitgestalten wollen. Die Marktchancen erkennen, bevor andere sie sehen, und wissen, dass große Abschlüsse Leidenschaft und Drive erfordern. Kurz gesagt: Wir suchen First Mover mit Hands-on-Mentalität.

Du steigst nicht in einen starren Konzernapparat ein, sondern wirst Teil des Kernteams, das PlanetHome Investments aufbaut. Deine Ideen, Dein Marktverständnis und Deine Erfahrung sind ausdrücklich gewünscht und prägen unsere gemeinsame Zukunft.

Deine Vorteile – Eine starke Plattform im Rücken:

· Etablierte Marke: Vertrauen und Schlagkraft eines führenden Immobilienunternehmens.

· Agilität: Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem hochmotivierten Team, das wachsen will und wird.

· Kundenvielfalt: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit privaten Investoren, Semi-Professionals, Family Offices und institutionellen Marktteilnehmern.

· Transaktionsmanagement: Strukturierung und Steuerung von Off-Market- und On-Market-Transaktionen von der Akquise bis zum

Notartermin.

· Bewertung & Positionierung: Professionelle Einwertung und marktgerechte Positionierung von Investmentimmobilien.

· Bereichsaufbau: Aktive Mitgestaltung der Prozesse, Strategien und Standards für PlanetHome Investments.

WAS DU MITBRINGEN SOLLTEST

· Track Record: Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Investmentgeschäft oder in der Vermittlung von Wohn- und Geschäftshäusern.

· Marktnetzwerk: Belastbarer Zugang zu Eigentümern, Investoren, Projektentwicklern oder Family Offices.

· Vertriebsstärke & Verhandlungsgeschick: Hohe Eigenmotivation, Abschlussstärke und Freude an der Akquise.

· Unternehmer-Mindset: Lust auf Gestaltungsspielraum – wenn ein Prozess noch nicht im Handbuch steht, erkennst Du die Chance, Dinge besser zu machen.

WAS DU VON UNS ERWARTEN KANNST

· Leistung soll sich lohnen: Wer außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielt, soll auch außergewöhnlich verdienen. Wir bieten ein Vergütungsmodell, das unternehmerisches Denken und Erfolg unmittelbar belohnt.

· Home & Office: Wir glauben an Marktpräsenz, Teamgeist und Geschwindigkeit. Der persönliche Austausch im Büro ist für uns ein echter Erfolgsfaktor, ergänzt durch moderne, flexible Arbeitsmöglichkeiten.

· Für Menschen, die das Geschäft lieben: Work-Life-Balance ist wichtig. Aber diese Position richtet sich an Professionals, die Immobilien, Investments und Transaktionen nicht nur als Job betrachten, sondern als Leidenschaft. Wenn Du morgens aufwachst und Dich fragst, welche Opportunität heute im Markt entsteht, dann könntest Du hervorragend zu uns passen.

KLINGT NACH DIR?
Dann lass uns sprechen! Egal ob Du aktuell Wohn- und Geschäftshäuser vermittelst, im Investmentbereich eines Maklerhauses tätig bist oder für eine Boutique, ein Family Office, eine Bank oder Beratungsgesellschaft arbeitest: Wenn Du beim Aufbau von PlanetHome Investments in Berlin eine Schlüsselrolle übernehmen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

PlanetHome Investments. Von Anfang an dabei. Nicht irgendwann. Jetzt.

descriptionHtml:
Our Story Hello there. We’re Zopa. We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

You'll work on distributed systems processing thousands of transactions daily, build resilient services that handle people's money, and create experiences that make traditionally complex financial products feel simple.
Your impact:
  • You love shipping great products, not just writing superb code
  • As an Engineer, you’re interested in the problem, not just the requirements
  • You feel comfortable in a fast-moving environment and are ambitious about the speed and quality of your code. We ship our code multiple times a week with the impact measured in the result for the customer, not lines of code
  • An advocate of test-driven development or, even better, behaviour-driven development. A strong commitment to quality is essential
  • You've worked on large scale distributed software systems that have proven scalability and complex topologies
  • Enjoy talking to key stakeholders and understand and show passion for the business objectives of the company
  • You are comfortable with a fair bit of uncertainty, fast change, and love solving hard problems collaboratively
  • You are a team player who thrives working in an honest and friendly working atmosphere. We have a flat hierarchy and give you the opportunity to make a real impact

    • Your toolkit:
  • You'll work with Kotlin, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Aurora Postgres, and other modern technologies. If you haven't worked with all of these, we value skilled engineers with a willingness to learn.
  • A product-focused engineering mindset
  • Experience building distributed systems at scale
  • Test-driven development practices
  • Comfort operating in uncertainty and rapid change
  • Collaborative problem-solving skills

    • Our engineering culture:
  • Customer impact over unnecessary complexity
  • Team success over individual heroics
  • Operational ownership, not just feature delivery
  • Continuous improvement through honest feedback

    • Added bonus:
  • Experience with fintech or banking is a plus, but we value problem-solvers from all backgrounds
    • #LI-JH1

    At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

    We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

    You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

    *Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

    Diversity Statement

    Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.

    Our approach to AI in interviews

    At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs.

    Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process.

    Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other.

    Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

title: Senior Key Accounts Manager
descriptionHtml:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Airbnb Hotels team is a fun, fast-growing group leading Airbnb’s expansion into the hotel sector. Operating with an entrepreneurial spirit, this team combines the simplicity, product excellence, and guest-centered ethos that define Airbnb. This team’s mission is to deliver the smoothest, most intuitive hotel booking experience for guests, while helping hotels easily drive incremental bookings so they can focus on delivering the best hospitality. The ultimate aim is to help more people discover high-quality hotels, creating value for guests and our hotel partners.

The Difference You will Make:

As a Senior Key Account Manager on the Hotels Enterprise team, you will own the commercial relationship with a portfolio of global and multinational hotel groups in your region. Your goal is to turn introductions into signed agreements then into live, healthy, growing inventory by increasing participation, bookings and revenue across Airbnb and HotelTonight. You will lead the account planning cycle with each partner, negotiate and renew commercial terms, and be the single point of contact between their executives and many Airbnb teams including Connectivity, Product, Legal and Market Management teams.

A Typical Day: 

  • Be accountable for the end-to-end lifecycle from prospecting, to acquisition, contracting, rollout and performance management  of Key Account partnerships
  • Execute a global win-win strategy for your portfolio that drives value to all parties and position Airbnb as a top strategic partner across all distribution channels.
  • Through the creation of mutual account plans with your partners you will design clear actions which deliver on the Objectives and KPIs of Airbnb and our Key Account Partners
  • Negotiate agreements with partners to unlock new opportunities for both parties & promote long term mutual success
  • Leverage data to make decisions and design projects to best expand and enhance availability and revenue through existing partnerships.
  • Monitor & analyze over/underperformance, market trends, growth opportunities or anomalies and regularly communicate performance to Executives leveraging available production data and global market insight.
  • Work with partners to ensure that the partnership is held to the highest industry standards and that commercial agreements as well as operational SLAs are met.
  • Develop close working relationships with key internal teams and individuals to ensure that they  provide appropriate levels of support to these key partnerships and key enhancements are made to unlock revenue for the business.
  • Conduct regular business reviews, formal presentations for internal and external purposes.
  • Work cross-functionally to execute changes at scale while collaborating with Market Management as a subject matter expert in Key Accounts accounts to drive local property performance. 
  • Proactively contribute to the development and standardization of Enterprise team processes, playbooks, and best practices across the global function

Your Expertise:

  • 8+ years of Travel Industry Account Management experience; including 5 years in a Key Account Manager role with at least 2 years  being responsible for a global partner base. 
  • Proven track record of executing on strategic priorities
  • Experience in analyzing, structuring and negotiating complex deals that align across multiple business unit needs
  • Strong negotiation skills with a proven ability to structure and close high-value, complex deals that establish long-term, strategic partnerships.
  • Comfortable performing data analysis and making decisions based on the results
  • Ability to balance time spent between strategic initiatives and operations while diving into the details when necessary.
  • Experience developing and selling complex business solutions at the C-Suite level
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to effectively influence top leaders internally and within the industry
  • Have a passion for redefining travel, Airbnb, and being the best!
  • Proactive self-starter able to prioritize and manage work autonomously
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to travel at least 50% of the time.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Germany Annual Pay Range€84.000—€105.000 EUR

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Senior Legal Compliance Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Legal Compliance Counsel, you will shape and drive Parloa's compliance strategy. You will be the go-to expert for Product, Engineering, and Sales on the rules that apply to SaaS and AI companies, and you will make sure our products and business practices meet them.

This is your opportunity to build compliance into an enterprise AI platform from the ground up, right as AI regulation is taking shape.

Areas of ownership:

  • Compliance Leadership: Lead on compliance topics and advise people at every level, from daily operational questions to go-to-market decisions. Set priorities and steer the company's compliance direction.

  • Product Compliance: Work with Product and Engineering to build requirements like the EU AI Act, data protection and industry-specific rules into products early in development. Make compliance-by-design the default way Parloa builds.

  • Compliance Reviews and Risk Management: Lead reviews of contracts, product features and business processes. Identify, assess and prioritize legal and regulatory risks, then turn them into practical solutions that keep the business moving.

  • Policies and Commercial Enablement: Write and roll out policies and processes for commercial teams, working with Sales Enablement to spread best practices across the company. Manage external counsel on complex matters.

  • Regulatory Monitoring and Function Building: Track new regulation, especially in AI, and turn its impact into clear recommendations for leadership. Build and improve compliance processes over time and mentor team members as the function grows.

Who you are:

  • Fully qualified lawyer (German state exams / Volljurist) or an equivalent degree from a recognized institution. We also consider candidates with an LL.M. in German law after a different first degree.

  • Several years as Legal Counsel with a clear focus on regulatory compliance. Ideally this includes product compliance or close work with Product, Engineering, GRC or the CISO.

  • Solid understanding of regulatory requirements for SaaS and/or AI companies, such as the EU AI Act, EU Data Act, DORA, HIPAA and GDPR.

  • Proven track record of driving compliance topics as the subject-matter lead, ideally with some leadership or mentoring experience.

  • Ability to turn complex legal topics into practical, business-focused solutions that non-legal teams, especially product and engineering, can act on.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join the ML Engineering team in Patient Solutions.

Your mission will be to improve how people access quality care and manage their health over time by building and leading AI and ML systems that create real, measurable impact. You will work in a feature team developing intelligent patient-facing solutions, from smart practitioner discovery to long-term care management, playing a key technical role in shaping how we scale our AI capabilities across Europe.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and implement ML and AI solutions aligned with patient product goals, covering search, retrieval, and personalized care pathways

  • Build and maintain large-scale retrieval pipelines, including hybrid search, embedding systems, vector databases, and multi-stage re-ranking architectures

  • Develop, fine-tune, and evaluate LLM and VLM models using techniques such as knowledge distillation, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures, and prompt engineering

  • Build and orchestrate agentic AI systems, integrating external data and capabilities through tools and MCP-based integrations

  • Define metrics aligned with product goals, run controlled end-to-end experiments using W&B, MLFlow, or Braintrust, and communicate findings to guide product and technical decisions

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

  • You have 7+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, or AI Engineering, with a strong track record of taking models from prototype to production at scale

  • You have hands-on experience building and orchestrating agentic AI systems (e.g., using ADK)

It would be fantastic if you:

4076 - Senior Manager, Global Resource Management – GOC (Parental Leave Cover)

Role Summary and Impact

The Senior Manager, Global Resource Management will play a key role in supporting the effective planning, deployment and utilisation of talent across the Global Operations Centres (GOCs).

The role will have responsibility for the day-to-day Resource Management of selected GOC Global clients, while also leading key RM activities including utilisation reviews, balanced team management, bench governance and cross-GOC RM projects.

Working closely with Capacity Planners, Staffing Strategists, Talent Acquisition, HR and market teams, the Senior Manager will help ensure client demand is effectively resourced, workforce risks are proactively identified, and RM processes are consistently managed across the GOCs.

The role will act as a key operational partner to the GOC RM Lead, taking ownership of defined areas and escalating strategic, commercial or significant workforce decisions where required.

Key Responsibilities

Global Client Resource Management

  • Own Resource Management for selected strategic global clients using GOC talent.
  • Support new global client opportunities and transitions, translating demand into clear resource requirements and staffing plans.
  • Coordinate staffing requirements across multiple GOC locations and disciplines.
  • Work with Capacity Planning and Staffing teams to identify appropriate resources and drive open requirements through to fulfilment.
  • Maintain oversight of the client's GOC workforce, including open roles, upcoming demand, resource movements, backfills and capacity risks.
  • Establish an effective RM cadence with relevant client and market stakeholders.
  • Proactively identify resource issues and drive actions to resolution.
  • Escalate significant commercial, capacity or stakeholder risks to the GOC RM Lead.

Utilisation & Workforce Optimisation

  • Coordinate regular utilisation reviews across GOC teams.
  • Identify under-utilisation, over-utilisation and available capacity and work with relevant teams to agree appropriate actions.
  • Monitor utilisation trends and highlight emerging risks or opportunities.
  • Ensure actions from utilisation reviews are tracked through to completion.
  • Support proactive redeployment of available talent against suitable client demand.
  • Provide concise utilisation insights and exception reporting to the GOC RM Lead.

Balanced Teams

  • Support regular reviews of team structures across GOC clients.
  • Identify opportunities to improve team balance, workload distribution and appropriate management oversight.
  • Work with RM, client and operational teams to address identified team structure or workload issues.
  • Monitor agreed actions and ensure they are followed through.
  • Highlight structural workforce issues requiring longer-term intervention.

Bench Management & Redeployment

  • Own the ongoing coordination and governance of GOC bench activity.
  • Support the rollout of the existing bench framework across additional GOC locations.
  • Maintain visibility of available resources and actively connect relevant skills and capacity with upcoming client requirements.
  • Coordinate appropriate bench project opportunities where immediate billable deployment is not available.
  • Track bench movements and provide visibility of key risks, ageing cases and redeployment opportunities.
  • Work with relevant GOC stakeholders to ensure consistent adoption of the bench process.

Resource Planning & Operational Support

  • Provide support on complex staffing requirements that require coordination across multiple markets, clients, disciplines or GOCs.
  • Assist Capacity Planners and Staffing teams with more complex resource challenges.
  • Monitor key staffing risks, blockers and ageing requirements and help drive them towards resolution.
  • Coordinate with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR and other functions where additional support is required to fulfil resource needs.
  • Support workforce and capacity planning activities by ensuring emerging demand and supply risks are visible.

RM Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and deliver selected Resource Management projects and improvement initiatives.
  • Support the rollout of consistent RM practices across GOC locations.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify manual RM processes and improve ways of working.
  • Support improvements to RM reporting, dashboards and workforce visibility.
  • Lead agreed workstreams such as:
    • Bench management rollout
    • Balanced Teams
    • Utilisation governance
    • RM reporting and dashboards
    • Process standardisation
    • Skills and capability visibility

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • Experience in Resource Management, People Operations, or a related area is desirable.
  • This is a hands-on role that requires someone who is motivated to make an impact, not simply tick boxes; it requires initiative, ownership and an appetite for challenge.
  • Strong communication, proactive, organisation and influencing skills.
  • Experience managing resource requirements across multiple clients, teams or geographies.
  • Good understanding of utilisation, capacity management and workforce deployment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to convert workforce data into practical actions.
  • Strong stakeholder-management skills and confidence working with senior stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive actions to completion.
  • Experience delivering cross-functional projects or process improvements.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solutions-focused approach.
  • Ability to operate independently while recognising when issues require senior escalation.

What Success Looks Like

The Senior Manager will be successful when:

  • Selected global clients have clear, proactive RM ownership.
  • Complex staffing requirements are driven to resolution without requiring continuous intervention from the GOC RM Lead.
  • Utilisation and balanced-team reviews result in clear actions and follow-through, rather than simply reporting.
  • Bench capacity is visible and actively managed across GOCs.
  • RM initiatives are delivered consistently across locations.
  • Capacity Planning and Staffing teams have an effective senior operational escalation point.
  • Major workforce risks are identified early and escalated with clear recommendations.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

title: Senior Network Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Our client is an established, family-owned industrial technology company headquartered near Zurich. Its systems run at customer sites in more than 60 countries. To keep them reachable and secure, it needs someone who can build and run the networks behind them, and who is comfortable intervening and troubleshooting when a customer's connection goes down.

What you'll do

  • Set up, run and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote-access VPNs to customer sites (IPsec, OpenVPN)

  • Configure and maintain firewalls (Fortinet, OPNsense and others)

  • Design and implement networks at customer sites: switching, routing, VLANs, WLAN

  • Find and fix network problems together with customers and colleagues around the world, remotely or on site

  • Install and roll out software on Windows and Linux systems

  • Build and maintain the internal test and lab networks

  • Keep network documentation clear and up to date, and help improve how the team works


What you bring

  • A completed IT or electrical engineering education (EFZ with further training, HF, FH or equivalent)

  • At least three years of hands-on experience in network or system engineering

  • Solid knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching and firewalls

  • Real experience with VPNs, ideally IPsec and OpenVPN

  • Working knowledge of Windows Server

  • A calm, customer-focused way of solving problems, including under pressure

  • Fluent German and English

  • Willingness to travel occasionally for on-site work

Nice to have

  • Linux administration

  • Scripting or automation (Python, Bash)

  • Certifications such as CCNA/CCNP or Fortinet NSE

  • A background in network or cyber security

What's on offer

  • Room to shape the role and how things are done

  • Flexible working model with home office (up to 60%)

  • Individual training and certification budget

  • Comprehensive social benefits

  • A long-term position in a stable, family-owned company

Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Wege sind kurz, und du arbeitest direkt mit uns Foundern zusammen. Du arbeitest People & Culture bei uns nicht in einem bestehenden System ab. Du baust es auf.

Aufgaben

Qualifikation

  • Eigenverantwortung & Speed: Du arbeitest schnell, hands-on und eigenverantwortlich. Du lieferst in Tagen, nicht in Wochen, und misst dich an Ergebnissen statt an Aktivitäten.
  • Datenkompetenz & Kommunikation: Du steuerst nach Zahlen, nicht nach Bauchgefühl, und hast Zielwerte wie Time-to-Hire im Kopf.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Platform Engineer 

À propos du rôle et de l'équipe

La Cloud Platform Engineering (CPE) est une Business Unit de près de 200 personnes qui continue de se renforcer pour accompagner les ambitions tech de Decathlon. Notre objectif principal est de rationaliser le catalogue de produits techniques et de fournir des services clé en main pour les équipes IT, afin de leur permettre de se concentrer sur le développement de fonctionnalités à fort impact applicatif.

Au sein de la CPE, tu rejoindras l'équipe Cloud Dev. Notre mission est de fournir des fonctionnalités essentielles et abstraites pour le Cloud, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques de développement d'ingénierie logicielle pour unifier, sécuriser et optimiser nos plateformes.

Tu rejoindras une équipe à taille humaine, composée d'ingénieurs passionnés. Nous sommes fans de développement logiciel, d'Infrastructure as Code, de culture DevOps/SRE, d'automatisation, de veille technologique... et bien sûr, de sport !

Périmètre et missions d'un Platform Engineer

En tant que Platform Engineer, tu joueras un rôle central dans l'autonomisation des équipes de développement grâce à l'ingénierie de plateforme. Tes missions s'articuleront autour des piliers suivants :

1. Ingénierie Logicielle & Abstraction Cloud

  • Utiliser les meilleures pratiques de développement (Software Engineering, Software Architecture) pour concevoir du code propre, robuste et maintenable créant des couches d'abstraction au-dessus du Cloud.
  • Développer et industrialiser des API, outils internes et modules d'infrastructure en Python et Go.
  • Consommer et orchestrer des services Serverless (Google Cloud Functions, Google Workflows) et moderniser l'outillage de déploiement.

2. Infrastructure as Code & Automatisation DevSecOps

  • Concevoir, tester et déployer l'infrastructure de manière cohérente et automatisée avec Terraform.
  • Construire et optimiser des pipelines CI/CD modernes (de préférence avec GitHub Actions) intégrant les standards de sécurité DevSecOps dès la conception.
  • Automatiser les tâches récurrentes par du scripting (Python, Bash) afin de réduire l'effort manuel et maximiser la fiabilité.

3. Intégration Transversale & Excellence Opérationnelle

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Réseau, Sécurité et Bases de données pour garantir des intégrations fluides, performantes et sécurisées.
  • Rôle de Run Captain: prendre en charge le support de niveau 2/3, l'analyse des incidents et le traitement des demandes de service pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle.
  • Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLO/SLI ainsi qu'à la démarche de réduction du MTTR en automatisant la résolution des problèmes récurrents.

4. Accompagnement, Partage & Culture Produit

  • Rédiger une documentation technique propre et des guides utilisateurs pour faciliter l'adoption des services de plateforme.
  • Sensibiliser et former les équipes techniques aux bonnes pratiques d'utilisation des composants développés.
  • Participer à l'animation collective via la gestion agile de nos livrables dans JIRA et promouvoir le partage de connaissances au sein de l'équipe.

Ce dont tu auras besoin pour réussir

  • Expérience & Dév : Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en développement Python avec une solide maîtrise des pratiques modernes de génie logiciel.
  • Expertise Cloud : Fortes compétences et expérience avérée sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD : Maîtrise de Terraform et très bonne pratique des pipelines CI/CD (idéalement GitHub Actions).
  • Scripting & Serverless : Bonne connaissance de l'automatisation (Python, Bash) et de l'architecture Serverless / événementielle.
  • Soft Skills & Esprit d'équipe : Excellent relationnel, fort sens de la satisfaction client/utilisateur interne, rigueur dans la documentation et aisance pour résoudre des problèmes complexes.
  • Langues : Anglais maîtrisé à l'oral comme à l'écrit, niveau B2 minimum.
  • Un plus apprécié : Connaissance pour le langage Go, l'utilisation de Google Workflows ou une certification GCP (Associate Cloud Engineer ou Professional Cloud Developer).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Esprit d'équipe & Sport : Une communauté sportive passionnée et du temps dédié à la pratique du sport.
  • Cadre de travail : Possibilité de travailler dans l'un des bureaux de Decathlon Digital à Paris ou Lille et 2 jours de télétravail par semaine.
  • Environnement de travail : Du matériel récent en accord avec tes missions et tes besoins techniques.
  • Opportunités & Mobilité : Une équipe locale au sein d'un réseau mondial, offrant des possibilités de carrière à l'international.
  • Développement professionnel : Accompagnement continu dans le développement de tes compétences (diversité des projets, certifications, formations internes et externes…).
  • Package de rémunération : Package attractif incluant la participation des employés aux actions de l'entreprise ainsi que des bonus mensuels, trimestriels et annuels.

DECATHLON DIGITAL 

Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les frontières et d'offrir des expériences sportives inédites. C'est précisément notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une équipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ingénierie logicielle, gestion de produits, données, cloud et cybersécurité, répartis à Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous créons la plus vaste plateforme sportive numérique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la chaîne de valeur, concevoir des expériences connectées et donner une seconde vie à nos produits.

Changeons la donne pour de bon. Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu’elle perdure. C’est pourquoi nous nous engageons à bâtir un modèle technologique plus durable, en réduisant notre impact direct sur l'environnement, et en créant un espace sûr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous épanouir ensemble. Rejoins l’équipe et façonnons le futur du sport.
